raw.title: Account Executive
raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

About the Role

Build new client relationships in a defined territory, combining thoughtful account prioritization with the pace and persistence to create opportunities at scale. With a large pool of untapped accounts still to break into, you’ll build your own book of business rather than inherit a fixed set of relationships.

This role is for a hunter who sells with focus. You’ll prioritise accounts, prospect and create opportunities across multiple buying groups, run well-managed pilots, and close a steady flow of deals, with clear ownership of the relationship from first outreach through the early customer relationship. Your results are visible, you’ll help shape a newly tiered sales organisation, and you’ll grow within a clearer individual contributor progression path.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Own a defined territory, prioritise accounts, and win new clients.

  • Prospect and create opportunities across the buying groups within each target account, and build a reliable, repeatable pipeline.

  • Qualify quickly and run well-managed pilot processes from start to close.

  • Communicate 9fin’s value proposition to clients through tailored demos.

  • Negotiate and close new business, including multi-year agreements where it makes sense.

  • Build account plans that map the organisation and identify teams and desks to expand into.

  • Keep clear CRM records and forecast accurately.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Enablement, and Rev Ops so deals move cleanly from pilot to onboarding.

  • Share ideas with senior management to shape Commercial team processes and best practices.

  • Bring client feedback to Product so the platform keeps improving for our users.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 2+ years of relevant Account Executive experience ideally in capital markets and/or Fintech SaaS.

  • Have a hunter mindset and a track record of generating your own pipeline and exceeding targets, ideally in a high-volume sales environment.

  • Have a good knowledge of financial markets and the ability to build strong relationships within the 9fin community.

  • Can plan and prioritise across many opportunities at once, with accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly in writing and in conversation.

  • Build trust across a matrixed commercial organization and partner effectively with Customer Success, Content and Product.

  • Have an existing network in the leveraged finance community (helpful but not required).

  • Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

We’re looking for a Head of Strategic Accounts, EMEA to lead the top tier of our commercial organisation — the largest, most complex accounts driving 9fin’s next phase of growth. Strategics is our top segment: a targeted book of our largest ARR accounts across the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms who set the standard for how credit intelligence is bought and used.

You’ll build and lead a team of ~5–6 senior relationship managers in London, each owning a small portfolio of strategic accounts in a hybrid Account Management and Enterprise Sales role. You’ll partner closely with our Head of Strategic Accounts, EMEA to run a globally coordinated segment and work with senior Customer Success partners at the account level.

This is a builder role for a leader who has personally carried a large number, sold enterprise-scale deals into financial services, and knows how to raise the bar on rigour, presence, and multi-year deal execution.

This role requires 3 days in our London office.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Lead the EMEA Strategics team to consistent, forecastable delivery quarter over quarter across a book of $13M+ ARR accounts.

  • Coach and manage a team of ~5–6 Strategic Account Managers covering our most important banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, and law firms in EMEA.

  • Drive multi-year deal execution, lock in early renewals, and structure enterprise agreements that grow durably over time.

  • Coach the team through complex commercial motions — MSAs, procurement, legal review, and executive alignment at the MD, Partner, PM, Head of Desk, and C-suite level.

  • Run weekly segment reviews focused on deals moved, deals at risk, pipeline health, and account-level path-to-close plans.

  • Set the operating cadence for the segment. Enforce our 3-day office minimum, and drive territory planning, account mapping, and a shared deal methodology across the team.

  • Partner with the EMEA Head of Strategic Accounts to build geographic reciprocity, with EMEA AMs backing up EMEA coverage on global accounts, and vice versa.

  • Work in a “two-in-the-box” model with senior CSMs (product and usage) and Sales Engineering (pre-sales), and partner across Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing, and Product to remove barriers to growth.

  • Be the senior voice of our strategic clients into Product and Engineering — translating segment-level themes across credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed, and private credit into a clear point of view on the roadmap.

  • Represent 9fin externally with the C-suite — at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences, and roundtables — and become a recognised name in EMEA debt markets.

  • Build the operating system for the Strategics segment — deal reviews, path-to-close proposals, territory planning, and account planning frameworks that scale.

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 12+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including 4+ years leading strategic or enterprise sales teams selling into financial services (banks, asset managers, hedge funds, PE firms), law firms, or a mix.

  • Bring a consultative approach to selling and want to become a strategic partner to our clients

  • Have deep familiarity with capital markets, credit, or the debt markets ecosystem across credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed, and private credit — you can hold your own with a restructuring lawyer, a leveraged finance banker, or a credit PM.

  • Have led teams through multi-year deal execution and understand what it takes to secure meaningful year-over-year uplifts, early renewals, and complex enterprise agreements.

raw.title: Senior AI Product Manager
raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

Our AI product area is growing. We already have two Product Managers working across conversational AI, agentic workflows, and domain-specific automation, and we need a third to expand our capacity as the scope of AI at 9fin accelerates.

Backed by over $170M in funding (Series C), we are scaling rapidly across product, engineering, and go-to-market. AI is not a bolt-on feature at 9fin; it is the core differentiator for the next phase of the company.

You will join an established AI PM team and take ownership of a product area within our AI surface. This could span new AI-powered features for credit analysts, workflow automation for legal and financial analysis, or expanding our conversational AI into new domains. The team has already built evaluation infrastructure and quality frameworks; you will use and contribute to these rather than build them from scratch.

You will work within our product organization (eight squads across AI, data, and domain verticals) and partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, domain experts, and designers. This is a high-autonomy role with real scope to shape what 9fin's AI products can do for our clients.

 

What You'll Do

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Collaboratively create and champion a clear product vision and strategy for your area, with a focus on building and evolving our AI products

  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights into problem statements that identify root causes, not just symptoms

  • Shape the next generation of agentic AI products: multi-step reasoning workflows, tool orchestration, and autonomous task completion for financial professionals

  • Demonstrate a working understanding of the challenges specific to building with LLMs, including managing hallucinations, evaluating output quality, and designing for non-deterministic systems

  • Use confidence-building methods (prototypes, user research, data analysis) to understand how users will interact with AI-powered products before committing to full builds

AI Quality & Data

  • Use the team's AI evaluation framework (LLM-as-judge protocols, quality thresholds, SME eval cycles) to validate and improve the products you ship

  • Contribute to the data strategy for your product area: annotation quality, ground truth curation, and feedback loops that improve model performance over time

  • Proactively identify and track metrics that measure client and business benefit, working with the team on continuous model evaluation and improvement

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work

  • Work with data scientists and ML engineers to bridge the gap between business needs and the technical capabilities of AI models

  • Communicate strategy, initiatives, and progress transparently across the organisation

  • Translate complex AI concepts, capabilities, and limitations into language that non-technical stakeholders can act on

  • Champion responsible AI practices: transparency in model outputs, bias monitoring, and compliance with client expectations around AI-generated content

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in FinTech or B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years focused on ML or GenAI products

  • Working knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation methods (not just "AI concepts" at a high level)

  • Experience shipping AI products where output quality is probabilistic: you know how to define "good enough" and iterate from there

  • Comfortable reading Python notebooks and SQL to interrogate model outputs and usage data

  • Track record of shipping AI products where you managed the tension between ML research/exploration and production delivery constraints

  • Collaborative leadership style with strong stakeholder management; you build relationships that empower your team to achieve outcomes

  • User-centric communication skills: you can explain AI capabilities and limitations to clients and internal stakeholders without overselling or underselling

  • You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and are energised by the challenge of building something new

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, legal tech, or data/analytics platforms

  • Familiarity with credit markets, debt instruments, or regulatory/compliance workflows

  • Experience with NLP applied to document analysis (contracts, legal filings, financial reports)

  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, tool use patterns, or multi-step AI workflows


The Opportunity

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from in-house legal subject matter experts (SMEs), customer interviews, customer feedback and data signals to craft a clear problem statement, articulating the root cause in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

  • Impact driven: Align the team around a key outcome and effectively prioritise initiatives across multiple dimensions.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics to measure client and business benefit. Work with the team to define and manage a process for continuous model evaluation and improvement, with particular attention to the accuracy and reliability standards required in legal contexts.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team success: Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complex legal and financial concepts to technical audiences, and similarly communicate technical capabilities to legal and credit professionals.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower the squad to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside of your team.

  • Stakeholder management: Work closely with stakeholders, including 9fin's legal analysts, credit team to gather the right input and insights. You will need to listen carefully and bring people on a journey.

AI Product Development

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered legal document extraction and covenant analysis, ensuring outputs meet the precision standards required for professional use.

  • Partner with software and AI engineering to define evaluation frameworks for AI outputs in legal contexts, where accuracy, source attribution, and explainability are critical to user trust.

  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to novel legal workflow problems, from covenant compliance monitoring to cross-document analysis across deal histories.

About You

This role will be a great fit if:

  • You have a legal or financial markets background, or have built products for this audience. You may have started your career as a lawyer, paralegal, or credit analyst, or you may have been a PM at a legal tech company. You are able to hold a substantive conversation about credit agreements, covenant packages, and how legal language governs capital structures. A sharp PM from an adjacent domain who can demonstrate rapid domain immersion will also be considered.

  • You are a strategic thinker who thrives with a blank page. You are comfortable defining strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing roadmap. You can synthesise ambiguous inputs into a clear direction and bring a team with you.

  • You're a collaborative leader. You have an empathetic leadership style and build strong, effective relationships. You love working autonomously but are able to earn the trust of others with a collaborative style. You are great at prioritising, not afraid to say no, and excel at managing stakeholders while also being confident in voicing your own opinions and challenging others.

  • You've got hands-on experience with AI. You have experience with or a working knowledge of AI and LLMs, including how to evaluate model outputs in production environments. You understand what good looks like when AI is applied to high-stakes, precision-dependent workflows, and you can engage meaningfully with engineering teams on evaluation design and quality standards.

  • You work in an AI-native way. You use generative AI tools as a natural part of how you work: prototyping ideas, conducting research, reviewing PRDs, and building agents or automated workflows to extend your own productivity. You are comfortable using coding assistants to get things done faster and are genuinely excited about what this shift means for how product work gets done. This is not a nice-to-have. We expect our PMs to be at the frontier of how AI accelerates product development.

  • You thrive building from zero. You are energised by the opportunity to define something new rather than optimise something established. You move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct based on evidence.

raw.title: Information Security & Risk Officer
raw.description:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


The role

It's a hands-on, delivery-focused role, and you'll make an impact from the start in risk management, security advisory, customer and tender responses, audit readiness and our data strategy.

This isn't a security engineering role. You won't configure firewalls or run vulnerability scans. Instead, you'll understand our technical environment well enough to spot risks and gaps, then recommend best practices for Engineering, DevOps and IT to put in place. A background in compliance management alone won't be enough for this role.

You'll report to our Senior Information Security Officer, who owns our GRC framework, ISO 27001 programme, CE/CE+ & DSPT compliance, and the security risk register. You'll help deliver across all of it.

Challenges you’ll solve...

  • Own risk management: run risk sessions across the business, keep the risk register current, write clear risk reports and chase treatment actions to completion

  • Advise the business: be the security voice with Engineering, DevOps, IT and Product, and a first point of contact for security questions from every team

  • Handle customers, tenders and suppliers: answer security questionnaires and tenders accurately, and assess suppliers before we approve them

  • Keep us audit-ready: gather evidence all year round for Cyber Essentials Plus, DSPT and ISO 27001, and flag control gaps with practical fixes

  • Deliver our data strategy: drive the data classification and access control programmes forward with data owners

You should apply if...

  • You have hands-on infosec and risk experience: ideally in health-tech, regulated SaaS or software development. You've run risk sessions, managed a risk register and reported on risk to senior stakeholders.

  • You possess technical depth to hold your own: You understand authentication vs authorisation, least privilege, IAM, network segmentation and firewalls, patch and vulnerability management, endpoint protection and cloud infrastructure.

  • You understand frameworks: ISO 27001, DSPT, NIST and Cyber Essentials Plus, and a sense of what proportionate looks like in a fast-moving product company.

  • You work fast and independently: You manage your own workload, flag blockers early and can move between a tender, a questionnaire and an engineering conversation in the same day.

  • You care about healthcare: and know the data we protect belongs to patients and clinicians.

Nice to have: enterprise risk management experience, and having been through a CE+ audit cycle.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £65,000 - £75,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £15,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £65K – £75K • Offers Equity

raw.title: Senior Product Designer
raw.description:
About Aibidia

Aibidia is a fast-growing SaaS company transforming how multinational businesses manage transfer pricing. We're building intelligent, scalable software that simplifies complex tax and compliance processes, helping some of the world's largest organisations work more efficiently and confidently.

We're a team that values curiosity, ownership and pragmatic problem-solving. As we continue to evolve our products and embrace AI-native ways of working, we're looking for a Design Engineer to help shape the next generation of our platform.

The Role

We're looking for an AI-first Senior Product Designer who combines strong technical capabilities with a solid understanding of product design, UX and usability.

This is a hybrid role at the intersection of design and engineering. You'll work on complex, data-rich enterprise software, using modern AI tools to rapidly prototype, iterate and deliver intuitive product experiences.

We're not looking for someone who simply creates beautiful interfaces or follows traditional, lengthy design processes. We want someone who thinks systematically, understands how software is built and knows how to leverage AI to turn complex requirements into functional, user-friendly solutions.

You'll join a team that has already established an AI-first design system and modern ways of working. Rather than reinventing what's already in place, you'll build on these foundations, contributing to an evolving design system while helping us move towards faster, more iterative product development.

What You'll Do

Design, prototype and ship

  • Translate complex business requirements and user needs into intuitive, functional product experiences.

  • Rapidly prototype and iterate on new features using AI-powered tools, getting working solutions in front of users early.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and domain experts to take ideas from concept through to implementation.

  • Balance usability, technical feasibility and speed of delivery, knowing when to iterate and when a solution is good enough to ship.

  • Design for complex, data-heavy workflows where clarity, efficiency and accuracy matter more than visual embellishment.

Build with an AI-first mindset

  • Use AI tools such as Claude, Figma and MCP integrations as a core part of your design and development workflow.

  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies, agents and workflows to continuously improve how we build products.

  • Apply sound design and engineering judgement to AI-generated outputs, ensuring quality, usability and consistency.

Contribute to our design system

  • Build on and contribute to our existing AI-first design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across the product.

  • Understand and apply design system principles, including components, design tokens, spacing, layouts, accessibility and interaction patterns.

  • Identify opportunities to improve components, documentation and AI-assisted design workflows.

Collaborate and validate

  • Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to understand problems, validate ideas and gather feedback.

  • Take a lean, iterative approach to product development, prioritising early validation over lengthy discovery cycles.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to ensure designs are technically achievable and can be efficiently implemented.

  • Continuously refine solutions based on user feedback, technical constraints and evolving business needs.

What We're Looking For

  • A hybrid design and engineering background, with hands-on coding capabilities and a strong understanding of UX, UI and usability principles.

  • Experience using modern AI tools as an integral part of your workflow, with a genuine interest in AI-assisted design, prototyping and development.

  • Strong systems thinking, with an understanding of how scalable design systems, reusable components and technical frameworks work together.

  • Experience contributing to design systems, with knowledge of design tokens, component libraries, accessibility and established UI patterns.

  • Experience working directly with codebases, GitHub and modern frontend technologies, rather than operating solely within traditional design tools.

  • Experience designing or building complex, data-dense B2B SaaS, enterprise or workflow-driven products.

  • Experience working in a startup or scaleup environment, where priorities evolve, teams are lean and speed of execution matters.

  • Strong product judgement and the ability to balance user needs, business requirements and technical constraints.

  • A curious, adaptable mindset and enthusiasm for experimenting with emerging technologies and new ways of working.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, tax technology, compliance or other complex, regulated industries.

  • Exposure to both early-stage startups and larger, more established software organisations.


Why Join Aibidia?

  • Build the future of AI-first product development: Help shape how AI is embedded into the way we design, prototype and ship software.

  • Solve genuinely complex problems: Work on sophisticated enterprise software where thoughtful design and usability have a meaningful impact.

  • Make an impact: Join a lean, collaborative team where your ideas, technical judgement and contributions directly influence the product.

  • Work with modern tools: Experiment with emerging AI technologies and continuously improve how products are built.

  • Grow with us: Be part of a scaling international SaaS business that's challenging traditional approaches to tax technology.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 💰 Share in Aibidia’s success – Enjoy a competitive compensation and incentive package that rewards your contribution.

  • 🏡 Flexible, hybrid working – Flexible working hours and a hybrid policy designed to support how you work best.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive healthcare – A healthcare package to support you and your wellbeing.

  • 💚 Wellbeing that matters – A genuine focus on physical and mental wellbeing, supported by our internal Health & Wellbeing Committee.

  • 🎉 Time to celebrate together – Regular team socials, including our much-loved summer and winter parties.

  • 💻 The best tools for the job – Access to the latest technology to help you do your best work.

  • 🚀 Invest in your growth – Performance-based development is part of our culture, with a dedicated learning budget for every employee.

  • 🌍 Make an impact globally – Join a fast-growing global SaaS company using technology to transform a traditionally complex industry.

  • 🤝 Low hierarchy, high collaboration – Work in an open, collaborative environment where ideas are valued and everyone has the opportunity to make an impact.

 

We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity, we want you to bring you, no matter your background, gender, race or sexual orientation!

Please note, we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. To be considered, you’ll need to show proof of your eligibility to work in the country.

raw.title: Associate Director, Transaction Monitoring
raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Airwallex is strengthening its global second-line Transaction Monitoring capability across products, payment rails and jurisdictions. You'll set the governance, challenge and modernisation agenda for a high-volume, global financial crime environment.

  • Own Airwallex’s global second-line Transaction Monitoring strategy, governance framework and policy standards across products, payment rails, customer base and jurisdictions.

  • Drive independent 2LOD challenge and oversight of 1LOD Transaction Monitoring teams, raising investigative rigour, alert disposition quality and consistency in suspicious activity detection.

  • Oversee second line regional SAR/STR/SMR reporting teams in performance of L3 review and preparation of suspicious activity reports according to relevant requirements, in coordination with regional and local MLROs.

  • Oversee the second line global Financial Intelligence Unit in performance of complex investigations, including cross-regional reviews, internal and external referrals, intelligence scanning and emerging risk typology development.

  • Collaborate with the FCC Global Models lead on performance of appropriate governance of the global Transaction Monitoring rule lifecycle, covering typology identification, scenario logic, segmentation, threshold tuning, and above- and below-the-line testing across cross-border payments and multi-currency accounts.

  • Lead the evolution from threshold-based monitoring towards AI-driven anomaly detection, machine-learning behavioural clustering and automated alert triage while maintaining explainability and regulatory defensibility.

  • Partner with Product, Data Science and Engineering to embed Transaction Monitoring logic into core transaction-processing systems and real-time payment infrastructure.

  • Resolve complex financial crime escalations, including novel laundering schemes, sanctions-evasion typologies and complex Suspicious Activity Report (SAR / STR) decisions.

  • Improve model effectiveness by partnering with Model Risk Management, Quantitative teams and Audit to validate Transaction Monitoring models and maintain coverage mapping against global regulatory standards.

  • Represent Airwallex’s Transaction Monitoring programme in regulatory examinations, including FCA, MAS, HKMA and AUSTRAC reviews, as well as partner-bank due diligence.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 10+ years of dedicated AML and financial crime experience, with deep technical and operational expertise in Transaction Monitoring across global cross-border payments, corporate banking, FX or fintech platforms.

  • 3+ years of experience leading, managing or mentoring compliance professionals in a global or multi-regional setting.

  • Proven experience establishing 2LOD oversight frameworks, rule-governance processes and effective challenge mechanisms for high-volume, automated Transaction Monitoring platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets, SQL, data analytics and modern Transaction Monitoring models, translating business logic into technical parameters for Data Science and Engineering teams.

  • Practical experience evaluating, testing or deploying AI/ML tools, graph analytics or automated dispositioning models in a regulatory compliance environment.

  • Strong understanding of global AML rules, typology standards and reporting expectations across key regulators, including FCA, FinCEN, MAS, HKMA and AUSTRAC.

  • A proven track record of managing regulatory examinations, internal or external audits and banking-partner inquiries relating to Transaction Monitoring systems and controls.

  • Exceptional stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative Transaction Monitoring models and risk decisions clearly to senior executives and external authorities.

  • Based in the UK, ideally within reach of Birmingham, with the agility to collaborate across APAC, EMEA and Americas time zones.

  • CAMS, CFCS, CFE or equivalent industry certification.

  • A bachelor’s degree.

Preferred

  • A quantitative, technical, data or legal degree.

  • Experience working across high-volume cross-border payments, corporate banking, FX or fintech platforms.

  • Experience partnering with Model Risk Management, Quantitative teams, Product, Data Science, Engineering and Audit.

You'll thrive here if

  • You've operated in a compliance-heavy environment and know how to move fast without cutting the corners that matter.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team's direction once a call is made.

Learn more about your team

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

  • Report sanctions programme health, residual risk, key performance indicators, and emerging risk trends to executive leadership, risk committees, and the board.

  • Lead, inspire, and scale a high-performing team of sanctions managers and subject matter experts across multiple regions.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 12+ years of dedicated experience in sanctions compliance and financial crime risk management.

  • Executive leadership experience managing cross-regional teams in a second-line-of-defence or global policy capacity.

  • Deep expertise in global cross-border payments, multi-currency account structures, foreign exchange, platform or embedded finance, or digital asset ecosystems.

  • Expert knowledge of global sanctions regimes, including OFAC, the EU, UK OFSI, the UN, MAS, HKMA, and AUSTRAC, as well as trade restrictions, export controls, and sanctions evasion techniques.

  • Experience providing independent oversight of customer, payment, and counterparty screening operations.

  • A track record of evaluating, tuning, or deploying modern sanctions technology, including AI/NLP-assisted screening tools, graph databases, and automated alert disposition frameworks.

  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to operationalise complex regulatory requirements in automated payment infrastructure.

  • Hands-on experience leading regulatory examinations, managing voluntary disclosures, and presenting screening architectures to regulators and institutional banking partners.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional leaders, defend risk positions to regulators, and present complex sanctions topics clearly to executive leadership.

  • A bachelor’s degree.

Preferred

  • Certified Sanctions Specialist (CGSS), CAMS, or equivalent professional designation.

  • An advanced degree, such as a Juris Doctor, master’s degree, or degree in a technical or quantitative discipline.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team's direction once a call is made.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Global Risk team at Airwallex plays a critical role in enabling the company’s growth by building a strong, scalable, and globally consistent approach to risk management. The team works across the business to define risk appetite, develop frameworks and policies, support strategic decision-making, and provide oversight of key risks as Airwallex expands across products, markets, and regulatory environments. You’ll be part of a highly collaborative group that partners closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Financial Crime Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, and Legal teams to help Airwallex grow responsibly and with confidence. This is a team where you’ll tackle complex, high-impact challenges, shape how risk is managed at a global fintech, and help build the foundations for long-term scale.

What you'll do

As Senior Director, Enterprise Risk Management, you will shape and scale Airwallex’s enterprise risk management capability across the US and EMEA, helping ensure risk management is a strategic enabler of growth rather than a check-the-box exercise. You will translate Board-approved risk appetite into practical decision-making, strengthen governance and reporting, guide major product and organization changes, and help the company stay resilient as it grows across markets, products, and regulatory environments. You will work closely with the Chief Regulatory and Compliance Officer and senior leaders across the business to turn complex risk signals into clear action, while building a strong and practical risk culture across the organization.

This role is based in the US or EMEA.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the evolution of Airwallex’s enterprise risk architecture, including risk appetite, taxonomy, governance standards, escalation protocols, and enterprise-wide oversight, ensuring the framework remains aligned with business strategy and global growth priorities.

  • Translate complex risk data, issues, and trends into clear, decision-useful reporting for the C-suite, Board committees, and external stakeholders, and act as a trusted independent advisor who can challenge initiatives that exceed approved risk appetite or outpace control maturity.

  • Oversee risk-informed change governance for new products, new markets, major systems changes, and structural changes, ensuring governance supports business velocity while maintaining effective control standards and clear accountability for remediation of material issues.

  • Own and continue to strengthen the enterprise crisis management framework, including escalation triggers, governance, and executive response mechanisms, while improving preparedness for severe but plausible events across operational, regulatory, technology, and business domains.

  • Drive a unified, risk-aware culture across the organisation by championing consistent adoption of enterprise risk standards, reinforcing first line ownership, and promoting risk management as a shared responsibility and competitive advantage.

  • Build and lead a high-performing global second line team, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, Finance, and regional leadership to support Airwallex’s next phase of scale with more data-driven and technology-enabled risk oversight.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Law, STEM, or another relevant quantitative field.

  • 10 to 15+ years of experience in risk management, operational risk, enterprise risk, compliance, controls, or audit within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or another highly regulated environment.

  • At least 5+ years leading enterprise risk management, operational risk, or governance programmes in a complex, matrixed, multi-jurisdiction organisation.

  • Proven experience designing, building, or scaling second line of defense frameworks, including risk appetite statements, risk taxonomies, governance processes, and escalation mechanisms.

  • Strong familiarity with the regulatory environment relevant to electronic money institutions and payments firms, including practical exposure to regulators such as the FCA, DNB, Bank of Lithuania, MAS, and FinCEN.

  • Demonstrated experience preparing risk papers and communicating effectively with senior executives, Board or committee audiences, regulators, or auditors, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience defining crisis or incident governance frameworks and leading or supporting executive-level response to material operational, regulatory, or business events.

  • A high-ownership, pragmatic approach, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and significant cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA, Master’s in Risk Management, or JD.

  • Professional certification such as FRM, PRM, CRMA, CAMS, or CFE.

  • Deep fintech and payments experience, including exposure to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, card scheme environments, local payment methods, or multi-entity regulated groups.

  • Experience managing risk approvals and governance in a high-velocity product and engineering environment, where new features, products, markets, or operating models are launched frequently.

  • Strong data literacy and comfort using dashboards, metrics, and technology-enabled tools to support risk oversight and reporting.

  • A clear bias toward automation, AI, and scalable tooling to improve issue management, reporting, and second line efficiency, paired with the judgment to balance innovation, business agility, and control effectiveness.

raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Role

As a Senior / Staff Product Manager, you will play a defining role in shaping the future of global money movement, embedded commerce, and unified payment acceptance at Airwallex. Operating at the intersection of core clearing/settlement infrastructure, merchant-facing experiences, and developer-first toolkits, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle—from long-term strategy and architectural design to global roadmap execution.

In this role, you will bridge our online payments-for-platforms suite (enabling marketplaces and SaaS platforms to collect, route, and embed payments) with next-generation in-person commerce (smart POS, SoftPOS, hardware/software integrations, and loyalty engines). You will lead cross-functional teams to modernise omnichannel workflows, scale coverage across international markets, and deploy AI-native capabilities that remove operational friction for global merchants.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery plans for Airwallex’s platform payments and in-person commerce solutions, expanding our reach across key verticals, marketplaces, and global geographies.

  • Architect seamless integrations connecting POS terminal workflows and embedded platform checkouts directly to core clearing, ledgering, and multi-currency settlement engines—optimising for processing speed, fee netting, and dynamic routing.

  • Build developer-first APIs, unified commerce SDKs, and intuitive terminal management systems (TMS) that drastically reduce integration overhead for marketplaces, platforms, and third-party software vendors.

  • Pioneer AI workflows and autonomous agents across merchant onboarding, automated terminal setup, dispute/risk management, transaction reconciliation, and proactive loyalty/reward engine optimisations.

  • Expand capabilities around alternative payment methods (APMs), card acquiring, and integrated loyalty redemption loops to help platforms monetize payments and retain underlying sellers.

  • Ensure high-availability infrastructure (including offline POS processing resilience) while delivering tooling to help merchants satisfy regulatory mandates (PCI-DSS, EMV, PSD3/local frameworks) and manage platform risk.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Hardware/Firmware, Commercial, Legal/Compliance, and Operations teams to build scalable feedback loops and launch high-impact products from concept to global scale.

Who You Are

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience building high-scale, mission-critical platform products in fintech, payments, or commerce infrastructure (Staff-level scope).

  • Hands-on domain expertise in card acquiring, embedded finance/platform payment models (marketplaces, payfac-like setups), or card-present ecosystems (POS/SoftPOS, EMV/NFC standards, terminal management).

  • Proven ability to engage deeply with engineering on complex architectural discussions covering API design, distributed ledgers, high-throughput transaction processing, and hardware/software interfaces.

  • Exceptional analytical rigor with a track record of structuring complex ecosystem workflows, leveraging data to drive strategic trade-offs, and solving ambiguous problems.

  • High agency, persistence, and an entrepreneurial bias for action—capable of executing fast and driving complex initiatives to completion in a high-growth environment.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; proven success influencing cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders across diverse international regions.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher with strong academic performance, preferably with coursework in Computer Science, Engineering, or quantitative disciplines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience designing or scaling developer-first payment APIs, unified commerce SDKs, or multi-sided platform architectures.

  • Hands-on exposure to deploying Generative AI, agentic workflows, or automated intelligence in fintech operations, transaction reconciliation, or onboarding.

  • Working familiarity with international card networks, alternative payment methods (APMs), cross-border settlement rails, and regional regulatory frameworks (UK/EU, APAC, or Americas).

Associate Relationship Manager - London
raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. Allica’s Relationship Management team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow at pace, providing established SME customers with expert human relationships alongside modern banking technology.

The team supports customers with lending, current accounts, savings, asset finance and working capital facilities, while building deep local relationships with SME customers, trusted professional advisers and business communities.

The Associate Relationship Manager role is a newly created position that is a key step in our ambition to build the best Relationship team to support our SME clients. The successful candidate will manage a portfolio of clients and be expected to deliver across a range of commercial, customer service and risk objectives whilst also providing support to the wider relationship team as part of their development.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to develop their skills and progress a career as an SME Relationship Manager.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Manage a portfolio of SME customers delivering outstanding customer service, building genuine and trusting relationships and develop a deep understanding of your clients’ businesses and their ambitions.

  • Deliver against a range of commercial targets including lending and new customer / deposit acquisition, as well as identifying and meeting a range of client needs through the provision of Allica products and services.

  • Build a trusted external network with SME advisers and the wider business community. Leverage this network to generate new business opportunities for the bank, in addition to signposting your clients to external support and advice as appropriate.

  • Ensure that Risk is managed effectively on your portfolio, with all required risk activities completed on time and to a high standard. Use customer data and internal Allica systems to identify signs of client stress and take proactive action to tackle early.

  • Work closely with a Senior Relationship Manager, contributing to building a bespoke personal development plan which will include supporting them and the wider team as part of your learning.

  • Take an active role in new business campaigns, including attending events, following up on leads, supporting prospect engagement and undertaking some cold calling where appropriate.

  • Support event organisation and follow-up activity, helping the team build strong local relationships with SME customers, prospects, accountants, solicitors and other trusted professional advisers.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

At Bandwidth, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on, the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful. And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand

What We Are Looking For:

The Carrier Account Executive will fuel revenue growth by discovering, cultivating, and securing new opportunities across Bandwidth's suite of services within the Carrier Customer Segment.

What You'll Do:

  • Navigate effectively within customer organizations to sell Bandwidth's voice and messaging offerings.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across multiple levels of customer contacts, align Bandwidth resources with key customer decision makers.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each customer's business, market, and technical requirements to position Bandwidth's solutions effectively.
  • Achieve assigned quota for incremental revenue growth across the Bandwidth account base.
  • Analyze customer and market needs, pricing models and network operations input. Provide feedback through internal channels so course correction can be made quickly and efficiently.

What You Need:

  • Education:  
    • Bachelor Degree, Business. Marketing/Sales, Engineering or similar
  • Experience:  
    • 5+ years of experience in Strategic, technical, and communications application sales.
    • Existing relationships in major European Carrier / Service provider segment.
    • Proven success in client relationship management, account growth, and navigating complex customer organizations.
    • Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, influence decisions, and support customer needs
  • Knowledge:  
    • Working knowledge of Salesforce or similar CRM systems; proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint Customer
    • Knowledge of Voice and Messaging Services and working with the large Carrier segment
  • Skills: 
    • Ability to build strong, trust based relationships across multiple levels of a customer organization.
    • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate, triage customer needs and coordinate with internal experts when necessary
    • Capable of managing multiple tasks across a large account base while maintaining focus on revenue impacting activities.
    • Customer centric mindset paired with a proactive, sales driven approach to growing accounts

The Whole Person Promise: 

At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

  • Work laptop & mobile phone with a competitive subscription plan, and an internet allowance to support the costs of the Internet at home.
  • We contribute 8% of your monthly gross salary into your private pension.
  • Income protection plan to ensure you'll receive a regular income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury.
  • Life insurance providing financial support to your loved ones in the event of your unexpected passing.
  • Health insurance, with extensive coverage, a simple claim process and the possibility to cover your life partner and children.
  • Extensive Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24/7 counseling and support on all areas of life (personal and professional).
  • Unlimited, free and anonymous consultations with our dedicated therapist.
  • Childcare support
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • 24 days annual leave per year and 1 additional day every 3 years.
  • Time-Off Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your time-off - not even with email.
  • Additional time-off can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
  • "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
  • 90-Minute Workout Lunches, contribution to your monthly fitness subscription and unlimited virtual meetings with our very own nutritionist.

 

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you're 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

 

Applicant Privacy Notice

What We Are Looking For:

Bandwidth is looking for an Account Director to own new business revenue within the Salesforce Native Contact Center ecosystem. This is an individual contributor, new logo role - built for a commercially aggressive hunter who thrives on closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.

At its core, this role exists because of a strategic partnership. Bandwidth is the first Preferred and Certified Carrier for Salesforce Native Contact Center internationally, so Salesforce enterprise AEs direct customers with BYOC telephony requirements to Bandwidth. The Account Director will own that inbound pipeline and convert it, while simultaneously self-sourcing additional new business.

This role also involves working alongside channel partners in B-end enterprise deals where Bandwidth's carrier capability is required to complete the solution. This is a collaboration motion, not a channel management role - the AD works with partners to close specific deals, not to recruit or develop the partner base.

The right candidate brings 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, credibility within the Salesforce or CCaaS ecosystem, and the commercial instinct to operate across a dual motion: partner-referred inbound and self-sourced outbound. You should be as comfortable working alongside a Salesforce AE on a joint pursuit as you are prospecting independently into a target account.

What You'll Do:

New Business Pipeline & Conversion

  • Own the full new business sales cycle for Salesforce Native Contact Center BYOC opportunities — from initial qualification through commercial structuring, negotiation, and contractual close
  • Manage and convert inbound pipeline referred by Salesforce AEs, maintaining deal velocity and ensuring Bandwidth is positioned correctly at each stage of the customer's evaluation process
  • Self-source additional new logo pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting into enterprise accounts operating within or adjacent to the Salesforce Native Contact Center ecosystem
  • Build and maintain a robust, accurate pipeline with strong CRM hygiene; manage forecasting and deal progression with the discipline expected at Account Director level of commercial engagement
  • Execute against individual revenue targets spanning both Salesforce-referred and directly sourced new business

Salesforce Partnership Collaboration

  • Build trusted, day-to-day working relationships with Salesforce enterprise AEs and their management - becoming the go-to Bandwidth contact for BYOC opportunities within their accounts
  • Participate in joint account planning with Salesforce sellers, helping map enterprise accounts with BYOC requirements and aligning on pursuit strategy
  • Engage Salesforce alliance and partnership contacts as needed to maintain commercial alignment and ensure inbound lead quality improves over time
  • Represent Bandwidth credibly in joint customer meetings alongside Salesforce - operating as a senior commercial peer, not a subcontractor

Channel Partner Collaboration on Enterprise Deals

  • Work alongside channel partners - including MSPs, SIs and Salesforce implementation partners - on B-end enterprise deals where Bandwidth's BYOC carrier capability is part of the solution they are delivering
  • Support channel-led pursuits by providing Bandwidth's commercial, technical and contractual expertise at the appropriate point in the deal cycle
  • Ensure deal economics are structured correctly in partner-involved transactions, with clear accountability for Bandwidth's revenue and obligations
  • Maintain strong working relationships with key channel partner contacts on active deals, providing the senior Bandwidth commercial presence they need to close

Executive Engagement & Deal Leadership

  • Navigate complex enterprise organisations, building relationships across CIO, CTO, VP of CX, operations and procurement - positioning Bandwidth as a strategic infrastructure partner for their Salesforce Contact Center deployment
  • Lead commercial negotiations on high-value, multi-stakeholder enterprise agreements, working across legal, security, finance and procurement to reach close
  • Orchestrate internal Bandwidth resources - Solutions Engineering, Legal, Product, Finance and Operations - around complex deals without losing deal momentum
  • Operate comfortably across large enterprise and complex mid-market deal sizes, adjusting commercial approach and engagement model appropriately

Market Intelligence & Commercial Feedback

  • Maintain a strong and current understanding of the Salesforce Native Contact Center landscape - how enterprise customers evaluate and adopt it, where BYOC fits into the decision, and what objections Bandwidth regularly faces
  • Provide commercial and competitive insight back to Bandwidth's product and GTM teams - surfacing patterns from the Salesforce channel and direct deals that should inform positioning and product direction
  • Stay informed on competitive dynamics across BYOC, CPaaS and CCaaS so you can position Bandwidth accurately and confidently in contested opportunities

What You Need:

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience - with a consistent, verifiable track record of closing six- and seven-figure ARR new logo deals in competitive, technically complex markets

  • Demonstrable experience operating in or alongside the Salesforce ecosystem - whether through co-sell motions with Salesforce AEs, selling into Salesforce-driven transformation programmes, or selling solutions that integrate with or complement Salesforce Contact Center or Service Cloud

    • Ability to build relationships at C-suite and VP level across IT, operations, procurement and CX functions, with the executive presence to represent Bandwidth as a senior commercial peer
    • Commercial acumen and deal-structuring capability to lead complex multi-stakeholder negotiations, including multi-party agreements involving channel partners
    • Strong pipeline and forecast discipline — comfortable managing a multi-source revenue target across Salesforce-referred inbound and self-sourced pipeline with full visibility and accuracy
    • Working knowledge of telecom fundamentals: SIP, PSTN, voice infrastructure, international connectivity and regulatory considerations including E911
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent enterprise sales experience
    • Strong understanding of BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) commercial and technical models - including how BYOC works within CCaaS and CRM platforms and what enterprise buyers need to understand to move forward

  • Experience working alongside channel partners on enterprise deals - understanding how to contribute to a partner-led pursuit, structure Bandwidth's commercial involvement and close without creating friction in the partner relationship

  • Solid knowledge of the CPaaS, CCaaS and cloud communications landscape - including the competitive dynamics, key platform players and how enterprises evaluate and adopt carrier-level infrastructure

Bonus Points:

  • Familiarity with Natterbox, Aircall, Dialpad or other Salesforce-native voice providers — and a clear understanding of how Bandwidth differentiates as a carrier in that space
  • Experience selling into regulated enterprise environments where compliance, resilience and security are key components of the buying decision
