About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The role

You will own the peptide and protein platform as a commercial product: the market analysis behind it, the target product profiles it is judged against, the decisions about what we build and license first, the go to market strategy and the positioning that partners hear. You will sit between our model and science teams and our business development function, and you will be accountable for the peptide portfolio having a defined buyer, a defensible claim and a credible price.

Key responsibilities

Market and competitive intelligence

  • Build and maintain a rigorous view of the peptide/protein therapeutics landscape by segment, indication and modality, mechanism trends and delivery technologies.

  • Track and interpret competitor activity across AI-enabled discovery platforms, peptide/protein-focused biotechs, screening technology providers, and internal pharmaceutical capability, and translate it into implications for our product road map and and go to market execution.

  • Maintain a live map of deal structures, comparables and valuation benchmarks in platform licensing and co-development, and advise on where our agreements should sit.

  • Bring the outside in: run structured voice-of-customer work with pharmaceutical R&D leaders, and turn it into prioritised, written requirements rather than anecdotes.

Target product profiles and programme definition

  • Author and defend target product profiles for internal programmes, specifying which properties are differentiated in the market and define evidence needs.

  • Translate partner-supplied target product profiles into feasible research plans in collaboration with scientific leadership, including honest assessments of what our platform can and cannot address today.

  • Define stage gates and go or no-go criteria for peptide programmes, and make the recommendation when a programme should stop.

Productization and roadmap

  • Decide, on evidence, which platform capabilities become licensable products and in what sequence, balancing near-term revenue against durable differentiation.

  • Own the peptide/product product roadmap end to end, agreeing priorities with model, data and science teams and holding the line on scope.

  • Define packaging and commercial models for each offering, including access arrangements, bespoke model fine-tuning on partner data, co-development structures and asset-level licensing.

  • Specify the data we need from partners in order to improve, and turn broad offers of collaboration into precise, written requests.

Positioning, evidence and partner engagement

  • Responsible for partner engagement and revenue generation in collaboration with the Business Development team.

  • Build the peptide narrative and the materials behind it: capability maps, benchmark summaries, validation packages and competitive comparisons that hold up under scrutiny from senior pharmaceutical scientists.

  • Set and enforce the standard for external claims, ensuring that what we say about validation, benchmarks and limitations is accurate, consistent across documents, and appropriately caveated.

  • Support business development through partner meetings, scientific exchanges, conferences and diligence processes, acting as the credible bridge between technical and commercial conversations.

  • Work with scientific and legal colleagues on intellectual property strategy, freedom-to-operate considerations and novelty positioning for designed molecules.

Essential experience and skills

  • Ten or more years in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with substantial exposure to peptide, protein or biologics therapeutics in discovery, development, product strategy or business development.

  • Demonstrable command of what makes peptides difficult as drugs: proteolytic stability, oral and systemic exposure, receptor selectivity and off-target risk, immunogenicity, formulation and manufacturability, and the trade-offs between them.

  • A track record of shaping and closing commercial partnerships, licensing agreements or platform deals with pharmaceutical companies, or of owning commercial strategy for a platform sold into pharmaceutical R&D.

  • Proven ability to author target product profiles, competitive assessments and commercial cases that senior stakeholders act on.

  • Credibility in both directions: able to hold a substantive technical discussion with computational and experimental scientists, and a commercial discussion with a vice-president of platform technologies, without over-claiming in either.

  • Comfort operating with incomplete evidence, and the discipline to distinguish clearly between what is validated, what is promising and what is aspiration.

  • Excellent written English. A great deal of this role is producing documents that must be right.

  • Travel including to represent Basecamp Research at clients and industry meetings

Desirable experience

  • Experience in metabolic disease, immunology, anti-infectives or another therapeutic area with an active peptide pipeline.

  • Familiarity with macrocyclic peptides, peptidomimetics, non-canonical amino acids, conjugation strategies or oral delivery technologies.

  • Direct experience of AI-enabled drug discovery platforms, from either the platform side or the pharmaceutical side of a partnership.

  • A postgraduate degree in a life science, chemistry or a related business areas, or equivalent depth acquired in industry

Compensation and benefits

What we offer in return

  • Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics..

  • Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

  • High Growth: We truly believe in investing our people we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that means most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.

We are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of ethnic or national origin, race, religion, sex, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other basis. If you have a disability or additional need that needs accommodating do let us know.

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers.

Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars.

We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses.

That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years.

  • Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger.

  • Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience.

  • Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it.

  • Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers.

  • Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems.

  • Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better.

  • Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself.

You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. THE ROLE

Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity

  • Partner Engagement & Insight:

    • Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build

    • Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier

    • Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve

  • Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace, or dealer-facing products

  • Familiarity with gamification or engagement loop design in a B2B context

raw.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace — connecting car buyers and sellers at scale — and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification.

You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions — and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration — delivering the full production lifecycle. With no dedicated ML engineering function, you'll be responsible for ensuring your solutions are robust, scalable, and performing in the real world long after they ship.

  • GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value — document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place.

  • Commercial Impact: Connect your work directly to business outcomes. Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly.

  • Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function — and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be the perfect match for all we've listed in this posting, so we’d encourage you to apply if you feel you're close to the brief but not an exact match. Ideally you’ll have

  • Commercial Mindset: You think about business impact first. You understand how your models connect to revenue, efficiency, or customer outcomes — and you use that to prioritise, scope, and communicate your work.

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels.

  • Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability.

  • [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context.

TEHCNICAL SKILLSET

  • Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy.

  • Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility.

  • GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short.

  • Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation.

  • Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it.

  • [Bonus] Experience with VertexAI

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

  • Languages: Python, SQL

  • Data & Transformation: dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery

  • Visualisation & BI: Looker

  • Engineering & MLOps: Docker, GitHub

  • Workflow & Orchestration: Vertex AI Pipelines (GCP), Kubeflow

  • LLMs & GenAI: Gemini API, Claude API

raw.title: Financial Risk Advisory - Director
raw.description:
Position Overview:
 
Risk Advisory Directors are critically important project leaders who help our clients navigate the complexities of SOX, deliver internal controls focused projects, and coach and develop our people. Our clients represent a broad range of public or soon-to-be public companies, from new IPOs, mid and large cap companies, and Fortune 1000s.
 
Principal Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Project Delivery:
 
·       Leads multiple concurrent SOX projects in various maturity stages (new implementation, recurring projects, and limited/defined scope projects).
·       Executes projects with minimal supervision by more senior individuals.
·       Sets realistic deadlines with the client and internally with the team.
·       Seen as the principle point of contact by the client and CFGI leadership for each project.
 
Engagement Management:
 
·       Schedules and manages teams/individuals of various staff level(s) based upon project need and scope.
·       Effectively manages the workload of the various teams/individuals, while making progress towards project milestones to deliver work on-time and on-budget.
·       Actively manages project budgets and evaluates whether there have been changes to budgetary assumptions; obtains client approval to perform any additional services in advance of incurring time.
·       Ensures the team member timecards are submitted timely and accurately; responsible for the review of budget-to-actuals and review of invoices.
·       Communicates project status frequently (via email, phone, virtually, and/or in person) to the client and to the project’s Partner.
 
Technical Acumen:
 
·       Fluency in implementing SOX for newly public companies, including the design of age/stage appropriate controls, providing practical guidance and controls implementation and the management of/remediation of gaps and deficiencies.
·       Expert proficiency in drafting and reviewing control design language, flowcharts, narratives, IPE, and determining system(s) and application(s) scoping.
·       Advanced understanding of Big 4 sampling, testing, and deficiency evaluation methodologies.
·       In-depth experience in the review of SOC-1 Type II reports and relevant CUEC mapping, including sub-service organizations.
·       Working proficiency and understanding of IT General Controls, SEC guidance as it pertains to the SOX requirements for different filer types, PCAOB, and AICPA audit standards.
 
People Development:
 
·       Leads by example.
·       Provides constructive, in-the-moment feedback and formal written feedback.
·       Identifies development opportunities for individuals and strategically schedules people in those roles.
·       Responsible for the morale of their teams.
 
Education and Experience Requirements:
 
·       10+ years of direct, client service/ client facing experience in commercial audit, risk advisory, or technical accounting, with at a minimum 6 years at a Big Four or a large national firm.
·       Undergraduate degree in accounting or similar field from an accredited university.
·       CPA and/or MBA combined with solid accounting experience are preferred but not required.
·       Strong project management skills with the ability to multi-task between responsibilities, prioritize and manage multiple requests.
·       Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills, and ability to assimilate easily into teams.
·       Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
·       Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written.
·       Exceptional virtual and in-person executive presence.
·       Entrepreneurial nature, self-motivated, ethical, and dependable.
·       As a professional, you must understand the unique pressures of client service and the occasional challenges of unpredictable working hours to meet project deadlines and/or client requests for travel, as necessary.

raw.title: Account Manager - London
raw.description:
Account Manager

About Us

ClaimSorted helps insurers outsource claims end to end – a service called Third-Party Administration (TPA), a ~$200B industry. We combine a strong in-house claims team with our AI-enabled platform to deliver up to 3× faster claims, better service, and better economics for insurers.

Backed by Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo, we’ve raised $15M+ and already manage claims for over $100M in insurance premium across 30+ MGAs, including more than five publicly traded companies. Our goal: scale to $1B and become the most valuable TPA in the market.

The Role

You will own the full customer relationship: onboarding, go-live, retention, renewals, expansion, and work directly with the CEO as the customer’s internal quarterback at ClaimSorted.

  • Lead onboarding and delivery: build the plan, drive the timeline, and ensure a clean go-live

  • Coordinate Ops, Claims, and Product to unblock issues fast and keep clients confident

  • Run the account rhythm: success plans, SLAs, escalation paths, and exec updates

  • Spot risk early, de-escalate issues, and earn renewals and references

  • Find and close expansion opportunities (new programs, regions, lines, volume)

  • Turn what works into repeatable playbooks, templates, and routines

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

Qualifications

We care more about hunger and grit than years on a CV. You might be a management consultant who’s seen insurance pain points firsthand, or a top-performing Account Manager ready for something bigger.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to London

  • Work authorisation in the UK without need of sponsorship

  • Commercially minded with the ability to map value and close expansions

  • Strong relationship builder who earns trust across stakeholders and stays calm under pressure

  • 2+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, sales, or insurance/InsurTech(a plus)

  • Knowledge of the insurance industry or TPA operations (a plus)

Our Values

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary beyond the industry standard

  • Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

  • Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

  • Medical insurance

  • Pension contributions (UK)

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

raw.description:
BUILDING A MORE RESILIENT WORLD

ABOUT CLAIMSORTED

At ClaimSorted, we’re building a more resilient world - one where people and businesses have the confidence to pursue bigger opportunities. We’re doing this by transforming how insurance delivers on its most important promise: helping people and businesses recover when things go wrong.

The world’s largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies work with us to handle claims and manage risk more efficiently, so they - and the people they protect - can move forward with confidence.

Backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo, we grew 10x in the past year - and we’re just getting started.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our founding GTM team and create a steady pipeline of qualified leads for our Strategic Account Executives (SAEs). You’ll be the first conversation most of our future customers have with ClaimSorted, finding the right people at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies in the world and giving them a reason to listen.

You’ll be measured on two things:

  • Volume: a high level of prospecting across email, LinkedIn, phone and other channels

  • Conversion: a high prospect-to-qualified-meeting rate, so every meeting you hand to an SAE is worth their time

What you’ll do:

  • Research accounts, identify the right stakeholders, and build targeted lead lists at the largest insurance and Fortune 500 companies

  • Run high-volume outbound across email, LinkedIn, phone and whatever else cuts through with people who get pitched constantly

  • Treat outreach as a structured process, using AI tools to research, personalize and scale your prospecting without losing quality

  • Qualify relentlessly, so every meeting you book is a real opportunity and not noise

  • Own top-of-funnel end to end, from first touch to a booked, qualified meeting handed to an SAE

  • Refine our outbound messaging as you go, feeding what you learn from hundreds of conversations back into how we message and target

  • Work directly with Claims and Product, so what you hear from prospects shapes how we position what we build next

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, in-office role in our London office. We’re a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

WHO YOU ARE

You have at least a year in a communications-heavy role, ideally in sales or something adjacent (SDR/BDR, recruiting, customer success, account management or similar), and you’re ready to step up into a high-growth enterprise sales environment.

  • Great written and spoken communicator: you can get a stranger to reply to a cold email or pick up the phone, and you keep sharpening your messaging when the data says it isn’t landing

  • A sharp researcher: you can quickly work out who the relevant people are at a large organization and what would make them care

  • AI-fluent: you use AI tools to do better prospecting, and you treat outreach as a structured, repeatable process rather than ad hoc effort

  • Built for volume: you stay sharp and motivated through a lot of “no” on the way to “yes”

  • Coachable and fast-learning: you take feedback on your outreach and improve week over week, not quarter over quarter

  • Organized and process-driven: you keep a high-volume pipeline clean so nothing falls through the cracks

  • Ambitious: you want this to be the start of a sales career, not a one-year stop

OUR VALUES

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Generous, transparent equity participation

  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • 30 days of remote work annually

  • Private medical insurance

  • Pension contributions

  • Company offsites

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
raw.description:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

raw.title: Account Executive
raw.description:
We're looking for an Account Executive to close new-logo business for Cytix in a market where most of the people you're calling haven't heard of us yet.
You'll be selling a product, not a service, into CISOs, security engineers and AppSec leads, which means the pitch has to work on its own merits rather than on brand recognition. This is a full-cycle closing role: you'll run discovery, demo and negotiation yourself, with support from the CRO on the harder deals while you build that muscle.

You'll carry mid-market opportunities to start, working alongside SDR-sourced pipeline as well as your own prospecting, with a clear path to Senior Account Executive as your quota, deal complexity and independence grow.

What you'll do

  • Run full-cycle new-logo opportunities from qualified meeting through discovery, demo and close, sourced by SDR, Marketing and your own prospecting.

  • Generate some of your own pipeline alongside SDR support, prospecting into a clearly defined ideal customer profile.

  • Run structured discovery calls solo, identifying pain and priorities for your primary buyer.

  • Close mid-market deals with negotiation support from the CRO as you build experience with more complex procurement.

  • Maintain your own weekly pipeline and forecast, developing commit accuracy over time.

  • Work SDR and Customer Success handoffs as directed, keeping CRM records clean and up to date.


What you'll bring

  • 3–5 years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, or a strong track record in an adjacent commercial role (for example SDR) ready to step up.

  • A track record at or near 100% of quota (around £500k–£750k) in at least one of the last two years.

  • Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them.

  • Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start.

  • Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked.

  • Genuinely bright and inquisitive: good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured.

  • Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance.

  • Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory.

What you'll get

  • Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off

  • Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team.

  • A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme.

  • Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover.

  • More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme.

  • Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

raw.title: Head of Product Growth
raw.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

 

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL runs product-led growth alongside our sales-led motion, with media translation as the strategic wedge. This role is responsible for turning DeepL into the default platform for translation worldwide driving adoption through product usage, and converting that usage into strong Product Qualified Leads (PQLs) tha convert into revenues and strengthen our sales pipeline. This role drives adoption of our core DeepL Translate features (e.g. Customization Hub, TQE) and cross-sell into adjacent products like DeepL Voice. You will start with a focus on Media Translation.

Your Mission: Put DeepL Translate in the hands of everyone, everywhere and use that reach to grow adoption across DeepL's broader product surface, turning usage into a reliable, high-quality source of PQLs for the business.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Use case strategy: prioritize the highest-value use cases for media translation, and and build the growth loops and product surface to drive adoption of them.

  • Distribution on the DeepL platform (main channel): drive media translation adoption directly within web, browser extension, and apps. Work closely with the API/MCP track.

  • PLG/PQL engine: define what qualifies as a strong PQL for media translation (usage signals, account characteristics, intent signals) , build the instrumentation to detect it, and design a clean handoff into sales.

  • Growth plays for feature/product discovery: design and run growth loops that help users discover and adopt more features and products beyond their initial media translation use case, expanding usage depth and breadth.

  • Cross-functional coordination:

    • Close collaboration with the Marketing team on funnel design, messaging, and PQL feedback loop.

    • Coordination with Sales/Sales Ops on PQL definition and handoff.

    • Iterate with Pricing & Packaging team on P&P strategy and optoimization

  • Metrics ownership: define and report on leading indicators (platform usage, feature adoption, cross-sell conversion, open-source adoption), and rigorously attribute product usage and these metrics to business outcomes (pipeline, revenue, retention) not just track activity, but prove and quantify its impact.

 

Qualities we look for

  • A builder, first and foremost someone who can build with AI, prototype fast, test with real users, and scale what works. This is a hands-on role, not a strategy-only one.

  • Track record building or scaling a PLG motion that feeds a sales organization ideally with direct experience owning PQL definition and handoff.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management this role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering, and needs to align each of them without owning their roadmaps.

  • Experience growing adoption within a core consumer/prosumer product (web, extension, or app), not just developer-facing surfaces.

  • Experience designing growth loops for feature/product discovery and expansion, not just top-of-funnel acquisition.

  • Experience with open-source community strategy has shipped or grown an OSS project, ideally in ML/AI.

  • Comfortable working in a hybrid PLG + SLG model and operating cross-functionally with teams whose roadmaps this role doesn't own.

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JB1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Senior Integrated Campaign Manager

DeepL · Reporting to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns

About the Role

DeepL's translation portfolio is trusted by well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide. Rather than organizing our go-to-market by product line, we run a single integrated campaign that speaks to the different people who drive adoption of that portfolio organized by persona, not by feature set. As Integrated Campaigns Manager, you will own the persona motion targeting Global Operators, the department heads in Marketing, HR, and Learning & Development who are responsible for how their organizations communicate globally. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically.

This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. You will report to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, Regional Marketing, and RevOps..

What You'll Own

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Translate DeepL's translation capabilities into compelling, pipeline-driving campaigns tailored to how functional leaders operate and buy, educating the market on the value of AI-powered translation for global business communication.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs.

  • Collaborate with Content, Creative, and Regional Marketing teams to produce and localize campaign assets.

  • Maintain a global campaign calendar and asset library, ensuring brand consistency, messaging alignment, and timely deployment across all touchpoints, and coordinate with owners of other persona tracks (e.g., Product/Eng/Dev) so the portfolio campaign reads as one coherent motion.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team to design and execute ABM programs, building tailored campaign strategies, messaging, and content for prioritized accounts and account tiers.

  • Partner with Performance Marketing and RevOps to feed account engagement, pipeline influence, and conversion data back into ABM targeting and strategy decisions.

  • Continuously refine account segmentation and messaging based on engagement signals, win/loss insights, and sales feedback.

.

Measurement & Optimization

  • Drive measurable impact on awareness, adoption, and pipeline; setting and tracking KPIs such as lead quality, conversion rates, account engagement, and ROI.

  • Collaborate with Performance Marketers to initiate data-driven optimization and A/B testing across campaign channels and ABM plays to continuously improve performance.

  • Leverage insights and competitive intelligence to inform campaign strategy, refine positioning, and identify new opportunities in the AI translation market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Foster cross-functional collaboration and campaign excellence, sharing learnings, best practices, and post-mortem analyses to continually improve performance and scalability.

  • Serve as the campaigns subject matter expert, representing campaign and ABM performance in relevant leadership and planning forums.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, campaign management, demand generation, or ABM roles.

  • Proven track record of managing complex, multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution.

  • Understanding account-based marketing programs, including account tiering, personalized content, and multi-touch orchestration alongside Sales.

  • Demonstrated success driving pipeline generation and revenue growth through integrated and account-based campaigns.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Data-driven decision-making and proficiency in campaign analytics, attribution, and performance optimization.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management, particularly with Sales and SDR teams.

  • AI literacy, including familiarity with GenAI tools for campaign planning, content creation, and execution.

  • Preferred: previous experience in high-growth SaaS companies (Series B–IPO stage).

  • Preferred: experience with ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) in addition to core marketing tech.

Technical Requirements - nice to have

  • Marketing Automation: HubSpot

  • CRM: Salesforce (or equivalent)

  • ABM Platform: 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar (preferred)

  • Project Management: Asana, Jira, or similar tools

  • Content Management: Contentful or comparable CMS/DAM platforms

About DeepL

DeepL is Germany's best-known AI company. People and their communication challenges are at the heart of everything we do. Founded by researchers in 2017, we have developed the world's most accurate AI translation and writing technology — serving well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide.

Accessible across the web, browser extensions, desktop and mobile apps, and an API, DeepL supports a best-in-class communication experience across 31+ languages.

 
 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

raw.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

 

Meet the team behind this journey

You will join the Hybrid Platform Engineering track, which builds and operates the compute layer underpinning DeepL's products and research: the Kubernetes control plane, node lifecycle, networking, storage and core cluster services, across both on-prem and cloud infrastructure. Today that spans hybrid infrastructure in Europe - including large on-prem GPU clusters powering DeepL's research and hundreds of on-prem GPU nodes serving production inference - as well as AWS regions across the globe running the product. The track is deepening this hybrid model, unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and AWS to give product and research teams a self-service foundation they can build on.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the reliability, capacity and cost efficiency of DeepL's compute infrastructure, CPU and GPU: the hybrid platform serving our products across AWS and on-prem, and the on-prem clusters powering our research, including their hardware lifecycle

  • Shape the platform's architecture: bring strong technical positions, weigh them on their merits with your peers, and commit to decisions serving the best outcome

  • Design, build and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters across cloud and on-prem infrastructure, taking them from design through to long-term operation

  • Drive the technical work of deepening the hybrid model - unifying how workloads run across on-prem hardware and cloud, especially AWS and supporting research as it adopts cloud-native technology and ways of working

  • Define infrastructure-as-code and platform standards that hold across the track, and strengthen observability and security so the platform's behaviour is legible to the teams that depend on it

  • Mentor engineers across the infrastructure track and raise the technical bar of the group, through design reviews, architecture decisions and the everyday habits that keep the platform maintainable

  • Build consensus across engineering teams and turn it into shipped change, shaping platform direction at track level

  • Lead incident response for hybrid infrastructure, driving remediation through to root cause, and help sustain an on-call rotation the team can carry for the long term

     

What you bring to the table

  • Deep, hands-on Kubernetes expertise: you have designed, built and operated clusters at scale, through their full lifecycle

  • Depth at scale in either public cloud or on-prem infrastructure, plus the credibility to work in the other. AWS experience is preferred, and bare-metal or data centre experience is strongly valued

  • Networking and Linux depth you can debug with: you can follow a problem from a container through the host to the network edge

  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform or equivalent, and GitOps delivery with tooling such as ArgoCD, applied to environments you have owned in production

  • Software engineering skills in at least one major language, Go or Python preferred, at the level of building tooling other engineers rely on

  • A track record of technical ownership spanning several teams: you create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear technical positions, change them on evidence and carry other engineers with you

  • Strong incident-management and reliability-engineering discipline, and the ownership mindset to build more resilient systems

 

You’d get bonus points for

  • GPU infrastructure for training or inference at scale

  • Distributed storage systems in production, such as Ceph

  • Having served researchers or data scientists as platform customers

  • Networking at BGP level in a hybrid or on-prem environment

 

What we offer:

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. raw.description:
London – Junior Consultant, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness
Multiple Start Dates available for Jan-March 2027 Start date
£40,500 + Bonus + benefits. 
 
Ekimetrics is a leader in Marketing Effectiveness, Data Science and AI-powered solutions. We are one of the world’s largest independent analytics and consulting firms, pioneering the use of AI and advanced data science for over 16 years. 
 
Our goal: Combine high-impact AI and data science solutions for long-term sustainable business performance
 
Key figures about Eki
·        400 data science experts globally
·        1000+ diverse projects for more than 350 clients
·        5 offices: Paris, Hong Kong, London, New York & Shanghai
·        $1 billion in profits generated for our clients
·        7000 tons of CO2 prevented by our clients in 2022.
·        UK data company of the year 2023
·        Shortlisted Best STEM company to work for Women 2024
·        Voted Great Place to Work 2023
·        Voted as a leader in “Marketing Measurement and Optimisation” by Forrester Wave 2023.
 
Here in the UK, at our London-based office, we engage across four business offerings: MMM (mixed market modelling), customer analytics, data science transformations, and AI4 sustainability. We have clients across multiple industries such as retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance, banking, private equity, tech partners and many more.
 
About the Role
As a Junior Consultant, this is an exciting opportunity to develop a dual profile – The data scientist and strategic consultant. You will be working on challenging data science projects with international clients across multiple industries, building bespoke marketing analytics solutions to answer our clients’ key questions.
 
What you’ll be doing as a Junior Consultant:
·        Apply econometrics using data science and AI for business problems.
·        Understand clients’ business context and collaborate in a fast-paced environment.
·        Work on Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and Customer Analytics projects end-to-end, from gathering and analysing data to building statistical machine learning models and delivering presentations.
·        Work on 1-3 projects across global markets and industries such as retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance, banking, private equity, tech partners and many more.
·        Contribute to Ekimetrics R&D to support the development of new methodologies and build data Engineering/Architecture capabilities in the office.
·        Contribute to Eki.Life culture initiatives, well-being and help drive our CSR commitments
 
This is a great opportunity to join a growing, international pioneer in data science that will empower you to have an immediate impact from the beginning. At Ekimetrics, we thrive on accelerating growth for ambitious individuals. A Junior Consultant can expect to develop significantly in a short period while consistently delivering exceptional, high-quality results for our clients.
 
About You
Ekimetrics is seeking individuals who can wear 2 hats – the data scientist and the strategic consultant. You will most likely be a recent graduate with internship experience or early in your professional career.
 
What you need to succeed:
·        A degree in Data Science, Economics or a similar analytical field (e.g. econometrics, statistics, mathematics, or other quantitative degrees like Engineering, Data Science, etc.)
·        Prior experience (academic or professional) in data analysis/ modelling / advanced analytics or ML.
·        Experience with programming languages such as Python or R - we use Python at Eki.
·        Capacity to work and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.
·        Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
·        Interest in Data and Marketing to make an impact for businesses
·        Ability to work within an inclusive and diverse team to deliver innovative solutions.
·        A passion for joining a small team and a keen interest in personal learning and development.
·        Demonstration of behaviours that support our values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission, and Pleasure.
 Additional Requirements:
·        Must be able to work on-site a minimum of 2 days a week in London, UK (Hybrid)
·        Good sense of humour!
 
Working for Eki
 
Working for Ekimetrics is a lot of fun! Our London team is growing (65+people). We come from all over the world, have varied experiences and passions, and all contribute value to Ekimetrics’ success.
 
As well as an opportunity to join a driven, energetic, and highly innovative team, we also offer the following:
·        Competitive Compensation + individual & company y bonuses
·        Continuous Learning and development opportunities with Eki.Academy, training programs and certifications
·        Hybrid working (Minimum 2 days a week in the office)
·        20 days a year Work from Anywhere
·        25 days annual leave (+ Bank Holidays + additional days for tenure)
·        Private healthcare, life insurance, critical illness cover, and professional wellbeing support services
·        Group pension scheme
·        An emphasis on work-life balance and a strong company culture
·        Eki. Anniversary gifts for every year of service
·        Opportunities to develop a dual profile in data science and strategic consulting.
·        Opportunities for international mobility
·        Cycle to Work Scheme
·        Wellbeing support, Gym and retail discounts & 50% off runners need!
 
At Ekimetrics, we believe our best assets are our people - they are what set us apart and drive our success. We encourage entrepreneurial spirit and innovation. We share what we know with others, and, above all, we love what we do. These sentiments are supported by our company values which serve as pillars in our work and attitude.
 
Follow our Ekimetrics’ values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission and Pleasure.
 
Ekimetrics is an equal opportunities employer committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, creed, religion, nationality, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military veteran status, current employment status, or any other legally protected categories, subject to applicable law.
Interview process
1. Online Hacker rank - May contrain Python coding
2. HR interview
3. Assessment with a consultant
4. Case study Assessment
5. Final interview with a Manager

raw.title: Senior Buyer - Menswear - BROWNS
raw.description:
BROWNS FASHION
Founded in London in 1970, Browns redefined luxury retail, becoming globally renowned for a carefully curated edit of iconic luxury designers and innovative emerging talent. Deeply rooted in our boutique heritage, Browns sets the industry standard through an unwavering commitment to discovery, authenticity, and exceptional product selection.
Our people are central to this mission. We foster individuality, celebrate diverse perspectives, and champion an inclusive, dynamic environment where talent can thrive.
 
LONDON
Our London office is located in Old Street and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events.
 
 
THE ROLE
As Senior Buyer, you will drive the strategic and commercial success of the Men’s RTW and Non-Apparel departments, taking full ownership of category vision, brand portfolio management, and assortment planning. You will lead and empower the buying team, directing seasonal ranges, negotiations, and market appointments. Partnering closely with the Head of Buying, you will not only steer department trade and profitability but also collaborate on cross-business projects, influencing broader commercial strategy. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Buying, Product Selection & Strategy

  • Lead the Menswear seasonal buying strategy across RTW and Non-Apparel/Accessories, ensuring Browns’ assortment remains innovative, highly curated, and commercially impactful.

  • Lead all market appointments, directing product selection, leading complex brand negotiations, and taking full ownership of category decision making.

  • Identify and onboard high conviction emerging Menswear designers, luxury houses, and contemporary brands that align with Browns’ positioning.

  • Secure key Menswear exclusives, capsule collections and limited distribution drops to cement Browns as a destination and priority partner.
