raw.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - support the development of regulation, industry standards, and safe and beneficial development of AI tools.

About the Role

As UK Strategic Engagement & Partnerships Lead, you will develop and deliver OpenAI’s strategic engagement in the United Kingdom, building trusted relationships across government, Parliament, industry, academia and civil society. You will turn shared priorities into partnerships and initiatives that support the responsible development and adoption of AI.

Alongside leading strategic engagement, you will take ownership of select important emerging policy issues in the UK, developing OpenAI’s approach and leading the response in collaboration with UK policy colleagues and relevant global teams.

Your work will combine political strategy, stakeholder engagement and practical delivery. You will shape engagement plans, develop partnerships and coalitions, prepare senior leaders for important meetings and represent OpenAI in public and private forums. You will track outcomes and adapt plans as opportunities and stakeholder priorities evolve.

We are looking for a senior professional with strong political judgement, substantive understanding of technology policy and a record of delivering results through relationships. You will be comfortable moving from long-term strategy to detailed execution, explaining complex issues clearly and bringing external insight into our work.

You will work closely with UK policy colleagues and the wider Global Affairs team, and partner with communications, legal, technical and commercial teams to deliver coherent engagement and credible initiatives.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have deep knowledge of UK government, Parliament and the wider stakeholder landscape, and understand how political priorities shape technology policy and adoption.

  • Can get up to speed quickly on emerging policy issues, exercise sound judgement under uncertainty and lead work from initial analysis through to policy development and delivery.

  • Build trusted relationships across political and institutional boundaries and engage credibly with government, parliamentarians, civil society, industry and researchers.

  • Translate complex AI issues into clear, practical messages and partnership opportunities for different audiences.

  • Are comfortable operating independently while collaborating closely across teams in a fast-moving environment.

  • Are passionate about the promise of technology and the future of artificial intelligence but thoughtful about its potential risks.

We're looking for a blend of:

  • Experience working at the intersection of technology, policy, and politics and translating complex socio-technical issues to diverse audiences.

  • Substantive understanding of AI and technology policy, including the opportunities and risks relevant to UK stakeholders.

  • A record of building credibility and effective relationships with senior stakeholders across the UK’s political, public-sector and wider institutional community.

  • Experience designing and delivering strategic partnerships, with clear objectives, internal alignment, follow-through and demonstrable outcomes.

  • Experience developing advocacy campaigns or coalitions that translate policy priorities into effective engagement and practical results.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including experience briefing senior leaders and representing an organisation in sensitive external discussions.

  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and project management skills.

  • Ability to execute in fast and flexible environments through rapid cycles of analysis, decision, and action.

  • Track record of effectively working with cross-functional teams and aligning a diverse range of internal and external partners.

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Why This Role is Exciting

The Partnerships Manager (EMEA) will lead partner enablement and delivery across EMEA/MENA & APAC acting as Optro's on-the-ground authority for the region. Based in London, this person will set the pace for how partners across these regions are enabled, certified, and supported — building the policies, processes, and solving real delivery challenges that will keep the region running smoothly and independently. You’ll work directly with partners and internal teams to turn strategy into execution—testing, refining, and improving how Optro enables partner success.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting into the Director of Partner Services, this role is designed for an experienced leader who can own the EMEA/MENA/APAC region — setting direction, building policy and process, and making sound decisions independently. As a Partner Services Manager (EMEA), you will support the execution and delivery of Optro’s partner services strategy by owning key partner relationships, enablement initiatives, and delivery outcomes.

Partner Enablement & Delivery Readiness:

  • Execute structured partner enablement training plans aligned to partner maturity and Optro modules

  • Continuous enablement of partners - monthly calls covering new features, methodology and tooling updates

  • Support partners in building and operationalizing Centres of Excellence, driving delivery readiness and scalability

  • Track partner capability development and readiness milestones, escalating risks and gaps proactively

Partner Account Ownership:

  • Act as the day-to-day Partner Services owner for assigned partners

  • Maintain strong partner relationships focused on delivery quality, capability growth, and operational excellence

  • Support partner maturity progression toward greater delivery self-sufficiency

Cross-Functional Execution:

  • Work closely with Sales to ensure opportunities are partner-ready and transition smoothly into delivery

  • Recommend appropriate engagement models based on partner capability, maturity, and deal complexity

  • Collaborate across Sales, Alliances, Solutions, Services, and Product to support partner success

Escalations & Continuous Improvement:

  • Manage partner delivery escalations, conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions

  • Identify recurring delivery challenges and contribute to improvements in enablement, tooling, and operating models

  • Track partner capability development and readiness milestones, escalating risks and gaps proactively

  • Acting as an advisor as needed on partner implementations

Leadership Readiness & Growth:

  • Prepare executive-ready updates on partner performance, risks, and progress toward strategic outcomes

  • Develop expertise in partner services best practices with a growth path toward people leadership

 

Attributes for a Successful Candidate

  • 8+ years related experience, with a minimum of 2 years of Optro Experience working with the Optro Platform or other GRC platforms

  • Experience working with partners in an enterprise software ecosystem (training, escalations, monthly webinar, advisor)

  • Experience advising complex enterprise software implementations

  • Trained across multiple product lines and willingness to learn modules outside current scope

  • Experience working across multifaceted teams to deliver on software implementation engagements

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including comfort presenting to senior audiences

  • Ability to manage ambiguity and operate with autonomy while aligning to a broader strategy

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify root causes and drive cross functional process improvement

  • Strong, leadership judgment — comfortable making decisions independently

Perks (United Kingdom)

  • Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA!

  • Live your best life (LYBL)! $200/mo (USD) for anything that enhances your life

  • Comprehensive employee health coverage

  • Pension scheme with company contributions

  • Competitive compensation & bonus program

  • Generous annual leave of 25 days plus bank holidays

  • Time off for your birthday & volunteering

  • Employee resource groups

  • Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers!

*perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Our Company Values

  • Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset.

  • Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.

  • Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.

  • Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.

  • Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve.

raw.description:
Role overview:

As the Senior Marketing Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing Oviva's B2B content marketing strategy to drive NHS GP referrals, raise brand awareness and support business growth. You will create compelling, evidence-based content across multiple channels, work on the Oviva website and its SEO performance, own the patient testimonials workstream and lead the coordination of our in-person events. Working closely with the Marketing Lead, you will ensure all content is aligned to Oviva's brand, mission, and audience needs.

Job requirements

Essential:

  • Proven experience (3+ years) in B2B and content marketing within the healthcare sector.

  • Strong copywriting and content creation skills across multiple formats (email, blogs, case studies, web pages).

  • Experience planning and managing events, including conferences, stands, and sponsorship.

  • Hands-on experience managing websites using WordPress (or a similar CMS), with working knowledge of SEO best practices.

  • Experience producing or managing podcast and/or video content, or similar.

  • Data-driven mindset with experience analysing campaign performance and translating insights into strategy.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working across clinical, product, and commercial teams, as well as external agencies

Desirable:

  • Experience working with the NHS including GP Networks and PCNs.

  • Familiarity with lead generation strategies and marketing automation best practices

  • Experience using email marketing platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud (or similar).

Job responsibilities

Content Strategy & Execution

  • Design, develop, and deliver creative content strategies for B2B marketing campaigns that align with Oviva's annual goals and audience needs.

  • Create high-quality, impactful content across multiple formats, including email campaigns, blog posts, case studies, and web pages.

  • Repurpose and adapt content across channels and formats (including AI-assisted workflows) to maximise reach and efficiency.

Website & SEO

• Maintain the Oviva website via WordPress, including landing pages, content updates and UX improvements.

• Develop the B2B SEO strategy (keyword research, on-page optimisation, technical basics) to grow organic search traffic and inbound enquiries.

Event Organisation

  • Lead the end-to-end organisation of industry conferences, including identification of sponsorship opportunities, merchandise, stand design and staffing coordination.

Podcast & Video

  • Manage the filming and production of patient stories for Oviva's social media channels and website, and work on ur GP-facing podcast series - developing future episodes, identifying opportunities to grow the format, and shaping the distribution strategy to maximise reach across relevant channels.

Collaboration and Brand Alignment:

  • Partner with the clinical, product and service engagement teams to ensure all content aligns with Oviva's messaging and brand guidelines, and meets the needs of the target audience.

Performance Analysis:

  • Track SEO metrics and other key marketing indicators to generate insights that inform strategic decision-making.

Industry Awareness:

  • Stay updated on trends and best practices in B2B marketing and content creation within healthcare and technology sectors, leveraging this knowledge to refine Oviva's strategies, ensure content relevance, and drive innovative approaches to engagement and lead generation..

Job benefits

  • A mission-driven environment focused on making a real-world impact.

  • High-growth opportunities with a clear path to broader strategic leadership.

  • A flexible remote/hybrid work culture across the UK, Germany, Switzerland and Poland.

  • Annual learning & development budget.

  • Home working allowance and flexible working hours.

  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and inclusive policies (enhanced leave, etc.)

Having a culture that people want to work in, is very important to us. We do this by keeping our values at the forefront of everything we do:
We put the patient first. We empower our teams. We make it happen.

Oviva is passionate about creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diverse voices and perspectives. We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities.

A note on our process: As part of our pre-screening, you may be invited to a short AI interview. Prefer to start with a conversation with one of our recruiters instead? No problem, just let us know in your reply to the invitation email.

Ready to help shape the future of digital healthcare? Apply today.

Employee Relations Advisor - (Contract)
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

 

The Role
We’re scaling rapidly, and as we expand our reach, launch new products, and enter new markets, we need to stay sharp, scalable, and human. That’s where you come in.

We are introducing a newly created People Advisor role on a Fixed-Term Contract. This isn't just about managing a queue of cases; it's a unique project to build a legacy.

We want you to harness modern systems and AI to revolutionize how we manage employee relations, uncover casework insights, and proactively empower our business leaders.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has the curiosity to pioneer AI-driven ways of working, and brings deep experience handling complex, international ER cases.

You'll collaborate closely with our People team across the UK, Barcelona, and Boston. If you want to lead a high-impact project that will meaningfully elevate our people and performance, we’d love to meet you!


What you’ll do

  • Develop and implement next-generation ways of working, utilizing AI integration to streamline case management, data analysis, and manager enablement.

  • Act as a trusted co-pilot to our leaders, empowering them to confidently navigate performance, conduct, probation cases, attendance concerns, and policy changes.

  • Maintain flawless, compliant documentation while providing high-quality, human-centric support that ensures our policies are applied consistently across the region.

  • Transform raw data into strategic insights, highlighting trends and early warning signs so we can intervene proactively rather than reactively.

  • Drive ER cases from open to resolution with exceptional efficiency, minimizing timelines without compromising on care or compliance.

  • Partner seamlessly with the wider People Team and business units to ensure smooth, aligned delivery of all ER matters.

 

What you’ll bring

  • A forward-thinking mindset and tech proficiency: Practical experience using AI tools to drive efficiency, enabling you to successfully embed modern workflows into our daily casework.

  • Exceptional judgement and coaching skills: The ability to balance structured case processes with human nuance, providing co-pilot support that leaves managers feeling confident and empowered.

  • Deep ER expertise and pace: Strong, hands-on experience navigating complex ER, performance, and conduct cases across the UK and Europe, ensuring matters progress swiftly with noticeable reductions in delays.

  • Strategic partnership and data utilization: The ability to build deeply integrated, trusted partnerships across the business, using clear, reliable case data to support planning and mitigate risks.

  • Relentless attention to detail: A highly organized approach guaranteeing an impeccable standard of documentation accuracy and regional compliance.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

12-month fixed-term contract | Global Revenue Systems and AI Team |


About the Role

Our reps spend most of their day in Salesforce, and how it feels to use directly affects how much they sell. We're hiring a Salesforce Developer with a UI/UX focus to redesign the rep experience across our Sales and Revenue teams. You'll join the global Salesforce team for 12 months to make the CRM faster, clearer and more intuitive.

This is a hands-on build role. You'll design the experience and code it in Lightning Web Components, working with Sales, RevOps, Marketing and Data, and directly with the reps who use the result.


What You Will Do


Redesign the rep experience

  • Audit the current Lightning experience (record pages, console apps, list views, home pages) and find where reps lose time to clicks, clutter and missing context.

  • Turn what you find into a prioritised roadmap of UI improvements tied to rep productivity and adoption.

  • Design and prototype improved layouts, workflows and components, and validate them with reps before building.

Build with LWC

  • Develop custom Lightning Web Components (and supporting Apex where needed) that replace clunky standard layouts with focused, usable interfaces.

  • Configure and extend Lightning App Builder pages, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic Actions and console apps to deliver a consistent experience across teams and regions.

  • Build reusable components and follow SLDS conventions so the UI stays consistent and maintainable after your contract ends.

Make it stick

  • Run feedback sessions, usability tests and pilots with reps and managers, and iterate on the results.

  • Track adoption, page performance and user satisfaction to show what each release changed.

  • You've built a high-performing, trusted data organisation that delivers measurable value across the business so all functions use and trust the data to shape decisions, inform strategy and change how we work, well beyond reporting.

  • Your teams operate with clear priorities, solid infrastructure and real ownership, and what they ship is core to our business and our success.

  • Lead and influence, partner with executive leaders to shape the questions and drive the decisions that matter most.

What you'll bring

  • Proven scale-up leadership. You've led data organisations in high-growth tech or SaaS, and you've built this muscle before.

  • Leader of leaders. You've scaled organisations of 40 or more through senior leaders, coached leaders of leaders and hired top talent.

  • Technical excellence and innovation. A data science background combined with analytics and data engineering, and the depth to push what's possible in any direction.

  • Executive leadership. You've owned a data strategy and budget at executive level, made the big build, buy and invest calls, and helped set company direction alongside senior leadership.

  • Modern stack fluency. Fluency across the modern data stack, such as dbt, Snowflake, conversational analytics and Looker or Tableau, plus the instinct to build your own tooling where it gives us an edge.

  • Trust by design. Deep understanding of data privacy, governance and compliance, including GDPR.

  • Partnership at every level. Proven trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Finance and Operations, and the communication skills to influence at the most senior levels and drive alignment.

  • Big picture and fine detail. You move comfortably between company-level strategy and hands-on specifics.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

raw.description:
We are seeking an Chief Platform Architect in our CO, MN, or UK locations.
 
As the Chief Platform Architect for the Quantum Software Developer Platform, you will act as the technical authority for the design Quantinuum’s developer platform: access portals for quantum computers, hybrid work-flow orchestration, tooling access, documentation, and security. You will work with other leaders on hardware-software co-design efforts, ensuring our platform is scalable and enabling of our quantum processors. You will mentor senior engineers, ensure excellent coding standards, and help define and execute on the technical roadmap to translate business needs into robust, production-ready systems.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own the design and specifications of a high-performance developer platform.
  • Refine quantum computer access API and web portal architecture for performance, scalability and multi-region operation
  • Transform web portal into an application development and delivery framework by leveraging cloud-based hybrid workflow engine and reusable quantum/classical application components
  • Define standard interfaces for hosting application components and building applications by both internal and external developers
  • Ensure the security and reliability of the platform as it scales up
  • Deliver customizable cloud-based hybrid applications to end users
  • Work across the business to help define and maintain the technology roadmap, translating business goals into technical requirements and evaluating new technologies.
  • Foster a culture of excellence by establishing best coding practices, performing architectural reviews, and mentoring senior software engineers.

    • YOU MUST HAVE:
  • 25+ years in software engineering, with at least 5+ years in a senior architect or lead role, specifically within developer platforms.

    • WE VALUE:
  • Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native solutions.
  • Expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, developer portals (e.g., Backstage), and observability tools.
  • Demonstrated success in designing large-scale software systems
  • Proven ability to lead architectural work for large-scale projects and influence teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s or PhD preferred.
    Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior experience in the design and architecture of developer platforms
  • Experience in building platform engineering teams from the ground up.
  • Background in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  • Record of publication or patents in quantum computing.

    • Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing. 

    Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world's leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master's or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore. 

    By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible.

    What’s in it for you?

    We believe our people are our greatest strength and offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your professional growth, well-being, and long-term success.

    • Competitive compensation and the opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology
    • Flexible work arrangements that support work-life balance
    • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match and student loan repayment benefit
    • Equity opportunities
    • Generous paid time off, sick leave, and 12 paid holidays annually
    • Paid parental leave
    • Employee discount programs 

    Equal Opportunity Employer

    Quantinuum is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, ancestry, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values—empathy, accountability, clarity, and growth—guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com

About the Role:

Sitecore is seeking a dynamic and results-driven Field Marketing Manager to lead Net New demand generation for Digital Asset Management (DAM) across EMEA. This role will build market awareness, create qualified pipeline, and accelerate new customer acquisition through integrated field marketing aligned with regional go-to-market priorities.

You will develop and execute multi-channel programs that bring the DAM value proposition to target accounts and priority industries. Working closely with the DAM team, regional sales, business development, product marketing, and campaigns, you will turn audience and market insight into measurable pipeline. The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, commercially minded, data-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

What You Will Do:

Strategy & Planning

  • Define and execute the Net New DAM demand generation strategy for EMEA, aligned with regional GTM, account priorities, and growth objectives

  • Build integrated field marketing plans that increase DAM awareness, engage buying groups, and convert priority accounts

Pipeline Generation

  • Deliver qualified DAM pipeline targets alongside regional sales leadership, business development, and the DAM team

  • Use account, intent, and market data to identify high-potential audiences, industries, and buying signals across EMEA

Field Marketing Programs

  • Design and deliver high-impact regional programs aligned with sales priorities, target account needs, and local market opportunities

  • Create connected journeys across events, digital activation, executive engagement, and sales follow-up to move accounts through the funnel

Campaign Execution

  • Localize and activate global DAM campaigns, adapting the value proposition, messaging, content, and tactics for EMEA audiences

  • Own the execution of field events, webinars, executive programs, and digital campaigns that support Net New DAM acquisition

Performance & Optimization

  • Track and report campaign engagement, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, and ROI using agreed dashboards and reporting frameworks

  • Continuously optimize audience, channel, content, and investment decisions based on performance data and stakeholder feedback

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Collaborate with the DAM team, Corporate Marketing, Product Marketing, Regional Sales, Business Development, and Sales Enablement to align plans and resources

  • Act as a trusted marketing advisor to sales teams, equipping them with DAM messaging, campaign plays, and timely follow-up guidance

What You Need to Succeed:

  • A minimum of 5 years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in SaaS, enterprise software, digital experience, content operations, or DAM

  • Proven success in field marketing with responsibility for Net New pipeline creation across multiple EMEA markets

  • Strong understanding of account-based marketing, buying groups, intent data, demand generation, and funnel acceleration

  • Experience designing and executing integrated field programs that engage target accounts and accelerate pipeline; DAM or content technology experience is advantageous

  • Excellent communication, program management, and stakeholder management skills across regional and global teams

  • Proficiency in marketing automation, CRM, account intelligence, and analytics platforms

  • Fluent in English; additional European languages and experience marketing across diverse EMEA markets are a plus

Equal Opportunities at Sitecore

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.

raw.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
raw.description:
Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets is a prediction market exchange for sports and political trading, having handled over $50 billion in volume since 2010. We're upending sports betting with the fairest prices, the best technology, and a superior customer experience, powered by attracting great people and building a high-performance environment where they thrive. We're looking for an atypical candidate with strong regulated-business experience to support our growing CFTC business.

The Team

Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely.

About the Role:

This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need.

What you will do:

  • Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams.

  • Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products.

  • Automate as Code: Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and infrastructure-as-code checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down frequent shipping.

  • Assess & Remediate: Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams, and be hands-on in implementing those recommendations.

  • Monitor & Respond: Monitor and analyse system access logs, flag anomalies, and support incident response, containment, and post-incident root cause analysis.

  • Plan for Resilience: Plan and test security backups and disaster recovery processes to keep the platform resilient.

  • Maintain Compliance: Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and controls meeting DCM/DCO requirements, and maintain evidence and documentation to support regulatory examinations and audits.

  • Partner Across Teams: Partner with business and engineering teams on solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences.

  • Champion Ownership: Build a culture of security ownership among engineers, acting as a security partner rather than a gatekeeper.

Role Requirements:

  • Security Engineering Background: Hands-on experience building security engineering/DevSecOps capabilities in a cloud-native, high-growth environment, ideally financial services or exchange infrastructure.

  • Confident Communicator: Comfortable communicating security risk, controls and technical decisions verbally and in writing to external stakeholders such as auditors or regulators.

  • Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with CFTC system safeguards expectations, including 17 C.F.R. § 38.1051 and § 39.18 or similar regulatory requirements.

  • AppSec Foundations: Strong grasp of application security principles (OWASP Top 10, NIST) and secure SDLC practices.

  • CI/CD & Tooling: Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI) and security tools (Snyk, Aqua, Trivy, Checkov, Twistlock, Clair).

  • Cloud & Container Security: Hands-on expertise securing AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, containers, and IaC.

  • Compliance as Code: Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and compliance-as-code practices.

  • Automation Proficiency: Proficiency in at least one of Python, Bash, or Go, with a track record of automating security processes.

raw.title: Associate Implementation Consultant
raw.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary

Snyk is hiring an Associate Implementation Consultant to help enterprise customers get started with the Snyk platform after the sale. You will support and deliver onboarding engagements, working with customer development and security teams to configure Snyk across their SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. This is an early-career role for someone with a technical foundation who wants to build a career in customer-facing application security, with hands-on work from your first weeks and structured coaching from experienced consultants along the way.

About the Team

The Customer Solutions team owns the technical success of Snyk's customers after the deal closes, from first onboarding session through full platform adoption. Implementation Consultants work alongside Technical Success, Support, Sales, and Product to turn a customer's security goals into a deployed, measurable program. As Snyk's install base continues to grow, this team is expanding to keep delivering a world-class onboarding experience at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver onboarding engagements for customers with well-defined requirements, following Snyk's onboarding methodology from kick-off through closure.

  • Support senior consultants on larger and more complex implementations, taking ownership of defined workstreams and learning how enterprise rollouts are planned and run.

  • Configure and integrate the Snyk platform with customer source control, CI/CD, container, and cloud environments, working from documented procedures and escalating questions early.

  • Join customer kick-offs, working sessions, and status reviews, and keep customer contacts informed on progress and next steps.

  • Answer customer questions about how Snyk works, and bring in senior consultants, Support, or Product when an issue needs deeper expertise.

  • Keep accurate project plans, notes, and handoff documentation so every engagement is easy for others to pick up.

  • Use Snyk's onboarding playbooks and templates, and suggest improvements when you find gaps.

  • Troubleshoot common integration and configuration issues, and document what you learn for the rest of the team.

  • Help customer teams understand developer-first security practices so they keep using Snyk after onboarding ends.

  • Build your skills through regular coaching, shadowing, and Snyk's technical training and certification programs.

What you’ll bring

  • 1+ years in technical consulting, professional services, technical support, or another customer-facing technical role, or equivalent hands-on experience such as an internship or relevant projects.

  • Foundational knowledge of the SDLC and modern DevOps practices, and curiosity about where security fits into both.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps tooling (for example Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes), with the motivation to go deeper.

  • Ability to manage your own tasks and deadlines across more than one customer project, with support from your team.

  • The ability to explain technical topics clearly to developers and other technical contacts, in writing and in conversation.

  • Genuine interest in application security and belief that a developer-first approach is the right way to solve it.

  • A collaborative, customer-first approach and a willingness to ask questions, take feedback, and learn quickly.

  • Working fluency with AI-assisted tools (Claude, Gemini, or similar) and comfort with how AI-generated code is changing what customers need to secure.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, plus an organized approach to problem solving.

  • Nice to have: basic proficiency in a scripting language such as Python, JavaScript, or another modern language.

  • Nice to have: prior experience in a support, solutions engineering, or technical account role for AppSec, CI, or DevSecOps products.

  • Nice to have: a security certification such as Security+, CSSLP, or CEH.

  • Nice to have: a Project Management Professional (PMP) or CAPM certification, or equivalent project management coursework.

  • Nice to have: a Computer Science degree or equivalent programming background, and exposure to enterprise-scale web technologies and microservices.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description

Sonar is scaling its go-to-market engine across Sales, Customer Success, and post-sales teams in every region. As the company grows, the field needs operating changes that are consistent, measurable, and adopted, not a collection of regional fixes. This role exists to design, land, and measure those changes.

As Director, Global Field Operations, you will sit in Revenue Operations as an individual contributor at Principal level, dedicated 100% to global field operations initiatives. You will not carry a regional support remit. You will own the portfolio of initiatives that change how the global field plans, sells, forecasts, and retains customers, from problem definition through rollout to measured business impact. You will be judged on outcomes such as conversion, pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, productivity, and retention, not on the volume of activity delivered.

  • Build and run change plans: stakeholder mapping, communication cadence, interlock with enablement, adoption tracking, and feedback loops. Explain the why behind each change in the language of the audience, from reps and front-line managers to the CRO and ELT.

  • Stay close to the field through deal reviews, pipeline inspection, and field sessions. Collect feedback continuously, adapt the approach quickly, and close the loop with the people who gave it.

  • Align Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Enablement, Finance, and Systems on priorities, sequencing, and ownership, often without direct authority. Balance regional needs against global standards.

  • Standardise global processes and operating cadence (forecast, pipeline inspection, QBRs) for scalability and repeatability.

raw.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
raw.description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries.
 
In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features that span both product and business teams. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
 
At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

What You'll Do
  • Develop data-driven strategies to support the growth of Spotify’s active users and subscribers 
  • Create and communicate impactful findings and recommendations that improve the Premium product
  • Model and forecast the impact of new business initiatives
  • Work closely with business partners to understand the changes they are driving and help them discover new opportunities for growth
  • Analyze experiments (A/B tests; quasi-experiments) to measure the impact of new features and go-to-market initiatives
  • Present your findings to senior leaders, influencing the course of our business

    • Who You Are
  • You have 5+ years of professional experience in data science or analytics, ideally at a consumer tech company or top-tier consulting firm.
  • You are fluent in SQL and Python or R, and have a strong grasp of statistical methods and causal inference. Direct experience with product analytics or experimentation is a plus.
  • You enjoy partnering with a range of cross-functional stakeholders and working on varied projects involving different products and problem spaces.
  • You have a strategic mindset and an eye for cleanly extracting the “so what” from complex, technical analyses.
  • You are an excellent communicator adept at presenting to senior leadership and audiences of varying levels of technical knowledge.
  • You are comfortable working through ambiguous, complex problems and don’t get discouraged when the path forward isn’t immediately clear.
  • You hold at least a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

raw.title: Data Scientist, Company Planning & Execution
raw.description:
How does a company with thousands of people building hundreds of products stay focused on what matters most? That's the question the Company Planning and Execution (CPE) team works on every day. We design the systems, processes, and insights that help Spotify plan, prioritise, and deliver at scale.

As a Data Scientist on CPE, you'll sit at the intersection of data, strategy, and operations. You'll bring clarity to complex questions by turning operational and strategic information into clear stories, recommendations, and decision frameworks that help leaders and teams act faster and smarter. You'll also explore how AI and automation can change the way people access insights and make decisions.

You'll work closely with data scientists, engineers, PMs, and business partners across the company to help refine how Spotify executes at scale. If you like making sense of ambiguity, care about how organisations work, and want your analysis to shape real decisions, this is the role.


What You'll Do
  • Formulate hypotheses related to how Spotify plans and delivers, and communicate insights effectively to a range of audiences.
  • Apply analytical techniques — including statistical models and machine learning — to identify trends and generate insights that improve how we work.
  • Build and maintain the data models, pipelines, and dashboards that provide visibility into how Spotify plans and executes.
  • Develop structured narratives and recommendations — not just charts, but the "why" and "so what" — in our semi-annual Planning and Execution Insight reports and recurring briefings.
  • Explore how AI and automation can make insights faster to produce and easier to access across the company.

    • Who You Are
  • Curious about how organisations work — not just the data, but the decisions and systems behind it.
  • 5+ years of experience with a quantitative background in science, economics, engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and comfortable working with multiple stakeholders across levels and functions.
  • Able to take messy, complex datasets and turn them into clear recommendations and stories that land with non-technical audiences.
  • Proficient in SQL and Python, comfortable in BigQuery, and experienced with tools like dbt, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Experience with operational or work management data is a plus.

raw.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
raw.description:
At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.

Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention.

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions.

Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.


What You'll Do
  • Lead multi-week ML initiatives end to end, from translating business requirements into technical specifications to shipping models and measuring their impact on subscriber metrics
  • Own components of our ML systems, making independent technical trade-offs and keeping them observable, reliable, and well documented
  • Collaborate with a multi-functional agile team spanning user research, design, data science, product management, and engineering to build new product features that advance our mission to connect artists and fans in personalised and relevant ways
  • Prototype new approaches and productionise solutions at scale for our hundreds of millions of active users
  • Help drive optimisation, testing, and tooling to improve quality
  • Unblock and share context with your teammates to raise the whole squad's velocity
  • Use AI-assisted engineering to move faster and remove repetitive toil, while owning the quality of everything you ship
  • Partner closely with senior and staff ML engineers, and be part of an active group of machine learning practitioners in your mission and across Spotify

    • Who You Are
  • You have experience building and shipping production ML systems
  • You have a strong background in machine learning, theory, and practice
  • You are comfortable explaining the intuition and assumptions behind ML concepts
  • You can own well-scoped ML projects end to end and make sound technical decisions independently
  • You communicate clearly with stakeholders and can explain the reasoning behind your technical choices
  • You are curious, open to feedback, and keen to grow your scope over time
  • You have hands-on experience implementing and maintaining production ML systems in Python, Scala, or similar languages, including model development with PyTorch
  • You are experienced with building data pipelines, and you are self-sufficient in getting the data you need to build and evaluate your models
  • You preferably have experience with cloud platforms like GCP or AWS
  • You care about agile software processes, data development, reliability, and focused experimentation
  • You have a desire to drive business impact

    • Where You'll Be

raw.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Core Experience team builds the foundations that make Spotify feel connected, intuitive, and consistent wherever people listen. From Playlists to shared product capabilities, we help teams across Spotify create experiences that millions of listeners use every day.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape the future of these platforms. You'll set product direction, bring teams together around shared priorities, and help create the capabilities that make great listening experiences possible at scale. This is an opportunity to influence how Spotify's products evolve while making a meaningful impact on listeners and creators around the world.


What You’ll Do
  • Partner with engineering leaders to explore technical solutions, evaluate trade-offs, and guide decisions that improve product performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Develop shared platform capabilities that help teams build consistent, high-quality experiences across Spotify.
  • Improve the adoption and long-term value of platform capabilities by gathering feedback, measuring outcomes, and supporting teams that use them.
  • Balance new product opportunities with technical improvements, including system performance, quality, simplification, and platform migrations.
  • Use experimentation, prototypes, technical exploration, and feedback to test ideas, learn quickly, and adapt your approach.
  • Build alignment across teams by communicating priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly, helping partners work toward shared outcomes.

  • You understand client and backend technologies and can work with engineers to connect technical decisions to user needs and business outcomes.
  • You're familiar with mobile development for iOS or Android, including areas such as app performance, reliability, user interface architecture, or design systems.

raw.title: Product Manager - Customer Service Platform
raw.description:
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify’s subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

Spotify's Customer Service Platform powers interactions between our users and support teams. As a Product Manager, you will shape the tools, channels, and foundational APIs that enable our advisors to deliver fast, effective, and empathetic support at scale.

You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.

 

What You'll Do
  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the tools our support advisors use every day, improving efficiency and enabling better outcomes for users.
  • Define and evolve how customers access support across chat, email, social messaging, and emerging channels, helping the right contact reach the right advisor at the right time.
  • Strengthen the foundational API layer connecting our support systems, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and developer experience as the platform scales.
  • Take initiatives from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering to ship iteratively, learn quickly, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to thoughtfully apply AI and automation within advisor workflows and channel routing to improve speed, accuracy, and the advisor experience.
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and customer service operations to build scalable capabilities that serve both advisors and users.
  • Define meaningful success metrics, run experiments, and use data and customer insights to make clear prioritisation decisions and measure impact.

Who You Are
  • You have 4+ years of product management experience and a track record of delivering impactful products in technology-driven environments.

  • You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on API design, system architecture, and technical trade-offs; you don't need to write code, but you can engage confidently in technical conversations.
  • You know how to take products from discovery through delivery, balancing thoughtful product development with the pace needed to learn and make progress.

  • You communicate clearly, can make complex trade-offs understandable, and know how to create alignment across technical and non-technical partners.
  • You use data, experimentation, customer insight, and judgement to make decisions and are comfortable adapting when you learn something new.
  • You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines and care about building products that create meaningful outcomes for customers and the people who support them.

raw.title: Product Manager - Data Platform
raw.description:
Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.

Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.

We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.


What You'll Do

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
raw.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.


What You'll Do
  • Build and run the backend services and data pipelines that ingest, validate and process music deliveries from partners, covering audio, metadata, lyrics and new content types
  • Own large parts of the ingestion pipeline and lead technical work as we add video, richer partner data and other new content
  • Make ingestion more reliable, catch data quality problems at the point of entry, and improve the operational tooling around the pipeline
  • Design and evolve APIs and schemas that other teams depend on, keeping contracts stable and backward compatible
  • Help move validation towards real time and make Silk Road a well-documented, self-serve platform
  • Deliver roadmap work, take part in planning, review code, and share on-call
  • Work with Content Ops, operations tooling teams, partner teams and the product teams that build on our content

    • Who You Are
  • You have strong experience building and operating backend services and data pipelines in production at scale, ideally in Java, Scala or Go
  • You have designed APIs and handled schema evolution and backward compatibility in systems where other teams rely on stable contracts
  • You’re comfortable modelling data for auditability, versioning and efficient querying and  understand the tradeoffs between real-time and batch processing
  • You lead projects from discovery to handover, make sound technical decisions, and mentor others
  • You may have worked with content ingestion, metadata standards such as DDEX, B2B partner integrations, rights or compliance-sensitive data, lyrics or time-synced data, or GCP.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

raw.title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
raw.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.

Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.


What You'll Do
  • Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use.
  • Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints.
  • Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers.
  • Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail.
  • Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap.
  • Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs.
  • Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents.
  • Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning.

    •  


Who You Are
  • You have a strong background in product design, with experience shaping complex digital products and delivering high-quality visual and interaction design.
  • You're comfortable working across strategy and execution, setting a clear product direction while staying close to the details of design and delivery.
  • You can build and ship user interfaces using a modern front-end technology stack, and enjoy bringing your designs into production.
  • You understand how to create cohesive visual experiences across product and brand, with a thoughtful approach to interaction, motion and design systems.
  • You bring an understanding of developer tools, enterprise software or platform products, including the challenges of designing for technical audiences.
  • You use generative AI and agentic tools in your work, applying sound judgement about where they add value and where human expertise matters most.
  • You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, using research, data and customer insights to make informed decisions and solve complex problems.
  • You communicate ideas clearly, build trust across disciplines and influence product decisions through compelling design work and storytelling.
  • You care about helping others grow, welcome different perspectives and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment where great work can happen.

Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

· Capture lessons learned and improve future designs, standards and operational performance.

· Lead and develop a small regional specialist team, balancing resources and priorities across projects and supporting recruitment and succession planning.

· Work closely with engineering, construction, commissioning, operations, commercial and global technical teams; build supplier relationships and report risks and technical performance to senior leaders.

What You’ll Bring

· Experience establishing technical standards, control philosophies and repeatable engineering solutions, alongside the judgement to balance strategy with practical delivery.

· Deep technical expertise in BMS, PLCs, DDC controllers, SCADA, controls logic, sequences of operation and system integration.

· Knowledge of BMS architecture, networks, resilience, cybersecurity, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA and relevant communications protocols.

· Experience with functional testing, failure scenario validation, alarm management, trending and operational performance optimisation; familiarity with ASHRAE, EN 50600, IEC and applicable local standards.

· Proven ability to lead specialist teams and contractors across locations, solve complex technical problems and influence senior stakeholders with sound commercial judgement.

· A degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Controls, Automation, Mechatronics or a related field, or substantial equivalent practical experience. Professional accreditation or relevant certifications are advantageous.

What We Offer
