raw.description:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Principal Engineer, Data Quality Platform

You'll own data correctness across Talos. You'll lead the data quality engineering team, run BAU data operations, and own reference and security master data, along with the pipelines and platform that deliver it.

Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does.

You'll join a small team with the mandate to work independently from product engineering and challenge it. Engineering teams make assumptions about how their systems behave. Your job is to test those assumptions and prove or disprove them with evidence.

 

Responsibilities

  • Lead AI-first data quality engineering

  • Validate every client-facing endpoint continuously. The focus is our REST and WebSocket APIs. Cloud delivery (S3, Snowflake, Databricks) is also in scope. Assert correctness against independent sources of truth, across every environment and client entitlement.

  • Cover streaming as well as request/response. For WebSocket, that means:

  • sequencing and gap detection

  • snapshot-to-increment consistency

  • reconnect and replay correctness

  • staleness of live subscriptions

  • agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state

  • Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts.

  • Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool.

  • Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests.

  • When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier.

  • Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client rate and false-positive rate.

  • Run data governance

  • Build and maintain a catalog of our data assets and APIs, covering lineage and downstream consumers. Maintain an understanding of assets, how they're used and what breaks when they change.

  • Own data governance tooling such as OpenMetadata.

  • Own reference and security master data

  • Lead the build-out of the next-generation security master platform, then run it day to day: new listings, symbol mapping across venues, and increment and contract specs.

  • Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback.

  • Expand coverage across the firm

  • Over time, extend data quality coverage beyond client APIs to:

  • trade signals

  • pre-trade analytics

  • client post-trade analysis

  • PMS analytics

Qualifications

  • A track record of leading data QA or data quality teams, preferably on market data or other high-throughput, real-time data.

  • A deep understanding of streaming and API behaviour: throughput, WebSocket semantics, ordering, recovery and failure modes.

  • Experience inventorying and testing a large API and data surface end to end.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance: cataloging, lineage, ownership.

  • Experience with performance and load testing of distributed systems.

  • A strong engineering background. You design platforms, not scripts on a cron job, and you build on shared infrastructure rather than creating one-off tooling.

  • Practical experience applying LLM and agentic tooling to engineering problems.

  • Our stack: Flink, Doris, Dagster and Spark, plus OpenMetadata (or an equivalent such as Apache Atlas). Experience with comparable tools is just as relevant.

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

  • Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW

  • Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan

  • Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More

  • Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions

  • Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024

  • Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • Retirement plan contributions

  • Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus.

  • Yearly discretionary cash bonus

  • Employee stock options plan

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid parental leave for 20 weeks, after 1 year of service

  • Global offsites and team outings

  • A one-time stipend towards at-home office set-up for all employees

  • A wellness credit of $50 accrued monthly, to go towards things like gym memberships, ski-passes, and work out classes.

  • A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

  • Donation matching up to $100 USD annually

  • Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and consistently outperforms goals. Prior experience in building and scaling platform integrations is essential. Existing platform-specific industry knowledge and network are a valuable bonus.

 

What you’ll do

  • Be the technical owner throughout the partner integration lifecycle, including technical discovery with partner, selection and SOW process for System Integrators for building new integrations, and technical project management.

  • Be the interface between partnerships and product/engineering teams, both internally and externally.

  • Provide subject matter expertise on platforms for merchants, assist merchant RFPs and technical questions wherever platforms are relevant, and be the escalation point for routing issues to partner technical contacts

  • Provide input to partnership and product teams on technology trends, integration gaps, future features and platform product roadmaps.

  • Technical evangelist for platform partners internally and externally.

  • Build integrations into tech stacks, including APIs.

  • Run debugging and UAT testing, as well as reviewing code.Act as the core technical owner throughout the partner integration lifecycle, encompassing technical discovery, selection of System Integrators, drafting Statements of Work (SOWs) for new integrations, and technical project management.

 

Qualifications

  • 8+ Years experience in a Solutions Engineering, Partner Engineering, Implementation Engineering or similar role (payments industry a bonus).

  • Knowledge / experience working with eCommerce platforms, subscription management platforms, and ERPs.

  • Highly familiar with API-based integration methods.

  • Development experience in frontend and backend web technologies, such as JavaScript, PHP, C# or others.

  • DevOps experience from a technical and customer solutions point of view.

  • Strong communicator who can both explain high-level takeaways and drill into technical details with clarity.

  • Confident working closely with product and engineering teams.

  • Highly organised and able to prioritise shifting workloads and responsibilities effectively.

  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fluent in English

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

How you’ll make an impact

  • Own and execute account development plans for a portfolio of strategic merchants.

  • Build high-touch, consultative relationships with merchant stakeholders from day-to-day operators through executive leadership.

  • Serve as the primary commercial and relationship lead during the post-integration lifecycle, ensuring clear ownership, communication, and follow-through.

  • Develop a deep understanding of each merchant’s business model, customer journeys, payment performance, priorities, and growth plans.

  • Identify and advance opportunities across payment volumes, product adoption, market expansion, and broader commercial growth.

  • Lead commercial conversations and negotiations in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and other relevant teams.

  • Translate merchant needs into clear internal priorities and influence product roadmaps, go-to-market motions, and service improvements.

  • Project-manage complex merchant initiatives, including cross-border expansion, new payment methods, optimization programs, and operational improvements.

  • Use data and customer insights to diagnose performance, quantify opportunities, and make compelling recommendations.

  • Provide regular account updates, risk visibility, and forward-looking plans to leadership.

  • Share market feedback and best practices that improve how Checkout.com serves enterprise merchants.

  • 6+ years of experience in B2B Account Management, Relationship Management, Customer Success, Strategic Partnerships, or a related commercial role, ideally in payments, fintech, technology, banking, or consulting.

  • Experience managing complex enterprise accounts and building trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial judgment, including experience identifying growth opportunities and leading or supporting negotiations.

  • A strategic, analytical, and data-driven approach to account planning and decision-making.

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong understanding of digital commerce, payments, fintech, and the competitive dynamics shaping the payments market.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the role

The Partner Engagements Manager, Compliance Strategy will lead Checkout’s external-facing compliance strategy across banking, scheme and other strategic partner relationships.

You will own the operating model and delivery of compliance-related partner engagements, including annual reviews, periodic due diligence, requests for information, licensing and scheme initiatives, and readiness for product or geographic expansion. You will ensure that Checkout presents a consistent, accurate and well-evidenced view of its compliance framework, while converting external expectations into practical improvements to our roadmap, controls, processes and operating model.

The role combines strategic ownership, senior stakeholder management and hands-on delivery. You will lead complex engagements, advise Compliance leadership, build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and develop the partner-engagement capability of the team, including managing and coaching Senior Analyst(s) as the structure is established.

What you will do

  • Own the Compliance Strategy partner-engagement portfolio, prioritising work across banking partners, schemes and other strategic external stakeholders.

  • Establish and continuously improve the operating model for partner engagements, including governance, roles and responsibilities, service standards, evidence expectations, response libraries, escalation routes and management information.

  • Lead annual KYC AML partner compliance reviews, partner onboarding or refreshes, complex RFIs and other material external engagements from planning through to closure.

  • Act as a senior Compliance representative in partner meetings, with high level input around Checkout’s compliance framework, risk management approach, policies, controls, governance and improvement plans with clarity and confidence.

  • Provide oversight and challenge to response packs, control narratives, policy summaries, presentations and supporting evidence, ensuring consistency, accuracy and appropriate ownership.

  • Lead compliance support for scheme, product-launch and geographic-expansion initiatives, ensuring external partner obligations and readiness requirements are identified, tracked and addressed.

  • Translate partner feedback, requests and emerging expectations into strategic recommendations, roadmap priorities, control enhancements and process improvements.

  • Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Technology and regional teams to align delivery and resolve dependencies.

  • Maintain clear governance over engagement risks, issues, decisions, action plans and remediation, escalating material matters to the Head of Compliance Strategy and relevant governance forums.

  • Produce concise and decision-useful updates for Compliance leadership, senior management and governance committees, including themes, trends, risks, commitments and delivery status.

  • Partner with relevant second-line teams to ensure external engagement activity is consistent with the Compliance framework, risk appetite, regulatory obligations and the responsibilities of the three lines of defence.

  • Coach, develop and set clear expectations for Senior Analyst(s).

  • Create and implement a high-quality, scalable and collaborative partner-engagement framework.

  • Identify opportunities to use better data, tooling, workflow design and documentation to improve response quality, reduce duplication and increase the resilience of the Compliance operating model.

As the BDR Academy Lead, you will own the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Checkout.com’s global Revenue Academy. You will turn commercial priorities into a structured, measurable development journey that helps Business Development Representatives (BDRs) build deep product knowledge, master prospecting skills, and apply our proprietary Sales Methodology. Your work will directly impact quality pipeline creation and prepare BDRs to progress into future commercial roles.

The Academy provides a consistent global foundation, tailored to two distinct sales motions: Mid-Tier and Enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

1. Own the BDR Academy End-to-End

  • Partner with BDR and Commercial leadership to establish the Academy’s operating model, annual roadmap, governance, and continuous improvement cycle.

  • Manage the complete learner journey from onboarding to graduation, including cohort planning, communications, milestones, and learner support.

  • Build and maintain a unified global curriculum with clear applications for Mid-Tier and Enterprise motions, balancing global consistency with necessary regional adaptations.

  • Translate field needs into clear learning outcomes, facilitator guides, practical exercises, and reusable assets.

  • Coordinate cohort intake and operational readiness across regional BDR leaders, Sales, People, and Talent Acquisition teams.

  • Deliver learning efficiently using a blend of e-learning, virtual sessions, and in-person training (directly or via regional partners).

2. Drive Capability & Field Application

  • Facilitate engaging blended learning programs: live workshops, practice simulations, call reviews, coaching sessions, and on-the-job application.

  • Earn internal "Train-the-Trainer" certification for the Checkout.com proprietary Sales Methodology.

  • Build BDR expertise across payments, Checkout.com products, discovery and qualification, account research, stakeholder mapping, outreach strategies, and commercial tools (including approved AI tools).

  • Partner with managers to connect training to live BDR workflows, reinforce positive behaviors, and identify capability gaps early.

  • Act as an AI champion, supporting managers in embedding approved AI tools and automated workflows into BDR routines.

3. Maintain Standards, Certification & Progression

  • Define competency standards, rubric-based assessments, and clear certification requirements for the BDR pathway.

  • Lead evidence-based milestone reviews with managers and leaders at key stages (onboarding, probation, and progression gates).

  • Track completion rates, assessment results, and revenue impact; provide transparent data to help managers make informed progression decisions.

  • Prepare BDRs for future commercial roles (e.g., Sales, Account Management) while managing clear performance-based expectations.

4. Measure Impact & Collaborate Globally

  • Track and maintain an Academy Scorecard covering metrics such as onboarding speed, certification rates, pipeline contribution quality, and learner/manager feedback.

  • Analyze cohort performance by region and stage to resolve bottlenecks and optimize delivery.

  • Collaborate with regional teams to ensure local market relevance without compromising global standards.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clear Pathways: BDRs follow a structured, tailored learning journey appropriate for their target market motion (Mid-Tier or Enterprise).

  • Actionable Learning: Coaching and training directly translate into improved live prospecting and pipeline generation.

  • Transparent Growth: Progression decisions are timely, objective, and grounded in clear competency evidence.

  • Measurable Value: Executive leadership receives clear, data-backed insights on cohort health, capability growth, and revenue contribution.

  • Scalable Operations: The Academy scales seamlessly across global regions without losing quality or accountability.

What You Bring

Essential Experience & Qualifications

  • Commercial & Enablement Background: Direct experience in BDR/SDR roles, BDR leadership, Revenue/Sales Enablement, or sales performance program management.

  • Program Architecture: Proven track record of designing, running, or scaling structured sales onboarding or development programs with clear milestones.

  • Instructional Design & Facilitation: Strong expertise in adult learning principles, workshop facilitation, and turning strategic concepts into practical, engaging training.

  • Stakeholder Management: Confidence collaborating with, influencing, and guiding frontline managers and senior commercial leaders.

  • Analytical & Operational Skills: Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics and feedback to evaluate programs and drive continuous improvement.

  • Tech & AI Positive: Comfortable using modern sales engagement platforms, learning technology, and approved AI tools to enhance productivity.

  • Proactive Leadership: Collaborative yet assertive approach—able to operate independently, take full ownership, and advocate for high standards.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

  • Experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or complex B2B technology sectors.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and sales engagement tools.

  • Experience building or administering skills assessments, certification programs, or analytics dashboards.

  • Fluency in additional languages relevant to Checkout.com’s key global markets.

  • Tracking, coordinating, and driving pentest and vulnerability findings through to remediation across engineering teams (ownership, action plans, status, closure)

  • Maintaining the accuracy and hygiene of security data asset inventories, finding trackers, and remediation records

  • Supporting detection deployment and validation, and feeding operational feedback into detection tuning to reduce noise and alert fatigue

  • Assisting with scripting and automation to remove manual toil from recurring operational tasks

  • Producing clear operational reporting and metrics on findings, remediation progress, and tooling health

What we're looking for

  • Practical experience operating modern security tooling SIEM (e.g. Sentinel), Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools, EDR, and vulnerability management platforms

  • Solid understanding of security operations workflows: alert triage, incident handling, and vulnerability/finding remediation lifecycles

  • Comfort with scripting to support automation and tooling (e.g. Python, KQL)

  • Working knowledge of cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure and GCP) and how security operations apply across cloud and SaaS

  • Familiarity with common frameworks and standards such as PCI DSS, NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, and MITRE ATT&CK

  • A pragmatic, ownership-minded operator: methodical, detail-oriented, and focused on getting things fixed rather than just logged

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Checkout.com is looking for an ambitious Senior Engineering Manager to join our Disputes team. Our mission is to build the tools, services, and models that help merchants manage and win disputes at scale - reducing the cost and operational burden of chargebacks while protecting revenue for our merchants and our business.

Disputes sit at the intersection of merchant-facing products, complex scheme and regulatory processes, and data-driven decisioning. Our team owns the full stack, anchored by a .NET back end that manages the dispute lifecycle and integrates with card schemes, alongside the front-end experiences merchants use to track and respond to disputes and the machine learning models that predict outcomes and recommend the best action on every case.

We're building for scale, and that scale brings ambiguity, shifting priorities, and the occasional setback - so we're looking for a resilient leader who has built and sustained high-performing teams, learned from failure, and come back stronger. Above all, you'll be someone who drives predictable delivery and operational efficiency: shipping consistently, running systems reliably, and continuously improving how the team works. The ideal candidate has operated across both enterprise and scale-up environments and has a proven track record of driving growth within large, complex, regulated organisations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a team centred on a .NET back end, with front-end and machine learning components, helping engineers establish and validate their understanding of technical architecture and design end-user-centric systems and tools.

  • Operating in a highly regulated financial space, ensure compliance with a range of control frameworks — from internal stakeholders such as InfoSec and Internal

  • Audit, to external auditors, card schemes, and regulators.

  • Oversee the responsible use of machine learning and AI in dispute decisioning, leading the team to develop the infrastructure, tooling, and governance required to run models safely and at scale in production.

About You

  • A resilient leader who has learned from setbacks and failures and consistently comes back stronger, keeping teams steady and delivering through periods of change and ambiguity.

  • You thrive on pace. You're energised by a high-growth environment, comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, and you keep the team moving and shipping when priorities shift under you.

raw.title: Account Lead - Client Success
raw.description:
Let’s transform banking forever

ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate.

That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure.

 

But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward.

 

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

 

Your mission:

As an Account Lead in our Mid-Market Client Management team focused on Client Success, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining strong, trusted relationships with a portfolio of existing and new clients.

 

You’ll develop a deep understanding of our clients’ businesses, priorities and evolving needs, helping them get the most from their relationship with ClearBank while ensuring we continue to deliver positive client outcomes. You’ll identify opportunities to deepen and grow those relationships through appropriate cross-sell and upsell opportunities, working collaboratively across ClearBank to connect clients with the products and solutions that meet their needs.

 

Key Responsibilities

· Own and develop strong, trusted relationships with existing Mid-Market clients, acting as a key point of contact and developing a detailed understanding of their businesses, priorities and evolving needs.

· Develop and execute client account plans that support successful, long-term relationships and identify opportunities to deepen client engagement.

· Proactively engage clients through regular relationship and account reviews, maintaining an understanding of their performance, priorities, challenges and future plans.

· Identify and progress cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, connecting client needs with relevant ClearBank products and capabilities to support sustainable account growth.

· Build relationships across client organisations, developing effective connections with relevant decision makers and stakeholders and ensuring relationships are not dependent on a single point of contact.

· Act as an advocate for clients internally, bringing together the appropriate teams to address needs, resolve issues and support strong client outcomes.

· Collaborate across Product, Solutions, Operations, Risk, Compliance and other relevant teams to support clients effectively and ensure commitments and issues are progressed appropriately.

· Maintain a strong understanding of the payments landscape and ClearBank’s proposition, using this knowledge to have credible, commercially relevant conversations with clients and identify opportunities that meet their needs.

· Monitor the health and development of client relationships, proactively identifying risks, emerging needs and opportunities for further engagement.

· Support retention and sustainable growth across the existing client portfolio by combining excellent relationship management with appropriate commercial development.

 
 

Skills & Experience (must-have)

· Strong knowledge and practical experience of the payments industry is essential, with the credibility to discuss payments propositions, client requirements and relevant industry developments with senior client stakeholders.

· Proven experience managing and developing existing B2B client relationships, ideally within payments, banking or financial services.

· Demonstrable experience of building trusted, long-term relationships with clients, understanding their objectives and using that insight to improve client outcomes.

· A track record of identifying and successfully progressing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client relationships.

· Strong commercial skills, with the ability to balance client success, relationship retention and account growth.

· Experience conducting structured client and account reviews and translating client needs into clear actions and opportunities.

· Proven stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility with decision makers and senior stakeholders within client organisations.

· Great communication, questioning and presentation skills, including the ability to make complex payments and banking topics clear and relevant for different audiences.

· Problem-solving and judgement, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and maintain client confidence when navigating issues or competing priorities.

· Ability to work collaboratively across multiple internal teams to deliver positive outcomes for clients.

 

Nice-to-have

· Broader knowledge of banking infrastructure and embedded banking.

· Experience working with fintech, financial services or other regulated organisations.

· Experience managing complex client relationships involving multiple products and stakeholder groups.

 

What success looks like in the role

· Clients experience a proactive, trusted and value-adding relationship with ClearBank, supported by a strong understanding of their business and priorities.

· Client relationships are maintained and developed effectively, with risks, issues and changing client needs identified and addressed proactively.

· Appropriate cross-sell and upsell opportunities are identified and progressed based on genuine client needs and commercial value.

· Account plans and client information remain current, providing a clear view of relationship health, priorities, opportunities and agreed actions.

· Strong collaboration across ClearBank supports positive client outcomes and sustainable long-term relationships.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

raw.title: Account Lead Mid-Market
raw.description:
Account Lead, Mid-Market

Let’s transform banking forever

ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate.

That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure.

But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

Your Mission:

You’ll join the Client Management team as an Account Lead for the Mid-Market segment, with a clear focus on winning new clients and accelerating sustainable revenue growth.

You’ll identify and develop high-potential prospects, build a strong and well-qualified pipeline, and lead opportunities through the full business development cycle. Working across ClearBank, you’ll bring together the right expertise to understand prospective clients’ needs, shape compelling solutions and convert opportunities into successful new relationships.

This includes

  • Developing and executing a focused business development plan for the Mid-Market segment, aligned with agreed commercial priorities and target client profiles.

  • Identifying and targeting prospective clients through structured market mapping, research, referrals, networking, industry events and proactive outreach.

  • Building and maintaining a healthy, well-qualified pipeline of new business opportunities, with clear next steps, accurate forecasting and disciplined progression through each stage.

  • Creating and executing account-based prospecting plans for priority organisations, engaging relevant decision-makers and building relationships across the buying group.

  • Leading the end-to-end new business cycle, from initial engagement and discovery through solution development, commercial negotiation and contract completion.

  • Conducting effective discovery to understand each prospect’s strategy, business model, customer needs and commercial priorities, translating these into relevant opportunities for ClearBank.

  • Developing compelling propositions that clearly articulate ClearBank’s value and provide informed perspectives on how prospective clients could achieve their objectives.

  • Collaborating across Product, Solutions, Risk, Compliance, Legal and other relevant teams to assess opportunities, shape viable proposals and progress new business efficiently.

  • Maintaining accurate and timely opportunity information, using pipeline data and market insight to support forecasting, prioritisation and commercial decision-making.

  • Representing ClearBank externally at relevant industry events and forums, using these opportunities to create relationships, generate leads and strengthen the Mid-Market proposition.

What we’re looking for (Skills & Experience)

This role would suit a business development focused professional with a strong record of identifying, developing and converting new client opportunities. You’ll be comfortable creating opportunities rather than relying solely on inbound demand, and able to manage complex sales cycles involving multiple senior stakeholders.

In addition:

  • Demonstrable experience of winning new clients through proactive business development, prospecting and relationship creation.

  • A strong track record of building, qualifying and converting sales pipelines in a complex B2B environment.

  • Experience managing the full new business development cycle, from market mapping and initial outreach through discovery, proposal development, negotiation and close.

  • Ability to develop clear target-client and account plans, prioritising activity according to strategic fit, client need and commercial potential.

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to uncover client challenges and translate them into relevant commercial propositions.

  • Experience building relationships with senior decision makers and navigating multiple stakeholders within prospective client organisations.

  • Strong commercial judgement, including the ability to qualify opportunities, focus effort effectively and balance growth objectives with risk considerations.

  • Clear communication, presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain complex banking or payments propositions in an accessible and compelling way.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Solutions, Risk, Compliance, Legal and operational stakeholders throughout the sales process.

  • Relevant knowledge of banking, payments, fintech or financial services would be advantageous.

What success looks like in the role

  • A strong, credible and well-qualified pipeline is developed and maintained against agreed Mid-Market priorities.

  • Priority prospects are engaged through consistent, targeted and insight-led business development activity.

  • Forecasts and pipeline information are accurate, current and supported by clear evidence and next actions.

  • New client relationships are built on a sound understanding of client needs, commercial value and appropriate consideration of risk.

Ways of working and Culture:

Build Trust Together: Be proactive in identifying and solving issues; take accountability for quality; work collaboratively; make informed decisions and ask questions while learning quickly; raise and resolve issues promptly and appropriately.

Care like we mean it: Challenge respectfully; give and receive feedback with good intent; show understanding and care for colleagues while balancing employee advocacy with business needs; contribute to an inclusive and welcoming environment.

Grow with the challenge: Manage multiple priorities; be adaptable and resilient across teams; develop personally and professionally to help the organisation move forward; aim for customer impact while recognising when “good enough” is acceptable

Succeed as one: Prioritise collective goals; seek diverse perspectives; collaborate beyond personal agendas; disagree constructively and commit once decisions are made.

Clear a bold new path: Challenges legacy approaches to unlock smarter ways of working; Acts with entrepreneurial spirit – moving fast from idea to execution; Sparks fresh thinking through bold exploration; Scales innovation to deliver long-term, sustainable impact.

If this sounds like you, then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

 

*Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. raw.description:
Senior Finance Business Partner, UK Finance

About us:

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

Role Purpose

As Senior Finance Business Partner, you’ll play a key strategic and operational leadership role within our UK Finance team, reporting to the UK CFO.

You’ll provide independent financial oversight and insight across the UK Bank, deputise for the UK CFO when required and connect UK Finance with Group Finance teams. The role combines financial control, regulatory oversight, planning and commercial finance to support effective decision-making and sustainable performance.

This is a visible senior role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial judgement and the confidence to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deputise for the UK CFO, including supporting interactions with the Board and Executive Committee.

  • Lead the relationship between UK Finance and Group Finance, ensuring services meet UK regulatory and operational requirements.

  • Maintain independent oversight of the UK Bank’s financial position, constructively challenging and validating Group Finance outputs.

  • Lead UK financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting.

  • Partner with the UK leadership team on business cases, profitability and strategic decision-making.

  • Support the review of regulatory submissions and the preparation of Board and Executive Committee papers.

  • Monitor compliance with UK regulatory and prudential requirements, escalating risks and control weaknesses appropriately.

  • Improve financial processes and reporting to strengthen clarity, accuracy and timeliness.

  • Act as a trusted adviser to the UK CFO and senior stakeholders, providing clear financial insight and challenge.

  • Contribute financial leadership to strategic initiatives, including growth planning and operational resilience.

Skills & Experience

  • A recognised accountancy qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or an equivalent, with significant post-qualification experience in financial services.

  • Broad finance experience covering financial control, reporting, planning and commercial finance.

  • Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS.

  • Experience of regulatory and prudential requirements, including PRA and FCA frameworks, ICAAP, ILAAP, and recovery and resolution planning.

  • Experience working within a regulated UK banking environment.

  • Strong budgeting, forecasting, performance analysis and business-case development skills.

  • Experience working effectively across a matrix organisation.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage and constructively challenge at Board and Executive level.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and focus on material issues.

  • Sound professional judgement, independence and professional scepticism.

  • A collaborative, outcome-focused approach, with the ability to take ownership, identify risks early and support shared goals.

Ways of Working & Culture

Build Trust Together: Take ownership of outcomes, maintain high standards of integrity and create confidence through reliable delivery and strong controls. Work effectively as part of a small, hands-on team, taking accountability for delivery while helping to improve and scale processes as the Finance function grows.

Care Like We Mean It: Support colleagues, provide constructive challenge and create an environment where people can perform at their best.

Grow With The Challenge: Embrace change, continuously develop expertise and proactively seek opportunities to improve ways of working.

Succeed As One: Work collaboratively across teams and functions, recognising that the best outcomes are achieved together.

Clear A Bold New Path: Challenge existing processes, champion innovation and help build scalable finance capabilities for the future.

raw.title: Head of Legal
raw.description:
Build Conveo's legal function from the ground up, and be the partner our leadership team relies on as we scale.

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~125 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, Balderton, and Visionaries, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We're investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

What We're Building

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer and B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

The Role

As our first Head of Legal, you'll build Conveo's legal function from the ground up. Strategically critical commercial agreements with enterprise clients and reseller partners are coming in, and they require sharp commercial and legal review to protect our revenue lines. You will advise on a broad array of legal topics across commercial, product, IP, employment and corporate matters, with the support of external advisors and tools where appropriate.

This is a partnership role. You'll report to our CFO and work hand in hand with them, with a strong dotted line to our CEO. You'll have full strategic and operational visibility across the organisation and help strike the balance between risk and opportunity. Conveo operates across Europe and the US, so you'll also support our New York team and work across jurisdictions.

You'll lead our legal associate directly and manage our external lawyers. Legal here is both sword and shield for our commercial team. You'll be commercially pragmatic: working with the business, you'll make proportionate risk calls on the deal as a whole, not clause by clause, and you'll be prepared to work at pace. You know that speed and clarity matter, and that sometimes legal rigour is what saves us down the road.

This role is based in our London office, in a hybrid setup (3 days a week in the office expected).

What You'll Do

Own our commercial contracts

  • Review and negotiate our most important client and reseller agreements: MSAs, DPAs, SLAs and order forms, often against enterprise procurement and legal teams

  • Own supplier contract reviews

  • Set fallback positions so deals don't stall, and tell the business clearly when to say no

  • Build templates and playbooks so sales can close standard deals without you

Build the legal function

  • Set up intake, templates, playbooks and a central contract repository

  • Decide what is handled in-house and what goes to external counsel, and keep spend in check

  • Select, brief and manage outside firms across jurisdictions

  • Lead and develop our legal associate, and grow the team as the company scales

Own corporate, people and IP matters

  • Keep corporate housekeeping in order across our entities

  • Work closely with the CFO and corporate counsel on any debt or equity fundraises.

  • Partner with our People team on employment and equity matters across the UK, Belgium, the US, and any new market we enter

  • Protect our IP and work with external counsel to protect our brand

  • Get the company ready for Series B and due diligence

Own the legal side of data privacy and AI

  • Have a say in how we build and use AI in our product, advising product and engineering to remain compliant with the changing landscape of AI regulation.

  • Create and own the data protection and AI terms in our client and supplier contracts, including DPAs and subprocessor terms

  • Develop and help manage our AI Governance across the company.

What Success Looks Like

After 3 months

  • You fully own the legal function

  • You've completed a deep-dive risk review of our contracts and processes, covering commercial, employment and terms and conditions, so we know what is in place and what is not

  • You've put a process in place to step into commercial agreements when needed

  • You have a handle on every open external counsel matter, and you're leading on our longer-standing legal issues

  • You've set up a working framework with our People team

  • You're shaping how legal acts as both sword and shield for our commercial team

  • Depending on when you join, you've started preparing the company for Series B and due diligence

After 6 months

  • We contract with clients in a fundamentally better way, through a new contracting process

  • There's a clear legal intake process across HR, corporate, IP and commercial

  • You have strong working relationships with sales, product, engineering, finance and People, and everyone knows legal is the place to go for any agreement

  • Our legal associate works independently and is growing as a legal professional

  • Our external counsel spend is planned and predictable, with outside advice focused where it adds the most value

What You'll Bring

You're high agency and low ego, self-directing and startup-native. You stay calm with a long backlog, and you're genuinely interested in AI tools. You'll also bring:

  • 10+ years qualified in any UK or EU jurisdiction, with private practice followed by in-house experience

  • Experience leading an in-house legal function, ideally as head of legal or GC at a SaaS company, with the creativity and drive to build things from scratch

  • Deep commercial experience, including IP and liability: MSAs, DPAs, order forms, and negotiating with enterprise procurement and legal teams

  • A track record of building legal process from scratch: templates, playbooks, intake, a contract repository

  • Experience running external counsel across several jurisdictions and keeping spend in check

  • Working knowledge of employment, equity and corporate matters across multi-entity groups, with exposure to the UK, US and Belgium.

  • Comfort making risk calls and closing imperfect contracts, and giving clear, usable advice to non-lawyers and board-level readers

Nice to Have

  • Fundraising experience on the fund or company side

  • US legal experience

  • Experience with data privacy (GDPR) and AI regulation, such as the EU AI Act

  • Experience with cross-border data transfers between the UK, EU and US

  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle tools and AI-assisted contract review

Why Join Us?

  • Build the legal function at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

  • A true partnership role, working directly with our CFO and CEO

  • Meaningful equity. We want you to own a piece of what we're building.

  • Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so 3 days a week in the office is required.

  • Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more

  • Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to: Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal

  • Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

  • Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

  • Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000

raw.description:
Multi-Site Manager - (HOP)

 

Deliveroo

Deliveroo is on a mission to be the definitive food company. We want to be the platform that people turn to whenever they think about food. We continue to operate in a competitive marketplace but have achieved so much over the past year, including significant growth in our Hop, Grocery, Editions, Signature & Plus businesses.

We continue to innovate and challenge ourselves on what we should deliver next to achieve our mission. We are investing and building out teams to help us launch new innovative products. It's an exciting time to join and while we have made great progress, we are just getting started!

Deliveroo HOP

Deliveroo HOP launched in September 2021 and is Deliveroo’s speedy grocery delivery service. Our mission is to deliver groceries to customers around the world in as little as 10 minutes - from the weekly shop, to a last minute dinner party or a late night snack. Working with trusted grocers, Deliveroo Hop promises to bring customers the very best products at lightning speed.

The team behind Deliveroo HOP are building a network of stores across London, the UK and International markets. Each delivery store is staffed with a team who have been specially trained to manage the operations efficiently as well as pick and pack orders in record time, with Deliveroo’s 100,000 strong rider network completing all deliveries.

We’re looking for people with an exceptional drive and entrepreneurial spirit to join the team at Deliveroo Hop and help us build the leading speedy grocery delivery service. Hungry to win? This is an exciting time to join the Deliveroo HOP team within the broader Deliveroo organisation - we’re only just getting started!

 

The Role

The role of the Multi-Site Manager is to drive the highest performance possible within their respective cluster of sites. This includes maximising customer satisfaction, optimising productivity and achieving site personnel costs, maintaining strong stock accuracy, tightly controlling inventory and minimising all wastage.

The Multi-Site Manager must also create a positive and cooperative working environment for all colleagues, develop and train team members to the highest standard, and ensure at all times that their operation remains safe, legal and compliant.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Plan your work week most effectively splitting time between your respective sites to ensure you are having the greatest impact possible whilst ensuring compliance to company work expectations (e.g. weekend working, late night working, time spent on site).

  • Lead through your respective teams, working closely with the Assistant Manager in your respective sites (2-4), to achieve all company objectives and goals. This will require an ability to lead effectively at a distance whilst also remaining willing and able to get stuck in!

  • Lead in accordance with the Deliveroo values and ensure your team follows suit. Act as a People Manager for all our staff colleagues and support them throughout their organisational life cycle. This includes the requirement to manage HR/ER cases.

  • Recruit and onboard HOP team members within your respective remit.

  • Develop, train and motivate all employees to achieve ambitious targets

  • Demonstrate operational excellence by meeting KPI targets across your respective sites constantly seeking to improve.

  • Minimise wastage within your respective sites by supervising regular stock counts, inventory management and supervising stock rotation.

  • Supervise compliance to company standard operating procedures (SOPs) through robust supervision, impactful coaching and inspirational leadership.

  • Drive strong standards within your sites, adhering to merchandising and space management principles in addition to delivering a clean, tidy, organised site environment.

  • Be responsible for ensuring compliance with all Health & Safety and Due Diligence measures in place for the operation. Ensure all product recalls and withdrawals are actioned as per company guidelines.

  • Complete high quality schedules for your respective sites adhering to company labour targets and working time directive requirements. Supervise accurate timekeeping and manage team holiday entitlements in the most effective way.

  • Carry out regular Health & Safety checks, including completion of requisite internal audits to monitor compliance to standards.

  • Host and participate in relevant meetings.

  • Monitor customer feedback seeking opportunities to improve the customer experience.

  • Maintain good relations to uphold Deliveroo’s positive reputation with all external parties, e.g.neighbours, landlords, contractors.

  • Liaise with your various counterparts across the business to improve overall operational performance.

  • Participate and/or lead projects, initiatives and activities to improve the operating model and achieve company objectives

Requirements

  • Minimum of 3-4 years of grocery experience

  • A good understanding and track record in managing and influencing the P&L and KPIs performance of your business

  • Capability and track record for project management

Multi-Site Manager - (HOP)

 

Deliveroo

Deliveroo is on a mission to be the definitive food company. We want to be the platform that people turn to whenever they think about food. We continue to operate in a competitive marketplace but have achieved so much over the past year, including significant growth in our Hop, Grocery, Editions, Signature & Plus businesses.

We continue to innovate and challenge ourselves on what we should deliver next to achieve our mission. We are investing and building out teams to help us launch new innovative products. It's an exciting time to join and while we have made great progress, we are just getting started!

Deliveroo HOP

Deliveroo HOP launched in September 2021 and is Deliveroo’s speedy grocery delivery service. Our mission is to deliver groceries to customers around the world in as little as 10 minutes - from the weekly shop, to a last minute dinner party or a late night snack. Working with trusted grocers, Deliveroo Hop promises to bring customers the very best products at lightning speed.

The team behind Deliveroo HOP are building a network of stores across London, the UK and International markets. Each delivery store is staffed with a team who have been specially trained to manage the operations efficiently as well as pick and pack orders in record time, with Deliveroo’s 100,000 strong rider network completing all deliveries.

We’re looking for people with an exceptional drive and entrepreneurial spirit to join the team at Deliveroo Hop and help us build the leading speedy grocery delivery service. Hungry to win? This is an exciting time to join the Deliveroo HOP team within the broader Deliveroo organisation - we’re only just getting started!

 

The Role

The role of the Multi-Site Manager is to drive the highest performance possible within their respective cluster of sites. Title: Site Associate (Part time)

Location: Brent Cross

Pay: £14.40 per hour

Hours: 20

 

About Deliveroo Editions

With a dash of hard-work, a sprinkle of teamwork and a whole dollop of creativity, we created “Editions” which is our ‘dark kitchens’ business. We have partnered with some fantastic restaurants such as Wagamama, Starbucks, Pho and Gourmet Burger Company to help further connect them with hungry customers. 

Delivery-only kitchens have never been higher profile, or more valuable for improving service and selection for customers. Deliveroo Editions were the world's first delivery-only kitchens, and we are still the market leaders in helping our restaurant partners succeed. What’s even more exciting is that we’re expanding our portfolio further.

Great people help to drive our business forward and we are always looking for more to join our sites. If you don’t have the exact experience, that’s okay, we’d still love to hear from you. 

Does this sound tasty to you? Take a look at our Site Associate role and apply below to join the Roo family.

About the role

The Site Associate role covers a wide range of tasks across the Editions site. You will ensure that the site is clean, support the wider operation of the site to ensure that our loyal customers receive their orders as quickly as possible from our trusted partners. 

Responsibilities will include:

  • You will report into the Site Manager and the site management team.

  • Ensuring that the cleanliness of the site is maintained to a high standard by cleaning as you go throughout the shift as well as regular deep cleaning of various equipment throughout the week

  • Cleaning communal areas, such as staff room, bathrooms, stock rooms, maintaining site health and safety standards at all times

  • Working with the management team to ensure a safe and clean site by participating in regularly checking

  • Assisting with dispatching, which will include running food from our partners to the dispatch area, assisting with orders and communicating with our riders

  • Supporting our partners by keeping kitchen equipment clean and ready for use throughout the shift with the pot wash

Who we are looking for

  • You radiate positivity!

  • You have a great attitude to work, you are driven and have willingness to learn

  • You are a team player, punctuality and reliability is your forte

  • You always go above and beyond, you’re looking to progress in your career

  • You can work autonomously but you LOVE working with a fantastic team and with our partners

  • You like to solve problems, making recommendations on how to improve daily tasks

  • Previous experience in a Kitchen Porter or Kitchen Cleaner role is a bonus, but don’t worry if you haven’t, if you have the right attitude and drive, we can train you.

What to expect from the interview process

  • Step 1: apply for any role you'd like to be considered for - we'd love to hear from you!

  • Step 2: if your application is successful, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to say hello and understand more about your experience

  • Step 3: if we decide to progress your application, you will be invited to an onsite interview with one of the site managers

  • Step 4: We'll come back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the outcome!

Benefits 

  • 25 days holiday, increases with length of service

  • Free food and LOTS of it

  • Access to Deliveroo Plus (no delivery fee on all orders)

  • Life assurance

  • Access to discounts in other companies via our benefits portal

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company paid team meals and nights out

  • Online learning courses delivered by global universities

  • Clear career development path

Why Deliveroo


Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. . We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace and Diversity

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer multiple great benefits in areas including health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing startups in an exciting space.

raw.title: Engineering Manager – Server-Driven UI (Codeless)
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Codeless, our internal Server-Driven UI (SDUI) platform team. In this role, you will lead a cross-functional team bridging mobile/web frontend engineering and core platform backend systems.

While this role is deeply rooted in modern UI architecture, its mission goes beyond standard UI development: Codeless empowers product teams across the organization to ship dynamic, native UI experiences dynamically from the backend—eliminating app store release bottlenecks, dramatically accelerating feature iteration, and establishing a unified UI schema across iOS, Android, and Web.

What you'll be doing

This is a role with broad impact, from hands-on technical guidance to championing web and mobile accessibility across the company. We're looking for a leader who excels at fostering collaboration and can confidently guide a concept from initial idea to robust implementation.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Build, mentor, and scale an engineering team responsible for our core Server-Driven UI platform ("Codeless"). Foster an inclusive, high-ownership engineering culture.
  • Platform Architecture & Evolution: Oversee the design and evolution of dynamic layout engines, declarative UI schemas, and client rendering frameworks across iOS, Android, and Web.
  • Developer Velocity & Platform Adoption: Partner with product feature teams to drive internal adoption of Codeless. Ensure the platform provides exceptional Developer Experience, clear tooling, robust design system integration, and seamless debugging workflows.
  • Technical Execution & Quality: Set high technical standards for platform performance, payload optimization, caching strategies, backward compatibility, and graceful offline/fallback behavior across client devices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, Design System leaders, and Core Infrastructure engineers to align the Codeless roadmap with broader company initiatives and global design paradigms.

What you'll need to thrive

Engineering Management: 3+ years of experience managing software engineering teams, with a track record of coaching engineers, delivering complex platform initiatives, and driving technical strategy.

UI & Platform Domain Expertise: Strong foundational background in mobile (iOS/Android) or modern web architecture (React, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, or declarative UI paradigms).

Product & Platform Mindset: Ability to treat internal product engineering teams as customers, evaluating platform success through developer velocity, adoption metrics, and rendering performance.

Why join us

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.
