raw.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

raw.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. You'll be responsible for building a pricing strategy and experimentation roadmap that grows revenue and profitability sustainably, without compromising the customer experience.

This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. 

About the Team

Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users.

The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.

Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth?

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products.
  • Identify and launch major growth opportunities across affordability, conversion, frequency, revenue, and profitability.
  • Drive 0 to 1 big bets through validation, launch, then scale them 100X.
  • Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering to design pricing algorithms, experiments, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and turn learnings into product strategy.
  • Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash.

What We're Looking For

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products.
  • Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions.
  • Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems.
  • Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps.
  • Can operate as a "conductor" — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams.

Why Join Us?

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our People team are the architects of a great workplace where brilliant minds come together to do their best work. From discovering diverse talent and nurturing future leaders, to creating spaces that spark collaboration and crafting rewards that celebrate success—we're passionate about building a culture where everyone can thrive.

We're looking for a Senior HR Advisor to join our Manchester team. This is a hybrid role. You'll help us deliver a fair, consistent and high-performing employee experience by leading complex employee relations, strengthening manager capability and using people insights to improve how we work across our Merchant organisation.

Get to know our People team—what drives us, how we work and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the UKI People team, primarily supporting our Merchant organisation. Employee relations sits at the heart of the role, alongside a broader focus on employee experience, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Employee Relations and Case Management

  • Manage a varied and complex end-to-end caseload across performance, probation, absence, grievances and disciplinaries.
  • Provide clear, practical advice that balances employee experience, commercial needs, employment law and organisational risk.
  • Build trusted relationships with managers, helping them address concerns early and confidently challenging where needed to achieve fair and consistent outcomes.
  • Respond to sensitive employee and manager concerns with sound judgement, discretion and professionalism, ensuring issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate and timely case documentation, delivering a consistently high standard of support across competing priorities.

Employee Experience and Engagement

  • Partner with managers, leaders, and People colleagues to create an environment where employees feel heard, valued and supported.

  • Support feedback channels and targeted engagement activity, ensuring themes are followed through and actions are clearly communicated.
  • Coach managers on the behaviours and everyday practices that influence engagement, performance and retention.

Root-Cause Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Use case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify hotspots and underlying factors, such as onboarding, management capability or gaps in existing processes.
  • Turn insights into practical interventions that reduce avoidable cases and improve employee and manager experiences.
  • Recommend continuous improvements to People policies, guidance and processes, helping us deliver support with greater consistency and efficiency.
  • Identify recurring employee or manager questions and improve the guidance, tools and self-service resources available to them.

Manager Capability and Coaching

  • A high level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential employee information.
  • A collaborative and adaptable approach, with experience building trusted partnerships across teams and influencing without direct authority.

  • Experience supporting employee listening, engagement or retention initiatives.

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and merchants every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's (& Doordash's) growth at scale.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Event Streaming Systems team. This is a hybrid role.

In this role, you'll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You'll help define the long-term direction of our messaging and streaming platforms, lead high-impact technical initiatives across teams, and raise the reliability, scalability and operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.

These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.
  • Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.
  • Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.
  • Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.
  • Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.
  • Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:

  • Significant experience building, operating and evolving distributed systems in production, ideally for platform or infrastructure teams supporting critical workloads.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.
  • Strong technical leadership skills, with a track record of defining technical direction, shaping roadmaps and leading multi-engineer or cross-team initiatives.
  • Ability to make and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations, using data, operational signals, customer needs and long-term system health to guide tradeoffs.
  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.
  • Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.
  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale, including incident leadership and post-incident improvement programs.
  • Experience with database reliability, storage systems, data platforms or DBRE practices in addition to event streaming.
  • Experience using automation or AI-assisted operational tooling to improve reliability, developer experience or incident response quality.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo (Doordash), you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.

Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale. Work on complex, always-on infrastructure that impacts millions every day.
  • 🌱 See your impact, fast. Shape the direction of foundational platforms used by teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership. Lead ambiguous, high-impact technical problems with strong support from peers and leaders.
  • 🌎 A culture built for builders. High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  • 💰 Share in the success you help create. Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

raw.title: Account Manager (Inbound)
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

The Account Manager is a proven high performer within the Inbound Sales team. In this position you are the face (or voice) of Funding Circle to the customer dealing with inbound leads in the form of business loan applications. The focus of the role is to assist the customer with their queries and educate them on both the Funding Circle offering and wider business context. You will be targeted on your conversion of the value offered by these inbound leads to the value of accepted loans.

  • Establishing instant rapport with your customers via telephone & email to cultivate successful relationships

  • Knowledge and understanding of the wider lending market and Funding Circle’s direct competitors

  • Pitching the Funding Circle proposition against alternative funding options available

  • Managing a high-volume, fast-paced pipeline; supporting your clients through each stage of creating an application

  • Being responsible for your own monthly target and continuously developing & improving your approach to help you get there

  • Adding value through upsell and cross sell of Funding Circle products as well as partner lenders within the Marketplace.

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • Relevant experience in a high volume sales environment focused on closing deals - a background in lending/commercial finance is preferable

  • A strong communicator, confident to be able to engage with small business owners over the phone and via email

  • Ability to continually develop and maintain your pipeline whilst managing applications in progress

  • Able to proactively identify ways to use Generative AI to streamline your daily tasks and improve your personal productivity

  • Confident using approved AI tools safely and effectively to enhance your output and find a better way of working

  • Proactivity and a desire to develop your career and taking onboard feedback - continuous development is a key part of sales at Funding Circle and we are looking for people keen to grow!

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

raw.title: Compensation Business Partner, International
raw.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is looking for a Compensation Business Partner to ensure our compensation philosophy, principles, and practices extend to all of our markets outside of the US, initially focused on EMEA and APAC.

This will be our first Compensation Business Partner dedicated to our international business sitting within the EMEA region, and an opportunity to help shape how Harvey approaches compensation as we continue to scale globally. You’ll partner closely with our People Business Partners, Recruiting team, business leaders, and the broader Compensation team to ensure our programs remain competitive, thoughtful, and scalable across markets.

We’re looking for someone who combines deep compensation expertise with strong business judgment. You should be equally comfortable analyzing market data, advising a recruiter on a complex offer, partnering with a PBP and developing a point of view on how Harvey should approach compensation in a new or rapidly evolving market. This is a highly collaborative role that will have a great degree of partnership across many functions.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary Compensation Business Partner for EMEA and APAC, developing deep context on our teams, talent markets, and hiring needs across the regions.

  • Partner closely with People Business Partners and business leaders on compensation decisions including new hires, promotions, internal mobility, and other complex compensation questions.

  • Build a particularly strong partnership with Recruiting, advising on offers, market competitiveness, and candidate-specific situations.

  • Help evolve Harvey's international compensation strategy as we scale, including our approach to geographic differentiation, market positioning, salary structures, and equity.

  • Bring deep equity expertise and help translate Harvey's equity philosophy across markets where candidate expectations and familiarity with US-style equity compensation can vary significantly.

  • Research emerging compensation practices and talent trends, particularly across the rapidly evolving AI market, and turn external data into clear recommendations for Harvey.

  • Conduct market analyses using compensation survey data and other sources, while applying judgment.

  • Partner with the broader Compensation team on compensation cycles, benchmarking, band development, and company-wide programs, ensuring international considerations are represented from the beginning.

  • Identify where our US practices translate internationally—and where they don't—and proactively recommend changes as Harvey enters and scales in new markets.

  • Help build the infrastructure, principles, and enablement that will allow Harvey's international compensation approach to scale.


What You Have

  • 5-7+ years of experience in compensation

  • Experience supporting international compensation across EMEA and/or APAC.

  • Experience working for a US-headquartered company, with a strong understanding of how global compensation programs are designed and adapted for international markets.

  • Meaningful experience with equity compensation, including the ability to explain and advise on equity in markets with different norms and expectations.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment; you are comfortable building while the company and market are changing around you.

  • Strong knowledge of compensation fundamentals including market benchmarking, salary structures, job leveling, offers, promotions, retention, and pay decisions.

  • Exceptional business partnership skills. You can build trust with leaders, PBPs, and recruiters while being willing to challenge assumptions.

  • Strong analytical skills paired with excellent judgment—you know when the data is telling you something and when it requires additional context.

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine appetite to become an expert on the AI talent market, including proactively researching competitors, compensation trends, and emerging practices.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building new approaches rather than relying on an established playbook.

  • Ability to communicate complicated compensation concepts simply and credibly to audiences with very different levels of compensation expertise.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an innovative and hands-on Senior Customer Marketing Manager to put Harvey’s EMEA customers centre stage: telling their stories, celebrating their wins, and building community around them.

Harvey has an incredible base of law firm and in-house customers across the region, and they are truly innovating the practice of law. Your first job is to elevate their voices: finding the customers doing standout work, earning their trust, and producing the written, video and spoken stories that put that work in front of the industry.

From there, the role expands into community programming: building the communities, programmes and moments (power user groups, customer roundtables, awards and recognition moments, customer-led content) that bring customers and the wider legal community together.

You’ll sit within the EMEA Marketing team and work hand in glove with our global Customer Engagement team, who own the overarching customer marketing strategy, programmes and playbooks. Your job is to make them work for EMEA: adapting them for the region’s markets, customers and culture, building what the region needs on top, and feeding what you learn back into the global motion. You’ll also partner closely with Customer Success and Sales. As the first dedicated customer marketer in the region, you won’t inherit a finished playbook. You’ll help write it.

What You'll Do

  • Localise the global motion for EMEA: take the programmes, playbooks and frameworks our Customer Engagement team builds globally and tailor them specifically for EMEA markets, customers and culture, working hand-in-hand to build a truly exceptional motion.

  • Build the EMEA customer story pipeline: work across customer-facing teams to find the customers doing standout work, secure their participation and approvals, and keep a steady flow of stories in production.

  • Tell their stories: own written stories, video stories, quotes and references end to end and to a standard the customer is proud to share.

  • Get the stories seen: package each story for the channels that give it reach, localised for priority EMEA markets, and make sure Sales knows what exists and how to use it.

  • Build the advocate bench: develop a roster of EMEA customers who can act as references, speakers, panellists and peer connectors, and track their participation so no one is over-asked and everyone gets recognised.

  • Build EMEA community programmes: design and run the formats that bring customers together, such as power user groups, customer roundtables, practitioner communities, awards and recognition moments, each with clear goals and structured follow-up.

  • Build repeatable playbooks and processes: the story production workflow, approvals process, reference tracking and community operating rhythm, so each new story and programme is faster to stand up than the last.

  • Measure and improve impact: track stories produced, proof usage, reference activity, community engagement and contribution to pipeline, renewals and expansion.


What You Have

  • 4-7 years of experience in customer marketing, customer advocacy, content marketing or community, ideally in B2B SaaS, technology or professional services.

  • Proven experience producing content end to end. Excellent writer and interviewer, with the judgement to find the real story and the credibility to earn trust with senior legal and business leaders.

  • Experience building or running events, customer communities and advocacy programmes.

  • Strong relationship instincts: you enjoy spending time with customers and build trust quickly with them, Sales and Customer Success.

  • Highly organised and operationally rigorous, with the ability to run multiple stories, programmes and stakeholders at once.

  • Comfortable working autonomously and building from scratch in a fast-moving environment.

  • Familiarity with using AI to scale your own work.

  • Experience marketing to legal, financial services, consulting, enterprise or other high-touch professional audiences is a plus. Additional European languages are a plus.

Harvey’s experts help leaders decide what to change, and how to change it, as they adopt and embed new ways of working: how legal work is organized and governed, how it’s priced by firms and valued by in-house teams and how their people build new capability. The Transformation Office then works alongside their teams to make it happen. Our advice draws on what we see across Harvey's customers in more than 50 countries and on where the technology is heading. Our client work shapes Harvey's product, and the product shapes our advice. Both improve together.

Law firms and legal departments are making decisions now that will shape how they compete for the next decade: which work to prioritize, how to price and value it, how to staff it and how to organize around AI. As Transformation Advisory Lead for Strategy & Economics, you help their leaders make those decisions well. You have made them yourself, inside a firm or a legal department, and advised others through them, so managing partners, general counsel and CFOs treat you as a peer.

You will be one of the first senior specialists in Harvey's Transformation Office. You will help build our strategy and economics offering, bring that expertise to client engagements run by our Engagement Managers and join our Practice Directors when a customer has a specific need in strategy and economics. What you learn will shape how Harvey advises the market and what we build next.

What You'll Do

  • Advise on strategy. Help leaders decide where AI changes their competitive position: which practices/domains, clients and types of work to prioritize, and where to invest.

  • Advise on pricing and value. Help firms and legal departments measure the impact of AI on the cost, speed and value of their work. For firms, that means working through how fee structures and value models need to change; for legal departments, it means showing the value their work creates for the business.

  • Advise on operating models. Help customers redesign how legal work is organized, supported and staffed, including team structures and the roles AI creates or changes.

  • Help leaders make the case for change. Work with managing partners, general counsel and finance leaders to build the case they take to their partnership, board, internal stakeholders or executive team.

  • Build the offering. Create the diagnostics, frameworks and leadership readouts the Transformation Office uses to deliver strategy and economics engagements, and turn each engagement into material the wider team can use.

  • Bring your expertise to early conversations. Join Practice Directors and account teams when a customer has a specific need in strategy and economics.


What You Have

  • 10+ years of experience, including significant time shaping strategy, pricing or operating decisions: for example in a law firm's strategy, pricing or practice management team, in legal operations, external counsel or law firm management, or as chief of staff to a general counsel. Experience in a legal-sector consulting practice is a strong plus.

  • Deep fluency in legal economics. For law firms: leverage, practice-group and matter profitability, pricing and fee structures. For legal departments: cost-center dynamics, outside-counsel spend and how the value of legal work is measured.

  • A track record of advising senior legal leaders through high-stakes decisions, with the presence to hold a room that includes finance.

  • A clear point of view on how AI will change the business of law, grounded in how the economics actually move.

  • Evidence that you have built frameworks or methods that others adopted and kept using.

  • The judgment to discuss efficiency in a way that builds support for change rather than fear about displacement.

  • Energy for building something new while the playbook is still being written.

raw.description:
What are we trying to do?  

Lab49 was founded in 2002 with a deep pool of business and technology talent and a global reach. We specialize in helping clients realize rapid transformational change at an industrial scale and operate historically towards the upper tiers of banking and capital markets, to include banks, hedge funds and exchanges; assisting those companies with their most key strategic business programmes and technology investments.  


What do we need help with?

We are looking for an experienced consultant to work on a large institutional multi-year business transformation and integration project in cross border payments. 

 


What will you do?

Business analysis 

  • Develop business requirements and backlogs 

  • Develop detailed business specifications, including worked numerical examples 

  • Develop functional architectures and solutions designs 

  • Develop delivery roadmaps, identify dependencies, risks and issues 

  • Perform business process reengineering 

Consulting 

  • Work as part of a team in hybrid manner 

  • Engage with client stakeholders to ascertain requirements, and validate Lab49 output 

  • Facilitate workshops between Lab and client to resolve issues, risks and discover requirements 


What do you need to know?

Skills & Knowledge 

  • Working knowledge of financial markets, some experience of payments 

  • Working knowledge of typical financial flows and architecture 

  • Understanding of business process modelling 

  • Ability to gather and document business requirements 

  • Understanding of agile methodologies including the creation of epics / user stories and the effective management of backlogs 

  • Stakeholder management 

  • Excellent communication skills; able to represent the team, project and firm in all manner of client situations 

  • Willingness and ability to get “hands-on” as needed; developing detailed specification and numerical examples 

    •  

    Experience  

    • Experience with business analysis projects both as an individual and as part of a team 

    • Experience with business analysis in the financial markets environment 

    • Experience working with IT teams to deliver products / solutions 

    • Experience with projects from inception through to delivery 

    • Experience working in an agile environment 


Who are you?

  • You want to help clients gain a deep understanding of their business processes and work with them to identify new and improved ways of working 

  • You like to see things through from idea to final product 

  • You keep up with the latest business trends in the market 

  • You keep up with the latest techniques, e.g. Deep Learning, NLP, AI and how they can be used to solve problems, increase productivity 

  • You pay attention to the details 

  • You have the sufficient confidence and credibility to represent Lab49 to the client 

  • You have the ability to understand the client need and articulate that to our internal teams 

  • You have the drive and ability to be successful in new environments and domains. 

  • You actively learn and develop your capabilities through self-study, and your network of peers and expert groups and organizations  

Why should you come work for us?  

  • It is a challenge. Your peers will push you, and you will grow in leaps and bounds that is impossible in traditional organizations.  

  • As a consultant, you will see a multitude of technologies, organizations, and projects. You will learn a lot in a very short period of time.  

  • We are a flat meritocracy with an engineering mindset. What matters is how good you are and how well you and your team deliver.  

  • We are focused on the finance domain. There are plenty of areas where technology is a competitive advantage, and our clients turn to us when they need more innovative solutions.  

  • If you ask our engineers, they will probably tell you that their extraordinary peer group is the primary reason that they work for us.  

  • We are entrepreneurial and agile. There is a lot of opportunity to take accountability and grow quickly.  

  • Automation positively transforms the lives of people and business. Our software helps you improve decision-making, increase efficiency, simplify complex processes and empower your people. We enable financial institutions, central banks and corporations to digitize and automate their most business-critical processes. We are reinventing the way business is done through innovations in automation technology.  

  • We encourage creativity by automating repetitive tasks. We think long-term to get it right the first time  

  • We are not limited by the status quo. We challenge boundaries, question assumptions and make transformative leaps.

raw.title: Partner Success Manager, EMEA
raw.description:
Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business.


We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

This is a hybrid role. Office attendance is expected two days per week on Tuesdays and Thursdays in London. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events.

Ironclad is scaling rapidly across EMEA through a partner-first go-to-market model. We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, proactive EMEA Partner Success Manager to shape and operationalise our Global Partner Services programs—building effective partner engagement, enablement, readiness, and collaboration across the region.

As part of Customer Value, you’ll support partner services across the customer lifecycle, from pre-sales alignment and delivery readiness through co-delivery and post-live adoption. Working with major systems integrators and consulting firms, you’ll help evolve a value-focused model that starts earlier in the customer journey and extends beyond implementation to improve conversion, accelerate time to value, increase platform usage, and strengthen long-term customer outcomes.

You’ll bring a strong operator’s mindset: turning ambiguity into clear, repeatable ways of working across Sales, Alliances, Technical Services, Customer Success, and external partners. You’ll use data to improve program performance and, based in London, spend regular time in the office and face-to-face with partners to build relationships and help them succeed.

What you'll do:

  • Own relationships with strategic partners’ practice and delivery leaders, aligning on priorities, readiness, quality expectations, capacity, and growth opportunities.

  • Partner with Sales, Alliances, and Customer Value to match qualified opportunities with the right partner, co-delivery model, and implementation approach based on customer needs, deal context, partner readiness, and expectations.

  • Operationalise partner engagement across the customer lifecycle—from discovery and scoping through readiness planning, delivery transition, and post-live support—clarifying roles and setting engagements up for execution and adoption.

  • Evolve partner programs with Partner Alliances, Enablement, and Customer Value leadership, including co-delivery and subcontracting frameworks, onboarding, certification, methodology alignment, delivery quality, and ongoing enablement.

  • Assess partner capacity, coverage, skills, and readiness against business demand and EMEA growth priorities; coordinate capacity planning across strategic and subcontracting relationships to improve predictability.

  • Build targeted partner enablement plans across product knowledge, implementation, integrations, value selling, customer change management, AI use cases, and emerging AI consumption models; help partners adapt capabilities and commercial/delivery approaches as opportunities evolve.

  • Work with EA and partner teams to understand partner ISV offerings, technology ecosystems, integrations, and customer architecture requirements, and connect differentiated capabilities to customer opportunities.

  • Help partner-led engagements establish a path to customer enablement, adoption, value realisation, and sustained platform usage after go-live; reinforce accountability for agreed post-live milestones.

  • Identify patterns in partner-led work that affect conversion, delivery quality, time to value, adoption health, renewal readiness, and expansion potential; translate findings into practical program improvements.

  • Establish an EMEA partner operating rhythm (in partnership with EMEA Partner Alliances) —including business reviews, readiness and capacity assessments, enablement planning, and escalation management—and keep partners current on regional priorities, market dynamics, customer needs, and product and go-to-market changes.

  • Maintain operational hygiene and data integrity for partner-led projects and programs across internal systems, reporting, and workflows; translate feedback from European partners and customers into actionable recommendations for Ironclad teams.

What success looks like:

  • A scalable EMEA partner-first operating model and a clear, consistent operating rhythm.

  • Better alignment between partner strategy and qualified deal motions, with greater confidence in partner fit, readiness, and implementation approach before kickoff.

  • More predictable partner capacity and targeted capability plans, with priority enablement gaps owned and closed.

  • Consistent, high-quality partner-led and co-delivered services, with clear roles across EA, Sales, Alliances, Services, Customer Value, and partners.

  • Partners equipped to respond to EMEA priorities and AI-led opportunities; partner ISV and integration capabilities connected to relevant customer needs.

  • Improved customer time to value, adoption, sustained usage, and expansion outcomes, with a positive contribution to adoption health, GRR, and NDR-oriented outcomes.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Partner Operations, Customer Success, Implementation, or a related role at a SaaS company and/or consulting or systems integration firm.

  • 2+ years of experience working with implementation partners, subcontractors, or partner delivery teams in a services environment.

  • Experience supporting complex pre-sales, scoping, or solution-alignment motions with Sales, Services, and/or Alliances teams; implementation, managed, partner services, or GSI experience is highly relevant.

  • Strong program management skills and a track record of building or improving cross-functional processes spanning internal teams and external partners.

  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguity and execute repeatable operating models in a fast-changing environment.

  • Strong relationship-building, influencing, and communication skills, including the ability to work with senior stakeholders across functions and geographies and turn complex considerations into clear recommendations.

  • Comfort using data and KPIs to evaluate program effectiveness and improve conversion, delivery quality, adoption, and customer outcomes.

  • Experience with change management, adoption planning, or value realisation is strongly preferred; understanding how to set partners up across sales, delivery, enablement, integrations, and customer outcomes is important.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, sound judgment, and comfort shaping a partner-first model as the business scales and the operating model evolves.

  • Willingness to spend regular time in the London office and travel across Europe (approximately 15%).

  • Fluency in an additional European language, particularly German or French, is beneficial but not required.

UK Full-Time Employee Benefits at Ironclad:

raw.title: Account Executive
raw.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.


Jeeves is rapidly growing our operations in EMEA and searching for a motivated, ambitious Account Executive to join and help scale our EMEA Sales organization.  The Account Executive will report to our GM of NAM & EMEA and be responsible for closing high-value clients and growing the EMEA market. The most qualified candidates will also be fluent in Spanish and have some experience in B2B sales across Latin America as well.

Location: This role is a full-time remote position. #LI-REMOTE

Job Responsibilities:
  • Acquire high-quality new clients through efficient outbound strategies (Hunting) + cross-sell & upsell existing clients by providing top-notch consultative sales.
  • Identify business opportunities targeting mid- to large-sized businesses, enterprises, and later-stage venture-backed startups; consistently meet and exceed sales targets and deliver revenue growth as an individual contributor.
  • Manage full sales cycle and executive effective pipeline strategy: lead generation, prospecting, qualifying, discovery, objection handling, development, negotiating, and closing.
  • Provide timely, detailed, and actionable feedback to management. product and engineering teams to constantly improve Jeeves’ platform features and financial services offerings.
  • Collaborate with marketing and customer success to develop your own materials and increase conversion rates
  • Build an effortless and value-driven client experience while working directly with a versatile portfolio of business owners to help support their financial goals
  • Collaborate with marketing and customer success to develop your own materials and increase conversion rates
  • Work with our Country & Regional Managers to develop, track, and exceed quota targets.
  • Build an effortless and value-driven client experience while working directly with a versatile portfolio of business owners to help support their financial goals

    • Requirements:
  • 6+ years’ experience in sales or business development 
  • Fluent in English and Spanish with experience working across EMEA and preferably Latin America in B2B sales
  • Experience in financial services, payments, crypto, blockchain/digital asset technologies
  • An existing network of transferable B2B relationships preferably with mid- to large-sized businesses, enterprises, and later-stage venture-backed startups is a must
  • Demonstrated ability to garner attention, present professionally, and communicate at all levels of an organization - focus on CFOs, Partners, and Business Owners. Proven track record of negotiating and closing complex, high-impact deals with C-level stakeholders.
  • Successful track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Keen interest in developing a career in a high-performing Sales team and learning the inputs of a sales machine; willingness to put in the work necessary to be successful
  • Experience using CRM software (ex. Salesforce, Hubspot or Pipedrive)
  • Excellent Communication: we’re energized by the challenge of grabbing someone’s attention, relating to them, and driving professional value in every interaction. You will contribute to this energy.

    • What will set you up for success:
  • Proactiveness: We’re a small team with a lean mindset. We’re making decisions fast and need to adapt quickly to new information. You thrive with independence and a  “get things done” attitude”
  • Results Focused: We’re constantly reviewing information, metrics, and KPIs. You should be excited by achieving numbers... and if they don’t exist, you’re telling us what they are and how to hit them. 
  • Excellent Communication: we’re energized by the challenge of  grabbing someone’s attention, relating to them, and driving professional value in every interaction. You will contribute to this energy.

raw.title: Legal Engineer
raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a box. It's part legal tech specialist, part product expert, part solutions architect, and part trusted advisor. If you want a role that stays static, this isn't it.

Your mission is to help some of the world's leading law firms get the absolute most out of Legora. You'll understand how lawyers work, how firms operate, and where AI can make the biggest difference — then turn that potential into workflows that deliver real value.

You'll be the person clients call when they want to rethink how legal work gets done — whether that's transforming how a practice group delivers work, embedding Legora across an international firm, or helping partners build the case for AI adoption.

Specifically, you will

  • Act as a genuine thought partner to law firms — understanding their practice areas, commercial priorities and ways of working, then identifying high-value opportunities to transform how legal services are delivered.

  • Own the journey alongside Customer Success from early pilots through onboarding to firm-wide adoption, turning initial use cases into sustained, measurable impact across teams, offices and practice groups.

  • Design and implement workflows around the realities of private practice — from due diligence, contract review and drafting to litigation, regulatory advisory, transactions and knowledge management.

  • Partner with law firm partners, innovation leaders, knowledge teams and practising lawyers to build the case for AI adoption, connecting Legora's capabilities to outcomes that matter to the firm and its clients.

  • Be the voice of the private practice lawyer inside Legora — bringing a deep understanding of legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial realities of law firms into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic direction.

  • Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from associates and partners to firm leadership.

  • Help firms navigate one of the most significant shifts in legal service delivery — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal work is performed, priced and delivered to clients.

  • Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora partners with leading law firms as we grow globally.

What you'll bring

You've worked in private practice and understand the reality of delivering legal advice in a law firm. You know that great legal work isn't just about getting the right answer — it's about delivering exceptional quality under pressure, managing demanding clients, exercising sound judgement and balancing commercial expectations with the highest professional standards.

But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how law firms operate and deliver value to their clients.

We're looking for

  • Meaningful experience working within a law firm, giving you a strong understanding of private practice, legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial pressures of delivering legal services.

  • Strong legal judgement and credibility. A legal qualification is valuable, but we're ultimately interested in your ability to understand sophisticated legal work and how it can be transformed.

  • Tech-curious and product-savvy — not necessarily a coder, but someone who leans into technical conversations around generative AI, implementation and workflow transformation.

  • Commercially minded — you understand how law firms operate and can connect changes in legal workflows to outcomes that matter to partners, practice groups and their clients.

  • A natural translator — comfortable moving between practising lawyers, partners, innovation and knowledge teams, product teams and engineers.

  • Someone who brings structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity — the calm, credible presence clients rely on when they're navigating significant change.

  • Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple complex client relationships without losing quality or pace.

  • High standards without perfectionism — you ship, you learn, and you make it better over time.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Account Executive, Deployments
raw.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Most sales roles hand you a territory, a playbook and a quota. This one hands you a market that does not exist yet. We are looking for a builder: someone who would rather create a market than inherit one. Our first enterprise customers are live and the signal is clear. Everything after that is yours to build.

Putting physical AI onto a production line is not a software sale. It reaches the plant manager, the COO, the unions, health and safety, IT, procurement, and often the CEO. Deals take time, run through site visits and technical assessments, and are won on trust. Your job is to close our first deals in the UK and turn them into a market we own.

 

We look for ownership, high agency and low ego, someone who wants to shape both our customer base, shape how we sell and succeed.

What You Will Do

  • Close our first enterprise deals in the UK. Own each one end to end, from first conversation to signed contract.

  • Run the full cycle: discovery, NDAs, use cases and footage, site visits, and a technical deployment assessment covering hardware, data, investment and timeline.

  • Seek the truth on every deal. Find out what Atlas can and cannot do on each customer’s line, say it plainly, and never sell what we cannot deliver, even when it costs the deal.

  • Navigate the whole buying group: plant managers, COOs, trade unions, health and safety, procurement, and the board. Bring each of them along.

  • Build your own pipeline from zero. There is no SDR behind you yet. Find the industrial champions in the UK and get in the room.

  • Develop the playbook as you go: who we sell to, how we price, what wins and what does not. The next ten sellers will run on what you build.

  • Take what you learn on the floor back to product, research and deployment.

Requirements

  • A track record of building, wherever you earned it: a market, a team, a company, a product line. Something that exists because you made it.

  • Enterprise sales experience. You have closed long, complex deals with many stakeholders, and you know how to keep them moving when they stall.

  • At your best in ambiguity. No map, no precedent, no one to ask.

  • You sell a vision and people trust you with it. Honest, likeable, low ego, high standards.

  • Willing to get your hands dirty. You build the account lists, write the proposals, and go to site yourself.

  • Based in London, in the office, with regular travel to customer sites.

Nice to Have

  • You have sold to operations buyers: plant or site managers, COOs, heads of manufacturing or logistics.

  • You have run pilots, POCs, or hardware-plus-software deals.

  • You have been early somewhere: founding AE, first sales hire, or early Head of Sales.

  • A background in operations consulting, VC, or as a founder.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

raw.description:
Head of Product - Cards

Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

Cards is one of the most strategically important products at Mollie. raw.title: People Partner & Employee Relations Lead, EMEA
raw.description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

We're creating a new People Partner & Employee Relations Lead role on the EMEA People team to build out our Employee Relations and HR Compliance capability across the region, alongside a partial People Partner support role. This is roughly a 60% ER & Compliance / 40% HRBP split.

Countries currently in scope: UK, France, Germany, Poland, Netherlands and Switzerland.

About The Role

As our EMEA footprint has grown, so has the complexity of managing employee relations and statutory compliance consistently in multiple jurisdictions. This role will own that complexity: handling ER casework end-to-end, lead works council activity, keeping us compliant with local labor law and data privacy requirements, and making sure our policies and manager practices hold up across every country we operate in.

You'll work independently to drive ER cases and compliance projects to resolution, while partnering closely with People Partners, Legal, and local leadership. You'll also have Business Partner responsibility for a defined set of groups, so you'll need to be equally comfortable running a grievance investigation and supporting managers in business related activities.
You know how to balance employment law compliance and risk mitigation with the agility, speed, and continuous evolution of a high-growth tech environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Employee Relations: Own workplace conflict, performance, disciplinary, and grievance cases across the region - investigating fairly, managing risk, and driving cases to a compliant and timely resolution.

  • Statutory Compliance: Monitor and enforce compliance with local labor law, working time regulations, compensation standards, and data privacy requirements across all six countries.

  • Policy Management: Own and evolve HR policies, employee handbooks, and SOPs - ensuring they reflect current law, scalable practices, and are usable by managers day-to-day.

  • Risk Mitigation: Run regular compliance audits and train managers on lawful hiring, termination, and everyday people-management practices.

  • Work Council Ownership: Act as the primary point of contact for works councils - preparing materials, running consultations, and managing the relationships. (Currently not active).

  • HRBP (c. 40%): Provide day-to-day People Business Partnering to an assigned set of groups - coaching managers, supporting workforce planning, and partnering on performance and talent conversations.

  • Partner cross-functionally with a variety of stakeholders including Legal, Security, Finance, and People teams (Talent Acquisition, Total Reward, and L&D) to ensure joined-up support for the business and consistent application of policy.

Requirements:

  • Fluent English is a must, plus French (spoken and written) is highly preferred

  • Solid multi-country ER and employment law experience across at least several of: UK, France, Germany, Poland, Netherlands, Switzerland.

  • 4+ years of relevant international HR Business Partner experience, supporting a variety of departments, especially Sales.

  • Experience managing works council relationships.

  • Strong compliance/statutory background - comfortable auditing, interpreting local law, and translating it into practical guidance for managers.

  • Structured and highly organised - able to manage a caseload and compliance calendar across multiple jurisdictions at once.

  • Independent and self-directed - able to move ER cases and projects forward without heavy oversight.

  • Collaborative - works effectively with People Partners, Legal, and local leadership; strong stakeholder management.

  • Commercial fluency - understands how a sales-driven, target-led business operates and can adapt HR approach accordingly.

  • Adaptability & Agility - comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment; able to navigate ambiguity, pivot quickly, and deliver pragmatic HR solutions without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Prior experience in a SaaS or tech environment is a plus.

  • Work on a multi-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide
