raw.title: Data Engineer
raw.description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality.
 
Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets.
 
We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero.

OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team 

We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model. 

Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions. 

By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization.

About the role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer who can own the journey of data from source systems to decision-ready outputs. You’ll build and maintain pipelines, model data, stand up dashboards, and integrate systems via APIs. In a team this size, you’ll also get involved in application development - building internal tools with Streamlit, FastAPI, or HTMX that put data directly in the hands of our investment and asset management teams. 

In your first 3 months you’ll have taken ownership of at least one critical pipeline from an external system into Databricks, and built or materially improved a reporting layer used by Fund Management or Asset Management. 


What you'll do
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines in Databricks, ensuring data is reliable, timely, and well-documented.
  • Own and evolve our Databricks models - define schemas, enforce testing, and keep the warehouse clean.
  • Automate manual data processes using Python, replacing spreadsheets and ad-hoc workflows with robust, repeatable jobs.
  • Build performance dashboards and reports in Streamlit and HTMX (FastAPI) that Finance, Asset Management, and Fund Management actually use.
  • Integrate internal and third-party systems via REST APIs, improving data accessibility across the business.
  • Champion data quality - implement validation, monitoring, and governance practices that give stakeholders confidence in the numbers.
  • Collaborate directly with non-technical teams to understand their problems and translate them into data solutions. 

    • What you'll need
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, used daily for pipeline development, data modelling, and automation.
  • Experience with modern data stack tooling: a cloud data platform (Databricks preferred), and version control (Git/GitHub).
  • A solid understanding of data modelling, warehousing patterns, and ETL/ELT design.
  • To be comfortable working with Postgres or similar relational databases.
  • Clear communication - you can explain a data model to a fund manager and discuss trade-offs with an engineer.
  • A bias toward shipping: you’d rather get something working and iterate than spend weeks in design. 

    • Bonus points for
  • Full-stack development experience - particularly with Streamlit, FastAPI, or HTMX.
  • Experience building and managing REST APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, and documentation.
  • Familiarity with renewable energy, infrastructure investment, or financial services data.
  • Experience evaluating and adopting AI/ML tooling to augment engineering workflows. 

    • 💚 Why else you'll love it here
  • 💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it's something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!
  • 🎉 Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! We were recently named the UK's top company to work for, and we ranked in the top ten in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2024. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people. We’ve also been placed in the top 10 companies for senior leadership
    • Our process usually takes up to 4 weeks, but we’ll always do our best to flex around what works for you. Along the way, you’ll chat with our recruitment team and your Recruiter will help you throughout different stages. Got any burning questions before then? Drop us a message at  and we’d love to help!
     
    If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. 🚀
     
    Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!
     
    Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we're looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

raw.description:
We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. 

Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 

Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.

We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team.

 

About the role

You and a group of strong analysts will be generating the insights that guide Octopus’ commercial decisions. 

You will be the most senior analyst in our London-based data commercial team, working with our global commercial teams in understanding our customers, setting prices, and being integral to the design of the innovative products we’re famous for.

You will help upskill analysts around the world, and directly partner with some of the most influential people in the business.


What you'll do
  • UK pricing: Partner with the product teams to set pricing for our 8 million (and growing!) customers in the UK.
  • Strategic analytics: Identify and analyse energy retail data to guide our understanding of our customers and our competitors. Impact our UK and global strategy through insights presented to the senior leadership team.
  • Global analytics: Work with teams in the seven other countries Octopus is active in to deliver and scale impactful, global projects, such as lifetime value calculations or churn modelling.
  • Metrics: Help people all across the business understand the key drivers of their operations through well-defined KPIs and intuitive dashboards.
  • Global cooperation: Prioritise and coordinate the data teams supporting Octopus’ operations globally, balancing local needs with global opportunities.

    • What you'll have
  • Passion for hands-on data work.
  • Experience mentoring and upskilling junior analytical colleagues.
  • Hands-on expertise with modern data platforms and analytical tools (especially SQL and python - see our full stack below).
  • Strong communication skills to influence non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Strong commercial acumen, preferably in pricing, margin optimisation, and/or growth analytics.
  • A track record of delivering actionable insights that drive measurable business impact.
    •

raw.title: Head of Strategic Accounts, UK
raw.description:
Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.


🚀 Our Story

Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. It powers PartlyRepair, used by collision shops, workshops and suppliers to take the admin off the job; PartlyLabs, the agentic infrastructure enterprises use to deploy Interpreter across their own workflows; and a developer API.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify), with Blackbird Ventures, WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree and Ecliptic Venture Capital. Hear it from the team: Why Partly exists and AI at Partly.

🖍️ This role

Repairers are Partly's flagship customer and PartlyRepair AI is our flagship product. You own Partly's relationship with the UK's largest repair groups, from the first conversation to every site ordering.

You lead the largest accounts yourself. You sit across the table from the CFOs and commercial directors of groups running hundreds of sites, and your job is to make sure being on the panel turns into volume flowing through the platform: site commitments, mandates, pricing and the rollout plan behind them.

You also run a small team of four: an AE bringing new groups onto the network, and account managers who get signed sites live and converting. The measure of success is that the commercial standard you set becomes how the whole team works.

 

💻 What will you do

Lead our largest repair groups

  • Own the senior relationship with our largest groups, including the CFO and commercial leadership

  • Take signed accounts from panel presence to genuine wallet share

  • Drive cross-sell of new products across our installed base

Land the groups still outside the network

  • Personally lead the largest unsigned groups, including insurer owned networks

  • Own the named account list and its tiering

  • Structure the terms, not just the signature: site commitments, supply mandates and pricing

Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market.

Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. raw.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Fraud Prevention)
raw.description:
About the role

Perplexity's fraud prevention team protects our products, users, and infrastructure from fraud and abuse across the whole lifecycle: sign-up, authentication, payments, API usage, and product features. We build and operate a real-time decisioning platform together with the surrounding systems: data pipelines for detection and model training, integrations with product and payment systems, and internal tooling for investigation and response. As a software engineer on the team, you will own services end to end, from design to production operations, and work closely with fraud analysts, ML engineers, and product teams to make abuse expensive and legitimate usage frictionless.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate high-throughput, low-latency backend services for fraud detection and prevention

  • Build data pipelines and real-time feature computation that power detections and ML models

  • Collect and process trust signals

  • Integrate fraud decisions into product, auth, and payment flows across Perplexity

  • Own reliability of production services: observability, alerting, safe rollouts, incident response

  • Build internal tooling for investigation, enforcement, and auditability

  • Partner with fraud analysts to turn new abuse patterns into production detections quickly

Qualifications

  • 5+ years building and operating high-throughput, latency-sensitive backend systems in production

  • Strong systems programming skills; Rust, Go, or C++ experience preferred (we write Rust)

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud infrastructure

  • Solid data fundamentals: stream/batch computations, caching and storage trade-offs

  • Pragmatic, ownership-driven approach: ship incrementally, measure, and make failures degrade safely

Nice to have

  • Fraud prevention, anti-abuse, or payments-risk domain experience

  • Experience serving ML models in production

  • Client-side experience (web or mobile) for signal collection

raw.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What will you do:
  • Lead the full sales-cycle, from prospecting to initial interest to deal close and coordinate collaboration cross-functionally with customer success, technical teams, etc.
  • Driving a complex sales cycle, involving internal and external stakeholders like integrators.
  • Create detailed business plans designed to attain predetermined goals and quotas
  • Build relationships with executives at all levels and in all industries, in order to close deals (corporate organisations)
  • Consult with prospects and existing customers regarding business objectives and requirements, and build long-lasting partnerships (corporate organisations)
  • Model a wide range of use cases in which Pigment can drive business transformation across different industries
  • Provide professional after-sales support with our CSM team to maximise customer loyalty
  • Negotiate agreements and keep records of sales and data in Salesforce
  • Think critically about sales insights and data and experiment with new growth tactics.

    • Who are you:
  • You have first hand experience as a B2B Account Executive or similar sales role in SaaS B2B or finance product
  • You have extensive experience in prospecting, opening and developing a corporate market across EMEA.
  • You have experience with MEDDICC sales qualification methodology;
  • You thrive partnering with business leaders and executives, developing long-term relationships, closing deals, and aligning key stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle
  • You have an affinity for tech and product issues and / or a relevant experience in finance or business planning
  • You have a deep track record of creating significant revenue impact and deep relationships for your organisation
  • You are a resourceful, resilient, creative problem-solver when faced with the business needs of your clients, and understanding how Pigment plugs into the bigger picture for them.

    • What we offer:
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • Bike2work scheme – save on a new bike and gear while commuting the greener way
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
  • Remote-friendly environment

    • How we work:
  • Champion our Customer: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations
  • Thrive Together:  We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day.  Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
  • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
    • We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
     
    Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What will you do:
  • Lead the full sales-cycle, from prospecting to initial interest to deal close and coordinate collaboration cross-functionally with customer success, technical teams, etc.
  • Driving a complex sales cycle, involving internal and external stakeholders like integrators.
  • Create detailed business plans designed to attain predetermined goals and quotas
  • Build relationships with executives at all levels and in all industries, in order to close deals (corporate organisations)
  • Consult with prospects and existing customers regarding business objectives and requirements, and build long-lasting partnerships (corporate organisations)
  • Model a wide range of use cases in which Pigment can drive business transformation across different industries
  • Provide professional after-sales support with our CSM team to maximise customer loyalty
  • Negotiate agreements and keep records of sales and data in Salesforce
  • Think critically about sales insights and data and experiment with new growth tactics.

    • Who are you:
  • You have first hand experience as a B2B Account Executive or similar sales role in SaaS B2B or finance product
  • You have extensive experience in prospecting, opening and developing a corporate market across EMEA.
  • You have experience with MEDDICC sales qualification methodology;
  • You thrive partnering with business leaders and executives, developing long-term relationships, closing deals, and aligning key stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle
  • You have an affinity for tech and product issues and / or a relevant experience in finance or business planning
  • You have a deep track record of creating significant revenue impact and deep relationships for your organisation
  • You are a resourceful, resilient, creative problem-solver when faced with the business needs of your clients, and understanding how Pigment plugs into the bigger picture for them.

    • What we offer:
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • Bike2work scheme – save on a new bike and gear while commuting the greener way
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
  • Remote-friendly environment

    • How we work:
  • Champion our Customer: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations
  • Thrive Together:  We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day.  Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
  • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
    • We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
     
    Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll join Pigment’s Reporting & Collaboration community, working as a senior hands-on Frontend Engineer on some of the most complex parts of the product.

This community is responsible for how users access, configure and interact with their data. That creates significant frontend challenges around large-scale datasets, filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and increasingly AI-powered experiences.


On the engineering part:
  • Spend approximately 80% of your time as a hands-on engineer, designing, building and shipping production features.
  • Work on complex, data-heavy frontend problems where performance, usability and scale all matter.
  • Build sophisticated interfaces for displaying, filtering and interacting with large datasets.
  • Work with React, TypeScript and JavaScript, while contributing to the wider technical decisions behind the product.
  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers and Engineers to take features from problem definition through to production.
  • Make pragmatic engineering decisions based on the needs of the product and its users, rather than pursuing technical complexity for its own sake.
  • Contribute to areas across Reporting & Collaboration depending on business needs and your interests, including data extraction and filtering, visualisation, complex configuration and emerging AI experiences.
  • Use modern engineering tooling, with Pigment teams working across GCP, CircleCI and AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

    • This is not a traditional Engineering Manager role where you step away from the code. You will remain a senior individual contributor and be expected to ship.

     


    On the people management part, here is what it entails:

    At Pigment, people management and technical leadership are deliberately separated.

    Tech Leads lead the technical direction of individual teams. Engineering Managers focus on developing engineers as people while remaining hands-on engineers themselves.

  • Spend approximately 20% of your time on people management.
  • Gradually take on direct reports after establishing yourself as an IC during your probation period.
  • Coach engineers across different teams within the Reporting & Collaboration community.
  • Support engineers with career progression, development, feedback and performance.
  • Run regular 1:1s and help engineers understand what they need to do to progress.
  • Set clear expectations and provide actionable feedback.
  • Handle difficult performance conversations when necessary and follow through with clear development plans.
  • Partner with Tech Leads to understand how your reports are performing technically without taking ownership of the Tech Lead's responsibilities.
  • Help create an environment where strong engineers can continue to develop while doing their best work.

    • Engineering Managers typically support engineers across multiple teams within their community rather than "owning" a single engineering team.

     


    Who you are

    We’re looking for someone who is both a strong senior Frontend Engineer and an experienced people manager.

  • Significant professional software-engineering experience, with the technical depth expected of a senior engineer.
  • Strong recent hands-on frontend engineering experience.
  • Production experience with React, TypeScript and/or JavaScript.
  • Previous formal people-management experience. Ideally, you have already managed engineers rather than looking for your first management opportunity.
  • Experience owning areas such as coaching, career development, feedback and performance management, not simply mentoring engineers or leading projects.
  • Experience building complex product interfaces, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, analytics, data platforms or another sophisticated data-heavy product.
  • Experience solving frontend problems involving areas such as large datasets, visualisation, filtering, configuration, performance or complex workflows.
  • A strong product mindset. You care about what you're building, who is using it and whether it genuinely solves their problem.
  • Strong collaboration skills across Engineering, Product and Design.
  • The ability and desire to remain deeply hands-on in the code while managing people.
  • The autonomy expected of a senior IC: once you understand the problem, you can work with the team to move it forward without needing constant direction.
  • Fluent English. French is not required.

    • What you will get
  • Competitive salary
  • Equity
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue is entirely free for you and your family 💙
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Brand new offices in the heart of Paris, London, New York, and, Toronto
  • Remote-friendly environment
    • We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
     
    Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. raw.title: Workplace & Culture Manager
raw.description:
Job Title: Workplace & Culture Manager

Reports to: People Manager

Location: London onsite 3 days

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the role

Radiant is looking for an organised, proactive Office Manager to keep our office running smoothly and support the wider team's day-to-day needs. This role blends two things: office management (space, supplies, vendors, facilities) and operations support (scheduling, correspondence, administrative processes). You'll be the first point of contact for the office and a key enabler for the rest of the team, working onsite/hybrid from our London office.

What you'll do

Workplace Operations

  • Manage day-to-day office operations, including supplies, equipment, facilities, and vendor relationships.

  • Maintains office supply stock (takes inventory, orders supply, and handles delivery) and manages local budget for orders

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the operations team and other departments as needed.

  • Coordinate scheduling and calendar management for senior staff, including booking meetings, meeting rooms, and travel arrangements.

  • Handle the compliance layer that sits under the agreements — liability cover for the spaces we occupy, the health and safety obligations each agreement places on us, DSE and home-working assessments, first aid and fire arrangements.

  • Reviewing a vendor or office lease agreement and maintaining a single source of truth for each agreement — term dates, notice periods, break clauses, rent and service charge, desk counts, meeting-room credits, what is included and what is billed on top.

  • Own the workplace budget: forecast it, track against it, and give Finance a clear view of committed spend and what is coming up for renewal.

Employee Experience & Culture

  • New joiners: Support onboarding and offboarding of new employees — desk setup, equipment provisioning, welcome packs, and first-day logistics.

  • Provide general administrative and operational support to leadership and cross-functional teams as needed.

  • Partner with People Team and leadership to align culture initiatives with broader business goals and people strategy

Efficiency & Process Improvement

  • Continuously review and improve workplace and operational processes to drive efficiency, reduce friction, and enhance the employee experience

  • Develop and maintain clear SOPs and playbooks for all core workplace and culture operations, ensuring consistency across sites

Reports to: People Manager

Location: London onsite 3 days

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the role

Radiant is looking for an organised, proactive Office Manager to keep our office running smoothly and support the wider team's day-to-day needs. This role blends two things: office management (space, supplies, vendors, facilities) and operations support (scheduling, correspondence, administrative processes). You'll be the first point of contact for the office and a key enabler for the rest of the team, working onsite/hybrid from our London office.

What you'll do

Workplace Operations

  • Manage day-to-day office operations, including supplies, equipment, facilities, and vendor relationships.

  • Maintains office supply stock (takes inventory, orders supply, and handles delivery) and manages local budget for orders

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the operations team and other departments as needed.

  • Coordinate scheduling and calendar management for senior staff, including booking meetings, meeting rooms, and travel arrangements.

  • Handle the compliance layer that sits under the agreements — liability cover for the spaces we occupy, the health and safety obligations each agreement places on us, DSE and home-working assessments, first aid and fire arrangements.

  • Reviewing a vendor or office lease agreement and maintaining a single source of truth for each agreement — term dates, notice periods, break clauses, rent and service charge, desk counts, meeting-room credits, what is included and what is billed on top.

  • Own the workplace budget: forecast it, track against it, and give Finance a clear view of committed spend and what is coming up for renewal.

Employee Experience & Culture

  • New joiners: Support onboarding and offboarding of new employees — desk setup, equipment provisioning, welcome packs, and first-day logistics.

  • Provide general administrative and operational support to leadership and cross-functional teams as needed.

Software Engineer I (New Grad)
raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Are you a recent or upcoming graduate ready to launch your career at the forefront of industrial IoT? Join us and help shape the future of connected operations. You will immediately dive into challenging, real-world projects with the freedom and responsibility of a full-time engineer. We believe in providing a greenfield opportunity for growth and a high degree of ownership from day one. You will build and innovate, making a tangible impact on our global customers. You'll also have access to the latest AI tools, with generous token allotments, giving you the leverage to ship more and learn faster.

At Samsara, New Grads can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, a New Grad may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data from millions of devices into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, a New Grad could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments. 

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged. 

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
  • You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
  • You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
  • You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
  • You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Current Senior pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field, with an expected graduation date in 2027.
  • This is a full-time, remote OR in-person hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in our London, UK office and 2 days working remotely.

Applications will close October 30th at 6:00pm (UK) 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.title: Senior Content Marketing Manager
Analytics Engineer
raw.description:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”?

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents. We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

  • Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

  • Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have

  • 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

  • A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

  • Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

  • Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

  • A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

  • Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

  • The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

  • Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

  • Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

  • Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

  • Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

raw.title: Treasury Operations Analyst
raw.description:
Role

Taptap Send is seeking a highly organised and motivated individual to join our Treasury Operations team and help us grow our business. In this role, you will report to the Director of Payments and touch all aspects of Taptap Send's payment operations, with an initial focus on stablecoin funding, working directly with our teams and partners across the world.

You'll own the full life cycle of payments, including creating, tracking and confirming crediting of funds, as well as troubleshooting payment issues across our growing Stablecoin operations. You'll also be involved in funding forecasts to ensure that our partners are well funded at all times.

You'll work directly with our trading team as well as collaborating with the wider team that spans the globe ( London, Abidjan, Lagos, Nairobi, Paris and New York, to name a few places), ensuring that Taptap Send is effectively supported in its growth and customer ambitions! There is plenty of room for professional progression and personal growth within our friendly and ever-growing Taptap community.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively managing treasury operations, initially for stablecoins, to ensure our accounts are funded and payments can be processed seamlessly

  • Working closely with partners to ensure that funding timelines are being delivered on time

  • Troubleshooting to find root causes of payment issues and working with internal and external partners to resolve

  • Assisting with onboarding new banks and trading partners for stablecoin, working closely with our business development team

  • Providing out-of-hours coverage when required

Requirements

  • Have at least 1 years’ experience, ideally in a payments or funding role and/or working with stablecoins

  • Are passionate about our mission and eager to do what needs to be done to achieve it

  • Are enthusiastic about treasury operations, solving unique problems, and optimizing processes

  • Enjoy challenges, are resourceful and think outside the box to find creative ways to tackle problems

  • Love working in teams and building meaningful relationships with key stakeholders

  • Don’t hesitate to place a call to promptly resolve issues or persevere to get a result

  • Have great organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities in a fast-paced startup environment where no two days are the same

  • Have proven analytical skills (Excel); SQL a plus

  • Are proficient in English

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

 

Taptap Values

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

 

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

raw.title: CASS Oversight Manager (f/m/d)
raw.description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

As the CASS Oversight Manager, you are responsible for ensuring that client money and custody assets held by Upvest Securities are protected, segregated and accounted for in full compliance with the FCA’s Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS).

You will act as the primary day-to-day authority on CASS, bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements, our operational processes, our client’s needs and our scalable investment API. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the CASS oversight framework: Maintain and continuously improve Upvest's CASS risk assessment, controls matrix, policies and procedures across CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, providing clear guidance to the business on what is and isn't permitted.

  • Work with our B2B clients, sales and client impact teams to actively shape solutions and provide advice that enables Upvest to support engaging and accessible investing for millions of end users in a CASS compliant way.

  • Oversee reconciliations and client money calculations: Oversee daily client money calculations and internal and external reconciliations of client money and custody assets, ensuring breaks are investigated promptly, shortfalls are funded and root causes are addressed.

  • Manage breaches and regulatory reporting: Maintain the CASS breach register, assess materiality, drive remediation and support FCA notifications where required. Own the monthly CMAR submission and act as the primary contact for the annual CASS audit, closing out findings to completion.

  • Keep the CASS Resolution Pack live: Ensure the resolution pack is complete, current and retrievable within regulatory timeframes, and that it is updated whenever banks, custodians, key vendors or critical staff change.

  • Embed CASS into how we build: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess the client asset impact of new products, features and system changes, and to ensure our ledgers, payment flows and custody integrations do what the rules require by design.

  • Enhance governance and culture: Produce clear CASS MI for the board and risk committees, deliver CASS training across the organisation, and track FCA developments to assess their impact on Upvest.

  • Manage external relationships: Support due diligence and periodic reviews of banks, custodians, and maintain acknowledgement letters and mandate registers in the prescribed form. Feed into TISA and other appropriate forums to gain further industry insights.

What you bring:

  • Deep CASS Expertise: Thorough working knowledge of CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, including client money calculations, reconciliation methods, acknowledgement letters, resolution pack requirements and the SMCR context in which the SMF18 operates.

  • Hands-on Client Asset Experience: Several years in a CASS operations, oversight or audit role in practice or at a broker, platform, custodian or wealth manager, with practical experience of breach handling, CMAR reporting and CASS audits.

  • Regulatory Analysis Skills: Proven experience in interpreting FCA rules and guidance and translating them into clear actionable operational procedures and controls.

  • Stakeholder Management: Strong communication of regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders, including engineering and product teams, external auditors and third-party custodians and banks.

  • Self-Starter Mentality: A highly organised approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise appropriately, and thrive under pressure, particularly around reporting and audit deadlines.

It’s great if you have:

  • Qualifications: Relevant industry certifications such as CISI Client Assets Specialist qualification, an accounting or audit background, or equivalent professional certification in a related discipline.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

raw.title: Senior Associate, Software Engineer
raw.description:
WisdomTree is seeking a Senior Associate, Full Stack Developer to join our fast-paced Software Engineering team and enhance our recently developed Trading and Pricing applications. The role spans front-end and back-end development, working closely with business stakeholders to translate needs into high-quality, maintainable and extensible solutions.

The Senior Associate will work independently on assigned projects while collaborating with the European Technology team and Software Engineering Lead. The role covers the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements and solution design through development, testing, release, deployment and post-deployment support.

The role will contribute to both Trading and Pricing applications, helping ensure they remain reliable, scalable and aligned with critical and evolving business needs.


Key Accountabilities and Scope
  • Business Partnership & Requirements: Work with business stakeholders to understand workflows, clarify needs and translate them into clear technical requirements, scope and acceptance criteria.
  • End-to-End Delivery: Own assigned tasks and projects from discovery and solution design through development, testing, release, deployment and post-release support, managing risks and dependencies throughout.
  • Trading & Pricing Applications: Develop, enhance and maintain business-critical features across both applications, with a focus on reliable workflows and maintainable solutions.
  • Solution Design: Contribute to technical design with the Software Engineering team, ensuring alignment with application architecture and engineering standards.
  • Front-End Development: Build and enhance user-facing features using React and Django.
  • Back-End Development: Develop Python services and APIs and integrate with Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • Quality & Agile Delivery: Deliver secure, well-tested and high-performing solutions; participate in planning, estimation, demonstrations, code reviews and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Infrastructure & Deployment: Work with CI/CD pipelines, Azure and AWS services, Terraform and serverless functions to support reliable releases.

    • Essential Skills and Qualifications

    Business Partnership & Delivery

  • Experience working independently with business stakeholders to discover, analyse and document requirements.
  • Experience owning tasks or small projects through the full software delivery lifecycle, from requirements through deployment and post-release validation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain business and technical requirements to different audiences.
  • Ability to manage priorities, dependencies and delivery risks while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

    • Front-End Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in React and Django, with experience in component-driven development and modern UI libraries.

    • Back-End Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Python and API development, including complex business logic and algorithms.
  • Experience with ORM and database integrations using Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

    • Design Principles

  • Good knowledge of software architecture, design principles and maintainable coding practices.
  • Experience with automated testing, test-driven development and peer code review.
  • Ability to collaborate on solution design while independently progressing implementation work.

    • DevOps & Tooling

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows and automated testing.

    • Desirable Skills and Qualifications
  • Financial services or investment-platform experience.
  • Experience working with trading, market data, valuation or pricing applications.
  • Knowledge of Azure App Service, serverless functions such as Azure Functions or AWS Lambda, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.

    • About Us:

    WisdomTree is a global financial innovator, offering a diverse suite of exchange-traded products (ETPs), models and solutions, private market investments and digital asset-related products. Our offerings empower investors to shape their financial future and equip financial professionals to grow their businesses. Leveraging the latest financial infrastructure, we create products that emphasize access and transparency and provide an enhanced user experience. Building on our heritage of innovation, we offer next-generation digital products and services related to tokenized real world assets and stablecoins, as well as our institutional platform, WisdomTree Connect™, blockchain-native digital wallet, WisdomTree Prime®*, and have expanded into private markets through the acquisition of Ceres Partners’ U.S. farmland platform.

     

    Work Smart:

    Headquartered in New York City, WisdomTree embraces a “Work Smart” philosophy that transcends physical workspace, aiming to optimize productivity, efficiency and effectiveness. Employee time in the office generally is not prescribed, and team leaders are empowered to determine how their teams work best, based on their roles, which may include in-person, in-office engagement.

     

    Mission, Vision & Values:

    WisdomTree is committed to delivering a better financial experience through the quality of our products, solutions and engagement, and to be the leader in delivering best structured access to global asset classes, empowering clients through innovative solutions and long-term performance. WisdomTree employees strive for excellence and innovation, work with transparency and accountability and support each other as a global team. We welcome the applications of qualified individuals who will support this mission and thrive in our collaborative and empowering work environment.
